chapters.title: Chapter 4880: THE Civilizational Instinctus! II
paragraphs: |In battle, THE Civilizational Instinctus transforms combat from an exchange of power into an architectural demolition for you. You no longer fight your opponent directly but rather fight the structure of their existence, seeking to topple their Civilization piece by piece until the whole collapses under its own compromised weight.|

|This methodology is particularly effective against opponents of greater Depth than yourself. Where direct confrontation would favor their superior weight, structural targeting allows you to circumvent that advantage entirely. You do not need to overpower their walls when you can simply remove the foundations those walls rest upon.|

|Against Absolutes, this capability represents your primary path to victory. Their Depth exceeds yours, but their Civilizations possess vulnerabilities accumulated across eons of existence. The older and grander a Civilization, the more points of failure may have developed within its structure if its foundations are weak.|
A path to victory against Absolutes!
Not through matching their power directly, but through exploiting weaknesses that their power couldn’t protect them from!
|Passive Benefit: Existential Proprioception|

|You now possess perfect awareness of your own Civilization’s Manifestation and its structural integrity. You perceive your own weaknesses as clearly as you perceive others’, allowing you to shore up vulnerabilities before enemies can exploit them. Your existence instinctively reinforces stressed points and redistributes weight to prevent collapse.|

|This self-awareness also grants immunity to being analyzed by others possessing similar capabilities. Your Infinities create a shroud of endless variation around your Manifestation, making it impossible for observers to perceive any single configuration long enough to identify weaknesses. What they see changes faster than they can process.|
So he could see himself as clearly as he could see others, but others couldn’t see him in return.
His Infinities protected him from the very capability he now possessed, creating a one-way mirror where he could observe without being observed.
|Scaling Parameters|

|THE Civilizational Instinctus grows more potent as your foundations increase. At current weight of 11x Surface, 10.5x Intermediate, and equivalent Fundamental to THE Primordial Paradox, you can clearly observe Manifestations of beings up to weak and average Absolute classification. Stronger Absolutes appear blurred, their Manifestations only partially visible.|

|As your weight increases, so too does the clarity of your observation. At weight equivalent to standard Absolutes, you would perceive their Manifestations with perfect clarity. At weight exceeding Absolutes, you would begin perceiving hints of Manifestations belonging to entities approaching THE Second Scale.|
|There is no theoretical ceiling to this capability. As your Infinite Formless Depth grows without limit, so too does THE Civilizational Instinctus’ reach.|
|Activation Requirements|
|THE Civilizational Instinctus requires no conscious activation for its autonomous response function. Your existence will react instinctively to threats regardless of your attention or awareness.|

|For Manifestation observation and structural analysis, focused attention is required. You must intentionally observe an entity with the purpose of perceiving their Civilization’s architecture. Casual glances reveal nothing. Dedicated focus reveals everything.|

|For targeted undifferentiation, you must have first identified a specific vulnerability and then direct your attacks with that weakness as the intended target. Unfocused attacks carry no structural targeting benefits. If you cannot even get near your enemy, even if you see their weakness, you will be unable to do anything.|
That last line was important.

Seeing weaknesses meant nothing if he couldn’t reach them. THE Civilizational Instinctus wasn’t omnipotence. It was a tool, and like all tools, it had limitations that he would need to account for in actual combat.
|Historical Context|
|THE Civilizational Instinctus has only been achieved by beings approaching THE Second Scale of Existence, and you are ridiculously far from that.|
|You are the first being in Observable Existence below Absolute to achieve any form of THE Civilizational Instinctus.|
The first below Absolute!
Another unprecedented achievement to add to a growing list of unprecedented achievements!
|Final Assessment|

|The Spark Fragment of THE First Cause has granted you three boons. First, the elevation of your foundations. Second, the Echo of First Cause prophecy that illuminatespotentialfutures. Third, THE Civilizational Instinctus that transforms how you perceive and observe the Civilizations.|
The possibilities were far too grand as Noah processed everything he had just learned.
And yes, he felt like he could truly see now.
When he looked at himself with his newly enhanced perception, he saw the phantom of his own Civilizational Manifestation unfurling before his awareness.

A massive Grimoire floated at the center of everything, its pages infinite and its cover burning with blue-gold light that painted the surrounding space in colors that spoke of boundless potential. Surrounding this Grimoire were Seals that formed a structure resembling a massive infinity symbol, the lemniscate shape wrapping around the book in endless loops.

Three massive pillars of foundation rose up endlessly from below, representing his Surface, Intermediate, and Fundamental Depths. They connected down to a radiant shore where vibrant blue-gold fields stretched toward horizons that couldn’t be perceived and trees shimmered with stellar brilliance that spoke of Civilizations planted and nurtured.

And at the very center of it all, a massive crimson blue-gold bonfire shone with the light of his Infinite Hunger combined with his core Infinite Undifferentiated Fate. Its embers flowed upward in an endless stream, inscribing themselves on the infinite pages of the Grimoire above before cycling back down to fuel the fire once more.
An endless cycle of growth and inscription and growth again.
|Self-Analysis Complete|
|Your Manifestation displays no observable weaknesses at this time|
|The integration of Infinity across all aspects of your Civilization has created a structure that shifts faster than vulnerabilities can form|
|Any stress point that begins to develop is immediately reinforced by your Infinities before it can become exploitable|
|This does not mean you are invincible|
|It means that THE Civilizational Instinctus cannot identify targets for structural attack against your current configuration|
|Enemies will need to rely on overwhelming force rather than precision targeting to harm you|
Noah looked at all of this as he felt a sense of calmness and Immensity settling over his existence.
He had become something truly unprecedented during this Temporal Traversal!
But first, he needed to get back.

As his body continued to tumble across existence, carried by weavings that had no destination, he sought to find an anchor between definition and undefinition that would allow him to return to reality. He needed something that existed in both states simultaneously, something that could serve as a bridge between where he was and where he needed to be.
When he thought of THE Infiniverse, existence fizzled around him as the coordinates failed to lock.
When he thought of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, the same fizzling occurred.
When he thought of Alfheimr or Ginnungagap or any other locations in his time, nothing took hold.
None of them were both defined and undefined in their stability.
None of them could serve as anchors for whatever strange space he was currently traversing.
He just needed entry to something that existed in both states, something that would anchor him to The Interstices, and from The Interstices he could navigate back to wherever he needed to go.
Something defined and undefined...

His eyes and existence that could now see many things shone with sudden realization as a candidate emerged in his mind. Something he had encountered before. Something that had nearly ended his journey through The Interstices the first time he had traveled them.
"O Hollow Echo, are you not defined and undefined? You are not THE Creature, and yet you are..."
HUUM!
Around him, existence flickered with recognition.
And this time, things did not fizzle.
The coordinates locked onto something that existed as both an echo and a presence, both a memory and a reality, both defined by what it had been and undefined by what it currently was.

He felt Temporal Traversal activating, his body instantly squeezing across existence as the weavings of definition and undefinition found their anchor point and began funneling him toward it with purpose that had been lacking moments before.
WAP!
Noah arrived back in The Interstices.

He found himself inside a Capillary Thread, one of the countless pathways that connected moments across time. Things would normally be dark and mystical here, the undefined space between spaces holding only shadows and potential.
But he could see now.

THE Civilizational Instinctus illuminated everything with clarity, showing him the structure of The Interstices themselves, the weavings of temporal authority that connected many things, the fabric of reality that made his journey possible.
And far ahead of him, the target he had been able to lock onto to bring himself back...
THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature turned around to observe him.
Its form was massive, a distorted reflection of THE Creature himself, burning with multicolored flames that flickered between presence and absence.
It observed him coldly, recognizing the being who had fled from it before.
Noah looked at THE Hollow Echo with a cold and glorious light in his eyes, his existence burning with blue-gold Infinities that painted the Capillary Thread in colors.
This time, he did not run away.
He did not run away.
His Civilizational Instinctus activated as he focused on THE Hollow Echo with dedicated attention, and for the first time, he saw what lay behind the multicolored flames.
He saw the Manifestation of an echo.
He saw the cracks in a foundation that had been hollow from the moment of its creation.
He saw weaknesses that no one had ever perceived because no one had ever looked at this thing with eyes that could truly see.
And Noah looked at this thing seriously.
"I believe...you and I have unfinished business."

chapters.title: Chapter 4881: All In I
paragraphs: What Noah saw was something unique.

The Manifestation of the Civilization of THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature was unlike anything he could have anticipated, its architecture showing something that had once been grand but was now merely a reflection of grandeur, a shadow cast by a light that existed elsewhere.

Nine grand hollow mountains surrounded the Echo, their tips pointing inward toward the being they protected while their bases spread outward in a perfect circle that seemed to define the boundaries of this entity’s domain. Each mountain was massive beyond description, their surfaces carved from what looked like crystallized colorless flame that had been frozen in the moment of burning, and their interiors were visible through countless apertures that revealed emptiness where substance should have been.
Hollow.
Just like the Echo itself.
The nine mountains formed a circular hollow domain that spun slowly around THE Hollow Echo, their rotation creating currents of authority that pressed against Noah’s existence with weight!
The formation was defensive and offensive simultaneously, a fortress that could become a weapon, a shield that could become a blade.
It was a unique thing to see, and for Noah, it was novelty, and it was new.
And because it was new, he focused and remained serious.

Because he was not even an Absolute, and he was looking at a Hollow Echo of THE Creature himself and choosing to fight with it rather than flee from it as he had done before. The gap between them should have been insurmountable. The difference in their existences should have made this confrontation nothing more than elaborate suicide.
But should have meant nothing to someone like him!
He looked at THE Hollow Echo with eyes that now perceived reality as it truly was, his Civilizational Instinctus granting him true sight.
"This time, there will be no running or retreat."
His voice was calm but held weight that made the Capillary Thread around them tremble.
"Unlike previous times, I will stake the Everything of this body. Either it collapses you, or you collapse it."
He paused, his blue-gold existence burning brighter.
"Do you understand me?"

He asked this question genuinely, because it would be even grander if this Hollow Echo could actually comprehend what was being offered. It would make dismembering it all that much more satisfying if it understood the stakes!
And...
"You. Have. Changed."
HUUM!

THE Hollow Echo shockingly spoke, its voice emerging from the colorless flames that comprised its form. The words were fragmented, broken apart by the hollow nature of the being speaking them, but they carried understanding that Noah hadn’t expected.

Around THE Hollow Echo, colorless flames flared and began to rage with intensity that painted the entire Capillary Thread in shades of absence. The nine hollow mountains that comprised its Manifestation actually began to spin faster, their rotation accelerating as the Echo prepared for combat.
And as the mountains spun, Noah paid attention with the dedicated focus that THE Civilizational Instinctus required.
He saw the weaknesses.

On the first mountain, a crack ran down from its hollow tip toward its base, a fissure that told of structural compromise where the mountain’s authority had been stretched too thin across too many defensive functions. The crack pulsed faintly with each rotation, growing slightly wider before contracting, a wound that had never properly healed.

On the third mountain, the apertures that revealed its hollow interior were clustered too densely on one face, creating a section of the surface that was more hole than substance. The integrity there was maintained through will rather than structure, and will could be exhausted.

On the fifth mountain, the base where it connected to the circular formation showed signs of erosion, the crystallized colorless flame appearing slightly dimmer than the rest of the structure. This was the oldest weakness, accumulated across however long THE Hollow Echo had existed in The Interstices.

On the seventh mountain, a crevice ran horizontally across its midsection where two different types of authority had been fused together imperfectly. The seam was nearly invisible, but to Noah’s enhanced perception it blazed like a beacon, announcing structural failure waiting to happen.

And on the ninth mountain, the tip itself showed microscopic fractures radiating outward from where it pointed toward THE Hollow Echo, stress damage from bearing too much of the hollow Civilization’s concentrated weight for too long.
Five clear weaknesses across nine mountains.
Five targets!
Five points where THE Civilizational Instinctus could be applied to transform this battle from an exchange of power into architectural demolition.

Noah saw every single one of these points as he prepared himself, his existence beginning to buzz with Immensity that had grown to levels rivaling weak Absolutes. He nodded with the calm of someone who had already calculated the path to victory.
"I have definitely changed. You have not."
His blue-gold flames burned brighter.
"Are you ready? Our Everythings are on the line."
THE Hollow Echo’s colorless flames surged with intensity that made the nine mountains tremble, and when it spoke again, its fragmented voice carried the weight of something magisterial!
"You. Cannot. Even. Comprehend. My. Everythings."
HUUM!
It was a reply, and shockingly it was also an Embodiment!

The words themselves carried the authority of THE Creature’s aspect, Existence given voice in a declaration that pressed against reality with weight that should have crushed anything below Absolute! The Embodiment crashed outward from THE Hollow Echo like a wave of pure presence, colorless and overwhelming and absolutely certain of its supremacy.
Noah felt the Embodiment coming as he stayed still.

His weight should be grand enough with his foundation to rival a weak Absolute. His established Apophasis were still active, still declaring what he was not. His Infinities still burned across every aspect of his existence, creating endless potential for response.

Every part of his existence was buzzing, but it wasn’t agitation or excitement that drove this resonance. It was determination. His existence was burning with determination as it wanted to test itself, to prove itself against something that would have been unthinkable to face just hours before!
And so it did.
And so he stayed still.
The weight of an Embodiment crashed into him.

The authority of "You. Cannot. Even. Comprehend. My. Everythings." slammed against his foundations with force that should have scattered his existence across The Interstices like ashes in a hurricane. The pressure was immense, incomprehensible, the weight of Existence focused through an Echo that retained a sliver of the original’s power to devastate anything below Absolute!
Certain times in existence, one could stand so defiant that an enemy could see their defiance and look at them with respect rather than contempt.

At this time, THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature looked at Noah’s unflinching gaze as this being who should have been crushed, who should have been scattered, who should have been nothing before the weight of an Embodiment... actually stood firm.
THE Hollow Echo nodded with seriousness and respect.
And...
BOOM!

The Embodiment that smashed into Noah only caused his blue-gold robes to flutter in currents of displaced authority, the fabric rippling with the remnants of force that had been distributed across his entire existence rather than concentrated on any single point.
He had long since stopped being THE Tongue Whisperer at this time.
He was not hiding behind a disguise or concealing his true nature.
He was Noah Osmont, THE Genesis Monarch, and at this moment he was an Absolute Immovable Object who did not move beneath weight that should have moved him!
His existence remained exactly where it was, and oh, the sensations that flooded through him were beyond description!
|Combat Analysis - Embodiment Resistance Successful|

|Due to your foundation weight of 11x Surface, 10.5x Intermediate, and equivalent Fundamental to THE Primordial Paradox, you possess sufficient Immensity to bear the crushing weight of Embodiments from Hollow Echoes without structural collapse. Your weight creates natural resistance that disperses incoming authority across your entire existence.|

|Additionally, your established Apophasis remain active: You are not limited by the weight that crashes against you. Your existence is not incapable of bearing that which seeks to overwhelm it. You are not collapsible under the Immensity of what you have claimed. Most of these negations remove conceptual vulnerabilities that Embodiments would normally exploit.|

|Furthermore, Autonomous Existential Response activated without conscious command. Your Infinities detected the incoming Embodiment and automatically configured your Seals, your Foundation, and your Civilizational Authority. Your body knew how to bear this weight before your mind understood what was happening.|
|You stood against an Embodiment of THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature through sheer will alone!|
HUUM!

At this time, THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature looked at Noah’s unflinching gaze as this being who should have been crushed, who should have been scattered, who should have been nothing before the weight of an Embodiment... actually stood firm.
THE Hollow Echo nodded with seriousness and respect.
And...
BOOM!

The Embodiment that smashed into Noah only caused his blue-gold robes to flutter in currents of displaced authority, the fabric rippling with the remnants of force that had been distributed across his entire existence rather than concentrated on any single point.
He had long since stopped being THE Tongue Whisperer at this time.
He was not hiding behind a disguise or concealing his true nature.
He was Noah Osmont, THE Genesis Monarch, and at this moment he was an Absolute Immovable Object who did not move beneath weight that should have moved him!
His existence remained exactly where it was, and oh, the sensations that flooded through him were beyond description!
|Combat Analysis - Embodiment Resistance Successful|

|Due to your foundation weight of 11x Surface, 10.5x Intermediate, and equivalent Fundamental to THE Primordial Paradox, you possess sufficient Immensity to bear the crushing weight of Embodiments from Hollow Echoes without structural collapse.
Your weight creates natural resistance that disperses incoming authority across your entire existence.|
|Additionally, your established Apophasis remain active: You are not limited by the weight that crashes against you.
Your existence is not incapable of bearing that which seeks to overwhelm it.
You are not collapsible under the Immensity of what you have claimed.
Most of these negations remove conceptual vulnerabilities that Embodiments would normally exploit.|
|Furthermore, Autonomous Existential Response activated without conscious command.
Your Infinities detected the incoming Embodiment and automatically configured your Seals, your Foundation, and your Civilizational Authority.
Your body knew how to bear this weight before your mind understood what was happening.|
|You stood against an Embodiment of THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature through sheer will alone!|
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4882: All In II
paragraphs: Noah felt the swirling Absolute Seals of Quintessence and Infinity and Fire and Darkness and Unity and many more all infinitely manifesting over his skin alongside his Immensity, creating a barrier of authority that reinforced his natural resistance.
Even though it was heavy, even though it was unfathomably heavy, even though lesser beings would have been erased from existence by such weight... he actually stood against an Embodiment!
And the action brought this battle to an extremely serious precipice.
THE Hollow Echo looked at him with colorless flames that burned brighter than before, recognition in its fragmented awareness.
It nodded once more as it raised its hands, the nine hollow mountains spinning faster around its form in preparation for what came next.
"Existence. Is. Everything."
Its voice was stronger now, more cohesive, as if Noah’s defiance had reminded it of what it meant to truly fight.
"And...My Everything Is Existence."
HUUM!

Another Embodiment bloomed outward from THE Hollow Echo, but this time it didn’t simply crash against Noah’s position. This time the Embodiment covered the Echo’s hands in crystalline colorless light, transforming its limbs into weapons of pure existential authority that shot out across the Capillary Thread!
The hands were declaring that everything they touched existed only at the Echo’s sufferance!
And Noah...
"Actually."
WAP!

He disappeared from the position where THE Hollow Echo’s crystalline hands were converging, his existence flickering out of that space and materializing above the Echo in a movement so fast that even the spinning mountains couldn’t track it immediately.
He had been going to block.
He had been going to test his defenses against this second Embodiment.
But somewhere between deciding to stand firm and the hands reaching him, he had changed his mind.

His face showed determination and seriousness as Immensity radiated from every aspect of his being, blue-gold flames painting the Capillary Thread in colors that challenged the Echo’s colorless authority. He looked down at THE Hollow Echo from above with eyes that saw its Manifestation clearly, that perceived the crevice on the seventh mountain where two types of authority had been fused imperfectly.
He punched out!

The motion seemed to occur in slow motion, each fraction of movement stretching across heartbeats as the significance of what was happening demanded attention. His fist descended toward THE Hollow Echo, and as it moved, it became covered with tantalizing blue-gold light of Infinities that burned so brightly that even the colorless flames of the Echo seemed to dim by comparison.
But the fist wasn’t the attack.
The fist was the delivery mechanism.

While he punched out, an endless sea of Absolute Seals of his First Tongue rushed forward from his existence like an ocean given purpose and direction. They didn’t spread randomly across THE Hollow Echo’s defenses. They didn’t waste themselves against the strongest sections of the hollow mountains.
They bombarded the crevice on the seventh mountain with precision that only THE Civilizational Instinctus could provide!

Seals of Absolute Tongue crashed against the horizontal weakness where two authorities had been imperfectly fused, their Infinite Hunger quality devouring the structural integrity that held the seam together. The Authority of Undifferentiated Fate followed immediately after, their quality of inducing undifferentiation causing the fused authorities to begin forgetting that they had ever been connected!

It was an attack that carried the seriousness of THE First Tongue behind it, 27 base configurations each multiplying infinitely into floods of linguistic authority that poured into a single structural weakness with concentrated devastation.
It was blinding.
It was glorious!
And the seventh hollow mountain, which had stood as part of THE Hollow Echo’s Manifestation since its creation, began to crack.
The seventh mountain cracked!

The sound that emerged from that structural failure was a terrifying onw. The crevice where two imperfectly fused authorities had been joined now gaped open like a wound that refused to close, the edges of the breach blurring as his Authority of Undifferentiated Fate continued their work of making the mountain forget what it had been.
THE Hollow Echo’s colorless flames flickered.
Well, not much, but enough!

Noah saw the connection immediately through THE Civilizational Instinctus. The nine hollow mountains weren’t just defenses surrounding the Echo, they were akin to load-bearing structures that supported its very existence and Civilization.
Damage to the Manifestation was damage to the being. Weakness in the architecture was weakness in the foundation of the Civilization!
Good to know!

The Echo’s crystalline hands that had been reaching toward where Noah had been standing moments before now swung upward toward his current position, their Embodiment-covered surfaces burning with authority that declared everything they touched would exist only at the Echo’s sufferance.
But Noah was already moving.

His existence flickered across the Capillary Thread with speed of a weaker Absolutes, his blue-gold form leaving afterimages that the Echo’s hands passed through without contact. He materialized beside the first mountain, the one with the crack running from tip to base, and his Seals were already flooding outward before his conscious mind had finished processing his new position.
Autonomous Existential Response!
His body knew what to do before his thoughts caught up.
It was a strange sensation, watching himself act with precision he hadn’t consciously chosen. Like being a passenger in his own existence. He’d have to get used to that.

Infinite Seals of Darkness crashed against the crack in the first mountain, their authority heavy with the quality of endings and conclusions that pressed against the structural weakness with concentrated precision. The mountain’s surface, already compromised by the fissure that had never properly healed, began to splinter outward from the point of impact.
"Existence Demands Tribute."
BOOM!
An Embodiment erupted from THE Hollow Echo with force that made the entire Capillary Thread tremble, the declaration pressing against reality itself with weight that demanded acknowledgment.
The authority of "Existence Demands Tribute" crashed against Noah’s existence with crushing pressure that sought to extract payment for his defiance.
He stood firm.
The pressure was immense.
His robes rippled. His flames dimmed momentarily. His existence actually compressed slightly under the weight of authority that would’ve scattered lesser beings across The Interstices.
But he didn’t fall!
And while he bore the Embodiment’s weight, his Seals continued their assault on the first mountain.
CRACK!

The fissure split open completely, running from the hollow tip all the way down to the base in a single devastating line. The first mountain didn’t crumble immediately, but its authority wavered, its rotation around THE Hollow Echo becoming unsteady as structural integrity failed across half its surface.
Noah flickered again.

He appeared at the fifth mountain, the one whose base showed signs of erosion where it connected to the circular formation. His existence was still bearing the weight of the Embodiment, still being pressed upon by authority that demanded tribute, but his attacks didn’t pause.
Couldn’t pause!

THE Hollow Echo was recovering from the shock and confusion of its power...failing and falling. Its colorless flames surged brighter as rage or determination or something that existed in the hollow space between emotions drove it toward retaliation. Noah had a window of opportunity, and that window was closing with every heartbeat.

Seals of Chaos flooded against the eroded base of the fifth mountain, their authority heavy with the quality of unpredictability that destabilized the already-weakened connection. The erosion that had accumulated across eons of existence became active decay in moments, the crystallized colorless flame beginning to dissolve where it met the circular formation.
"You Will Pay For This."
HUUM!

THE Hollow Echo’s voice was more coherent now, fury binding its fragments together into something approaching unified speech. Its massive form turned toward Noah with attention that had physical weight, and its hands rose once more as crystalline authority gathered around them.
But this time, it wasn’t just the hands.

THE Hollow Echo’s feet also began to glow with Embodiment-covered surfaces, the same crystalline colorless light wrapping around its lower limbs as it prepared an assault from multiple vectors simultaneously.
Noah saw the attack coming through THE Civilizational Instinctus, his enhanced perception tracking the trajectories of limbs that would converge on his position from four different angles.
He was going to evade, but...
"No."
He stayed.

His existence burned brighter as another Embodiment crashed against him, "You Will Pay For This" declaring that his actions had consequences that must be extracted. The weight was even greater than before, the Echo’s fury adding force to authority that pressed against his foundations with crushing intensity.
His flames dimmed further. His Seals worked overtime to redistribute the pressure. His Apophasis strained against conceptual attack that sought to make him collapsible.
But his hands didn’t stop moving.

While bearing the weight of two Embodiments simultaneously, Noah continued flooding Seals against the eroded base of the fifth mountain. His existence trembled. His foundations groaned. His infinite aspects stretched to accommodate pressure that should’ve been impossible to bear!
If anyone were watching this, they’d probably think he looked incredibly heroic. Standing firm against impossible odds. Defying authority that would crush lesser beings!
In reality, he was mostly trying to make sure he lived up to the distinction of Absolute Immovable Object.

The pressure was genuinely awful. Like being squeezed through a hole that was too small for his existence. But showing weakness now would be worse than the discomfort, so he kept his expression steady and his Seals flowing.
And the fifth mountain’s base gave way.
CRACK!
Before him, every fucking thing had to give way!

chapters.title: Chapter 4883: All In III
paragraphs: The connection to the circular formation severed completely, and the fifth mountain began to drift away from its assigned position, no longer contributing to the defensive formation, no longer spinning with its brethren in protection of THE Hollow Echo.
Two mountains compromised!
And THE Hollow Echo’s colorless flames had dimmed noticeably, its existence weakening in direct proportion to the damage inflicted on its Manifestation.
"Enough."

The Echo’s voice was fully coherent now, unified by fury that transcended its hollow nature. Its hands and feet, all covered in Embodiment authority, launched toward Noah’s position with speed that exceeded anything it had displayed before.
But Noah was already flickering away.
The weight of the two Embodiments he’d been bearing was still pressing against his existence, but the Echo’s weakened state meant that pressure was no longer insurmountable!

He materialized at the third mountain, the one with apertures clustered too densely on one face. His Seals were already flooding out before his feet touched position, infinite authority crashing against the section that was more hole than substance.
THE Hollow Echo’s hands passed through where he’d been.

He flickered to the ninth mountain, the one with stress fractures radiating from its tip. His Seals bombarded the microscopic damage with concentrated force, turning hairline cracks into structural failures.
THE Hollow Echo’s feet swept through empty space.
He appeared at the first mountain again, targeting the now-gaping fissure with Seals filled with Undifferentiated Fate that made the crystallized colorless flame forget it had ever been solid.
The Echo’s limbs, massive and covered in Embodiment authority, crashed against positions he’d already vacated.
Again.
And again.
And again!

Noah became a blur of blue-gold light that flickered across the battlefield, never staying in one position long enough for THE Hollow Echo’s attacks to connect, always appearing at the next weakness in the Manifestation’s architecture. His speed was truly, undoubtedly that of an Absolute! His precision exceeded them!
From THE Hollow Echo’s perspective, this probably looked like masterful combat. A perfect display of superior tactics overwhelming raw power.
From Noah’s perspective, it was a lot of flickering and smashing into structures of a Civilization that even his enemy did not know existed for him to see and exploit!
Same result, very different internal experiences.
CRACK!
The third mountain’s aperture-dense face collapsed inward, the section that had been more hole than substance finally giving way entirely.
CRACK!
The ninth mountain’s tip shattered, the stress fractures that had been accumulating reaching critical failure under the assault of infinite Seals.
CRACK!
The first mountain split in half, the fissure running from tip to base finally completing its work of total structural compromise.
THE Hollow Echo’s movements were slowing.
Its colorless flames were guttering.
Its Embodiments, when it managed to launch them, had weight that Noah’s foundations could bear without strain.
And still he didn’t stop.

He appeared at mountains that hadn’t shown obvious weaknesses, and THE Civilizational Instinctus revealed them anyway. Stress points that had been too subtle to perceive initially now blazed with clarity as the overall structure weakened. Secondary vulnerabilities that had been supported by primary integrity now became primary vulnerabilities of their own.
CRACK!
The fourth mountain’s internal support structure collapsed.
CRACK!
The sixth mountain’s rotation failed entirely, the hollow peak drifting away from the formation.
CRACK!
The eighth mountain’s surface shattered like glass, revealing emptiness within emptiness.

Noah floated in the center of what had once been a domain of nine grand hollow mountains, surrounded now by the fragments and debris of structural annihilation. Broken peaks drifted through the Capillary Thread. Shattered bases tumbled end over end in slow motion. Crystallized colorless flame dissolved into proto-matter that the space between spaces eagerly absorbed.
And THE Hollow Echo stood before him, its body no longer surrounded by its Manifestation’s protection.
Because its Manifestation was ruined.
Noah looked at THE Hollow Echo with eyes that saw everything clearly, and what he saw made him understand the true nature of what he’d accomplished.
THE Hollow Echo’s body was filled with cracks.

Not surface damage, but fundamental structural and Civilizational failure that mirrored the destruction of its Manifestation. Lines of fractured existence ran across its colorless flames, dark seams where its authority had been torn throughout by the collapse of the mountains that had supported its Civilization.

Its hands, which had been so powerful moments before, now trembled with weakness that couldn’t be concealed. Its flames, which had burned with the Echo of THE Creature’s aspect, now flickered with the uncertainty of a candle in a storm.
Its Depth, or really its Civilization, had been dismantled from the foundation up.
THE Hollow Echo looked at Noah with heaviness.
"You...were not like this."
"No," Noah agreed, his voice calm in a way that transcended the violence that had just occurred."I was not."
He floated before THE Hollow Echo with seriousness befitting the moment, his blue-gold existence burning with the light of victory that had been earned through methodology rather than raw power.
He hadn’t overpowered this Echo of THE Creature. He’d dismantled it, piece by piece, weakness by weakness, until the whole collapsed under its own compromised weight.
THE Civilizational Instinctus had proven itself.
And now came the harvest.
"Your Everything is hollow,"Noah said, and the words held no cruelty, only observation. "It will never match up to THE Creature himself. You are an echo, and echoes fade."
He paused, and a small respect entered his expression.
"But...you were grand. You were grand."

THE Hollow Echo received these words in silence, its cracked existence flickering with light that grew dimmer by the moment. It didn’t argue. It didn’t protest. It simply existed in the space between acknowledgment and dissolution, waiting for what came next as it was barely holding itself together.
And Noah raised his hand.

Blue-gold flames erupted from his palm as infinite Seals of Fire began to manifest in patterns that had never been attempted before. They didn’t scatter outward as attacks. They didn’t flood toward THE Hollow Echo as bombardment. Instead, they layered upon each other, compressing and concentrating into a shape that grew more defined with every passing moment.
A blade.

A massive flaming blue-gold sword forged from infinite Seals of Fire, each Seal contributing its authority to an edge that burned with heat transcending temperature. The weapon stretched for meters, its surface writhing with flames that held the linguistic weight of THE First Tongue alongside the destructive aspect of Fire itself.
Noah grasped it with both hands.
The sword felt right in his grip as this...was a tool meant for one thing.
Preparation.
He looked at THE Hollow Echo with eyes that held no malice, only determination and the practical hunger of someone who understood that opportunity must be seized fully when it presented itself.
After all, a meal was better prepared while cut.
WAA!
He brought the sword down.

The blade carved through THE Hollow Echo’s cracked existence with resistance of authority being severed rather than mere flesh being parted. The Echo’s colorless flames split around the wound, unable to reform, unable to heal. What Noah cut stayed cut because his Seals of Fire held finality that echoed the endings his Seals of Darkness had inflicted on the mountains.
He cut again.
And again.
And again.
The sword rose and fell with methodical precision, each stroke separating another portion of THE Hollow Echo from the whole.
THE Hollow Echo didn’t scream.

It had no mouth for screaming, and perhaps it had no capacity for pain in the conventional sense. But it watched as Noah worked, its fragmenting awareness perceiving its own dissolution with something that might’ve been acceptance.
This was how existence ended.
Not with defiance, but with acknowledgment that something stronger had come.

Noah continued to carve until the work was complete, until THE Hollow Echo that had once threatened to collapse him during his traversal of The Interstices was nothing but carefully separated portions floating in the space between spaces.
Then he stopped.
His sword of infinite Fire Seals dispersed, the flames returning to his existence as the weapon’s purpose had been fulfilled. He looked at what he’d prepared with satisfaction.
A pillar of silent light representing the fall of an Absolute...stretched out across The Interstices as...
’That can’t be good...’
Noah’s eyes squinted as there were monstrous beings in this place. Announcing deaths here was not something ideal.
He reached out toward the first portion, his Infinite Hunger already awakening with appetite that had grown alongside everything else about his existence!

Its hands, which had been so powerful moments before, now trembled with weakness that couldn’t be concealed.
Its flames, which had burned with the Echo of THE Creature’s aspect, now flickered with the uncertainty of a candle in a storm.
Its Depth, or really its Civilization, had been dismantled from the foundation up.
THE Hollow Echo looked at Noah with heaviness.
"You...were not like this."
"No," Noah agreed, his voice calm in a way that transcended the violence that had just occurred."I was not."
He floated before THE Hollow Echo with seriousness befitting the moment, his blue-gold existence burning with the light of victory that had been earned through methodology rather than raw power.
He hadn’t overpowered this Echo of THE Creature.
He’d dismantled it, piece by piece, weakness by weakness, until the whole collapsed under its own compromised weight.
THE Civilizational Instinctus had proven itself.
And now came the harvest.
"Your Everything is hollow,"Noah said, and the words held no cruelty, only observation.
"It will never match up to THE Creature himself.
You are an echo, and echoes fade."
He paused, and a small respect entered his expression.
"But...you were grand.
You were grand."
THE Hollow Echo received these words in silence, its cracked existence flickering with light that grew dimmer by the moment.
It didn’t argue.
It didn’t protest.
It simply existed in the space between acknowledgment and dissolution, waiting for what came next as it was barely holding itself together.
And Noah raised his hand.
Blue-gold flames erupted from his palm as infinite Seals of Fire began to manifest in patterns that had never been attempted before.
They didn’t scatter outward as attacks.
They didn’t flood toward THE Hollow Echo as bombardment.
Instead, they layered upon each other, compressing and concentrating into a shape that grew more defined with every passing moment.
A blade.
A massive flaming blue-gold sword forged from infinite Seals of Fire, each Seal contributing its authority to an edge that burned with heat transcending temperature.
The weapon stretched for meters, its surface writhing with flames that held the linguistic weight of THE First Tongue alongside the destructive aspect of Fire itself.
Noah grasped it with both hands.
The sword felt right in his grip as this...was a tool meant for one thing.
Preparation.
He looked at THE Hollow Echo with eyes that held no malice, only determination and the practical hunger of someone who understood that opportunity must be seized fully when it presented itself.
After all, a meal was better prepared while cut.
WAA!
He brought the sword down.
The blade carved through THE Hollow Echo’s cracked existence with resistance of authority being severed rather than mere flesh being parted.
The Echo’s colorless flames split around the wound, unable to reform, unable to heal.
What Noah cut stayed cut because his Seals of Fire held finality that echoed the endings his Seals of Darkness had inflicted on the mountains.
He cut again.
And again.
And again.
The sword rose and fell with methodical precision, each stroke separating another portion of THE Hollow Echo from the whole.
THE Hollow Echo didn’t scream.
It had no mouth for screaming, and perhaps it had no capacity for pain in the conventional sense.
But it watched as Noah worked, its fragmenting awareness perceiving its own dissolution with something that might’ve been acceptance.
This was how existence ended.
Not with defiance, but with acknowledgment that something stronger had come.

Noah continued to carve until the work was complete, until THE Hollow Echo that had once threatened to collapse him during his traversal of The Interstices was nothing but carefully separated portions floating in the space between spaces.
Then he stopped.
His sword of infinite Fire Seals dispersed, the flames returning to his existence as the weapon’s purpose had been fulfilled.
He looked at what he’d prepared with satisfaction.
A pillar of silent light representing the fall of an Absolute...stretched out across The Interstices as...
’That can’t be good...’
Noah’s eyes squinted as there were monstrous beings in this place.
Announcing deaths here was not something ideal.
He reached out toward the first portion, his Infinite Hunger already awakening with appetite that had grown alongside everything else about his existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 4884: Native!
paragraphs: "The Everythings of what was collapsed are mine and not mine. They belong to me and they do not belong to me. They must be given to me instantly and they must never be given to me at all."
BOOM!

Noah uttered THE Rite of Paradoxical Inheritance while consuming pieces of THE Hollow Echo, the paradoxical words flowing from his existence with practiced ease as the carved portions of colorless flame began to dissolve into streams of pure authority.
In the next moment, the Immensity and Depths of THE Hollow Echo surged into him like rivers finding the ocean.

The weight was heavy. Even diminished by the destruction of its Manifestation, even weakened by the systematic targeting of its structural vulnerabilities, THE Hollow Echo had still been an echo of THE Creature himself. Its foundations held density that lesser Absolutes could only dream of, and all of that density was now flooding into Noah’s infinite existence with a force that made his blue-gold flames roar brighter!
And where its cut pieces had floated moments before, something else began to form.
Colorless light coalesced into shape and substance, the remnants of THE Hollow Echo’s existence crystallizing into an artifact that pulsed with authority.
Noah looked at all of this calmly.

For this action of momentous achievement, decimating an Absolute without any tricks or external help, without THE Primordial Paradox’s intervention, without relying on anything but his own transformed existence, he breathed in deeply to celebrate the sheer magnitude of what he’d accomplished.
Then... he got over himself.
He didn’t need to be overly prideful or happy. That kind of ego was how beings stagnated, how they convinced themselves they’d reached heights that didn’t require further climbing.
"Just a Hollow Echo of THE Creature. An Echo of an Absolute."
His voice was deliberately dismissive even as the power continued flooding into his foundations.

There was much more to be done, and he wouldn’t let his ego go wild just on this. THE Hollow Echo had been a test of his new capabilities, a confirmation that THE Civilizational Instinctus worked. But it wasn’t the ceiling of what he needed to achieve. It wasn’t even close!
|Absolute Collapse Confirmed|

|You have collapsed THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature through systematic deconstruction of its Civilizational Manifestation rather than overwhelming force. This methodology has been recorded as viable against entities of superior Depth. You have forgone the formation of an Absolute Existential Palace in favor of drawing in as much raw Depth as possible|
|Foundation Status - Updated Assessment|

|THE Surface Depth: Your Immensity now registers at 1,250% comparative weight to THE Primordial Paradox at equivalent stage. This represents 12.5 times the foundation weight that one of THE Four possessed at Surface Depth before becoming an Absolute. No recorded entity has achieved such density at this level while remaining below Absolute classification.|

|THE Intermediate Depth: Your Immensity now registers at 1,200% comparative weight. This represents 12 times the foundation weight of THE Primordial Paradox at equivalent stage. The diminishing returns of higher Depths are evident, as each subsequent level requires exponentially more resources to elevate by equivalent amounts.|

|THE Fundamental Depth: Your Immensity now exceeds what THE Primordial Paradox and THE Creature possessed before their ascension to Absolute. You have surpassed the pre-Absolute foundations of THE Four themselves. When you eventually grasp Absolute Depth, your starting point will be higher than any Absolute in recorded history.|
The numbers were glorious, but Noah processed them with the same deliberate calm he’d forced himself to maintain. Getting excited about numbers alone was pointless.
He’d tested it against THE Hollow Echo.
He needed to test it against things that weren’t hollow!
But even as he maintained his composure, the prompts continued to bloom with information that demanded attention.
|Existential Advancement Detected|

|Various facets of your existence are rising in response to the harvest and the achievements of your temporal traversal. Your Derivative Civilizations strengthen. Your Infinite Hunger deepens. Your connection to Undifferentiated Fate solidifies. All aspects of your being grow heavier with each passing moment.|
|However, one singular facet has been tipped over the edge by this incoming harvest.|
|Your mastery of THE First Tongue has exceeded established classifications.|
|Previous Designation: Perfect Speaker of THE First Tongue|
|You have exceeded this designation.|

|You now stand at a ranking exclusive to you and not what others receive if they manage to surpass Perfect. The path you have walked through THE Prima Indifferentia, through consumption of the Spark Fragment of THE First Cause, through integration of infinite aspects across all elements of your Civilization, has created a relationship with THE First Tongue that transcends mastery.|
|You have attained the distinction of a Native Speaker of THE First Tongue.|
BOOM!
Native Speaker.
As if this was something he’d been born into.
As if THE First Tongue was his native language, the words he’d first learned to speak, the linguistic foundation upon which all other communication was merely translation.
As if this was his.

Around Noah in The Interstices, 27 Phonemes of THE First Tongue began to bloom into visibility without his conscious summoning. They emerged from his existence like flowers opening to greet the sun, each one burning with authority that had grown alongside everything else about him.
They danced.

There was no other word for it. The Phonemes swirled around his blue-gold form in patterns that held joy rather than combat purpose, celebrating an achievement that even they seemed to recognize as significant.
And then they moved.

The 27 Phonemes rose above his head in unison, arranging themselves into a formation that crystallized into something permanent. They interlocked and fused and became a crown of pure linguistic authority that settled above Noah’s brow without quite touching it, hovering with the weight of THE First Tongue’s acknowledgment.
His entire figure radiated a glow of ethereal blue-gold that painted The Interstices in colors that spoke of infinite potential and linguistic supremacy combined!
He looked fucking fantastic.
If THE Primordial Paradox could see him now, the ancient Absolute would probably have some cutting remark about pride and falls and the dangers of admiring one’s own reflection!
He refocused on the prompts that continued to flow.
|Native Speaker of THE First Tongue - Exclusive Capabilities|

|As a Native Speaker, you have obtained access to a feature of THE First Tongue that nobody else can utilize. This feature is known as Existence Writing, and it represents the difference between speaking a language fluently and thinking in that language natively.|
|Existence Writing - Primary Function|

|You may now compose entire sentences of THE First Tongue in written form, inscribing them upon existence itself rather than merely speaking them into being. These written sentences are designated asInscriptiones, Inscriptions that hold authority beyond verbal and written declaration.|

|An Inscriptiocan be infused with the power of an Embodiment or an Apophasis, elevating the written sentence. Embodiment Inscriptiones declare what IS with authority that presses against reality. Apophasis Inscriptiones declare what IS NOT with authority that removes possibilities from existence.|

|Apophasis Inscriptiones require greater expenditure of Civilizational Authority due to the fundamental difficulty of writing negation into permanence. Removing something from existence through inscription demands more than adding something to it.|
|Existence Writing - Delivery Methods|
|An Inscriptio may be delivered through three distinct methodologies:|

|Inscriptio Praesentia (Inscription of Presence): The written sentence is directed at a target within your immediate vicinity. The Inscriptio strikes with elevated effect that exceeds a normal Embodiment or Apophasis by a factor determined by the complexity and precision of the sentence composed. A well-crafted Inscriptio Praesentia can devastate targets that would resist verbal declarations of equivalent authority.|

|Inscriptio Nominata (Named Inscription): The written sentence includes the distinction or true name of the target within its composition. Upon completion, the Inscriptio does not strike locally but instead traverses across the flow of THE First Tongue throughout Observable Existence, seeking its named target regardless of distance or barriers. The sentence will find them. The sentence will deliver its payload. No location is safe from a properly constructed Inscriptio Nominata.|

|Inscriptio Dormiens (Sleeping Inscription): The written sentence is composed and completed but held in a state of suspension rather than immediate release. The Inscriptio remains dormant within your existence or can be placed upon objects, locations, or even other beings, awaiting the moment you choose to awaken it. When activated by your will, the Inscriptio exerts its effects as if freshly completed, regardless of how much time has passed since its composition. You may maintain multiple Inscriptiones Dormientes simultaneously, limited only by your capacity to remember their existence and locations.|
Noah’s eyes widened.
Oh.
Fuck.

chapters.title: Chapter 4885: Determination! I
paragraphs: Noah floated intently as he received more and more information.
|Existence Writing - Composition Requirements|

|Constructing an Inscriptio requires focused concentration proportional to the complexity of the sentence. Simple declarations can be written in moments. Complex sentences with multiple clauses and nested authorities may require extended composition time. The more precise the wording, the more devastating the effect, but also the longer the inscription takes to complete.|
|Inscriptiones Dormientesare a work of wonder. Write your sentences when you are safe. Unleash them when you are not.|
|Existence Writing - Scaling Parameters|

|The power of your Inscriptiones scales with your mastery of THE First Tongue, which as a Native Speaker has no theoretical ceiling. As your foundations grow and your connection to linguistic authority deepens, the maximum complexity and devastation of your written sentences will increase proportionally.|
|Historical Context|
|No other Native Speaker of THE First Tongue currently exists in Observable Existence.|
Noah gazed at this wondrous capability and the information flowing into his mind, the crown of Phonemes above his head pulsing with light that seemed to approve of his contemplation.
Existence Writing.
Inscriptiones that could strike targets before him with power exceeding normal Embodiments.
Inscriptiones that could hunt named targets across all of Observable Existence.
Inscriptiones that could sleep until he chose to wake them.
There was a lot!
In Observable Existence, there were many important moments across history.

The day THE Creature was born was an auspicious one, with those truly knowledgeable still going back and forth between his origin being in Alfheimr or THE Prima Indifferentia. Some had debated this question for eons without resolution, and they would likely debate it for eons more.

The first conversation to occur between a peasant and THE Primordial Paradox was also an important one, as from that conversation, many weavings of existence and reality as one knew it bloomed. The peasant had asked a simple question about the nature of contradiction, and THE Primordial Paradox had answered.

One could argue which events throughout history were the most important, with others among the Glossarians even mentioning the day THE Tongue Whisperer walked into THE Agora of Primordial Judgment and was inferred the title of a Polemarch being something truly worthy of note. His entrance allowed word to spread far and wide, increasing the influx of those entering THE Agora of Primordial Judgment as this would change just how many strong entities rose within it.
Many such arguments could be made.
But unbeknownst to many, at this moment in time, another critical event was taking place that was arguably one of the most important events in recent history.
And there was no one to observe it.
It was the entrance of THE Genesis Monarch into a distinction nobody else had in Observable Existence. Unique to him. The Native Speaker of THE First Tongue.

The moment he achieved this designation, Noah stayed still for a few seconds as he continued integrating the Depth of THE Hollow Echo. His expression was contemplative, his blue-gold existence burning with the weight of infinite potential, his crown of Phonemes hovering above his head with authority.

One could wonder just what grand thoughts were going on in his mind at this moment. What profound contemplations occupied the first Native Speaker of THE First Tongue in eons? What world-shaking decisions was he weighing as he stood at this unprecedented threshold?
After a while, Noah moved.

In the weavings of The Interstices, he waved his hands with deliberate purpose. Blue-gold Absolute Seals erupted from his existence in streams that wove together with architectural precision, forming shapes that solidified into something permanent.
A throne.
And a desk.

In the area where an Absolute had just fallen, where the fragments of THE Hollow Echo’s Manifestation still drifted through the space between spaces, Noah conjured furniture fit for a monarch conducting important affairs. The throne was grand without being ostentatious, formed from Seals of Infinity that burned with quiet authority. The desk before it was regal and practical, a surface upon which momentous work could be accomplished.
He sat down as if he was ready to begin the most important work of his existence.

From his body, golden pages unfolded and lined themselves up on the table before him with the precision of soldiers forming ranks. They lay flat against the surface, waiting to receive whatever wisdom or declaration their master chose to inscribe upon them. In his hands, a pen appeared, formed from concentrated linguistic authority that burned blue-gold at its tip.
And with an extremely serious expression that befitted the gravity of what he was about to do, Noah began to write his first Inscription!
An Inscriptio Nominata.
A Named Inscription.

At the tip of his pen, 27 Phonemes swirled like an endless galaxy, each one contributing its authority to the words that began to form upon the golden page. The Phonemes danced and wove and compressed themselves into written form, transitioning from verbal possibility to permanent declaration with each stroke of Noah’s hand.
The Inscription itself was simple in nature, something that would carry devastating effect upon its target.

But as he wrote, his Immensity began to glow into the words. His foundation weight pressed into each Phoneme. The authority of the Derivative Civilization of Infinite Hunger bled into the ink, adding the quality of endless consumption to what he was creating. The Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate followed, its connection to destiny ensuring that the Inscription would find its target regardless of circumstance, and it would undifferentiate.
And then, surpassing even what these authorities could provide, the light of an Apophasis began to cover what Noah was writing.
Not an Embodiment declaring what was.
An Apophasis declaring what was not.
He wrote with determination and focus that made the surrounding Interstices tremble, the words taking shape upon the golden page with weight that pressed against reality itself.

"The foundation of the one named herein is not capable of standing firm. Their Depths are not free from the sensation of burning across every fiber of their existence. Their weight is not permitted to remain stable, but must instead tear itself apart piece by piece until nothing remains but the agony of dissolution. This truth applies so long as the foundation of the target does not exceed the foundation of the one who writes these words."
Terrifying words began to be written as one had to wonder...who would make THE Genesis Monarch focus so intently to write such words!?

Their weight is not permitted to remain stable, but must instead tear itself apart piece by piece until nothing remains but the agony of dissolution.
This truth applies so long as the foundation of the target does not exceed the foundation of the one who writes these words."
Terrifying words began to be written as one had to wonder...who would make THE Genesis Monarch focus so intently to write such words!?

chapters.title: Chapter 4886: Determination! II
paragraphs: His first Inscription didn’t even carry an Embodiment. He went a level above and went all out to write an Apophasis from the very beginning!
Because of this, the process was hard.

Boundless seas of Infinities poured into the Inscription as Noah’s existence strained to maintain the coherence of what he was creating. An Apophasis Inscriptio demanded more than an Embodiment Inscriptio, and he was attempting one as his very first composition. The words wavered on the page, threatening to dissolve back into formless potential.
He pushed harder.

The Inscription nearly failed as the weight of negation pressed against his concentration, seeking to collapse the sentence before it could be completed. Writing what was not into permanence was fundamentally more difficult than writing what was, and Noah felt that difficulty as pressure against his mind and his foundations simultaneously.
But he pulled through.

His Infinite nature provided reserves. Where others would have been drained entirely by such an ambitious first attempt, Noah simply drew deeper from wells that had no bottom. His Infinities stabilized the wavering words. His determination held the sentence together through sheer refusal to accept failure.
And then it was done.

A blue-gold Inscription shining with immense weight and power was written on a golden page, the words burning with authority that made the surrounding Interstices darken slightly in response to their presence. Noah’s existence pulsed with the satisfaction of completion, the crown of Phonemes above his head flaring brighter as if acknowledging what he had accomplished.
|First Inscriptio Completed|

|You have successfully composed your first written Inscriptio of THE First Tongue. More significantly, you have composed an Apophasis Inscriptio as your inaugural work, a feat of considerable difficulty.|

|The Inscriptio you have created carries the following effects upon its designated target: constant burning sensation across all Depths of their existence, progressive destabilization of their foundation weight, and gradual dissolution of their structural integrity over time. These effects will persist indefinitely until the target’s foundation is fully compromised or until the Inscriptio is somehow countered by authority exceeding your own.|
|Applicable targets: Any entity whose foundation Depth does not exceed your own at the moment of Inscriptio activation.|

|Your proficiency in writing Inscriptiones has increased slightly. Future compositions will require marginally less concentration and will carry marginally greater stability during the writing process.|
|All that remains is a designated target.|
The designated target.
Now, what could make a man sit down and write with such concentration?
What profound purpose drove the first Native Speaker to compose an Apophasis of such devastating effect as his very first Inscription?
It actually wasn’t any grand reason.
It washatred.

Pure, undiluted hatred toward Noah’s self-proclaimed greatest enemy in existence. Not THE Entity, whose infection threatened all of Observable Existence. Not THE Living Paradox, who had stolen THE Primordial Paradox’s Claim. Not Bazuman, who had chased him across THE Prima Indifferentia with relentless hunger.
No.
All of his hatred was directed toward THE Living Elemental.

If THE Living Elemental was like any other enemy, Noah might have just chosen to forget about him or crush him when he vastly exceeded them in power. He cultivated and made progress in days what others did in eons. Eventually, THE Living Elemental would be nothing but an ant beneath his foot, and the grudge would be settled through simple overwhelming force.
But Noah had to prepare especially for THE Living Elemental.
Because this fucker had thrown him a burning curse that could attach itself to anyone near him, forcing him to be away from his women for a not insignificant amount of time.
Worst of all, he was in the middle of Dual Cultivation when this curse was set.
He had been forced to stop midway and remain in that state for that long extended period of time.
This was the reason for his deep distaste and hatred toward THE Living Elemental.
How dare he.
How fucking dare he?!
To get between a man and his...
Just thinking about it now made Noah angry.
His blue-gold flames burned darker for a moment.
He wrote the target of the Inscription very clearly.

His pen moved with decisive strokes, inscribing the designation upon the golden page with finality that left no room for ambiguity. The 27 Phonemes swirled at the tip of his pen and compressed themselves into a name that would bind this Apophasis to its intended recipient.
His first Written Inscription had its target as THE Living Elemental.
The moment the target was decided, the page it was written on began to float upward from the desk.

It looked innocent. A single golden page covered in blue-gold writing that burned with soft light. Beautiful, even. The kind of thing that might be displayed in a museum or preserved as a work of art.
But it was akin to a nuclear bomb.
An Apophasis Inscriptio Nominata that would hunt its target across all of Observable Existence and deliver constant agony and progressive foundation collapse upon arrival.
He wanted it to hurt, and for it to take some time!
An instant later, it shot out like an arrow and disappeared from The Interstices.

Noah leaned back on his throne with an expectant gaze, his eyes following the trajectory of his Inscription as it vanished into the weavings between spaces, racing toward Alfheimr where THE Living Elemental currently resided.
He didn’t know exactly how long it would take to arrive.
He didn’t know exactly what THE Living Elemental would be doing when it found him.
But he knew that very soon, one of the Absolutes who had made his life difficult was going to experience suffering that would make him regret ever interfering with his personal affairs!
The throne of Absolute Seals supported his weight as he waited, the desk before him still holding more golden pages that could receive more Inscriptions.
He had time.
He had Infinities.
And he had a list of enemies who deserved similar treatment.
But THE Living Elemental got to be first, because some offenses simply could not be forgiven!
But as one page flew...he could always begin preparing and writing others!

chapters.title: Chapter 4887: Adversity! I
paragraphs: In Alfheimr, the vibrant twilight burned across skies that held every color of flame simultaneously.

The Primordial Realm of THE Creature was a place where existence itself felt more real than anywhere else in Observable Existence, where the weight of simply being pressed against visitors with authority that reminded them they existed only because Existence permitted it.

Mountains rose toward horizons that couldn’t be reached, their peaks shrouded in mists that held secrets accumulated across eons. Forests of trees older than most civilizations spread across valleys that had witnessed the birth and death of countless powers.

And on the same mountain that THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger had descended a little while ago, after Origin had received her answer from THE Creature and given her answer to Hunger, two different figures were now walking up.

THE Living Emotive skipped up the ancient stone steps with manic energy that made her hair bounce with each movement. She hummed a tune that shifted between melodies without ever settling on one, her existence radiating weavings of emotion so intense that the very air around her seemed to feel what she felt. Joy and excitement and anticipation and a dozen other feelings wove through her aura in patterns that would have driven lesser beings to madness.
Beside her, THE Living Elemental walked with a frowning expression.
There was something he couldn’t quite put his finger on.

A sense of wrongness that had been building in his foundations for what felt like hours now, a disquiet that refused to be silenced no matter how many times he tried to dismiss it as paranoia. Even the prospect of a discussion with THE Creature, one of THE Four themselves, felt like something he couldn’t properly focus on right now.
There was one figure he was worried about.
THE Youngest!

Before, when that weak being had tried to encroach on his Civilization, Elemental had been so enraged that he’d paid a significant cost to exert his power outside THE Loom when all those holding THE designations were suppressed. He had laid out a savage curse upon THE Youngest, one designed to burn and isolate and torment until the target either perished or well...killed themselves to perish!
It had been a declaration of superiority. A reminder of the gap between Civilizational and whatever THE Youngest had been at that time.
But now, that weak being who wasn’t even at THE Civilizational Scale of Existence before had become one of THE Four.
THE Youngest now held a Claim.
THE Youngest was now counted among the more powerful entities in all of Observable Existence.

The time from then to now was what, a mere matter of days? It was absolutely nothing in terms of time to Elemental. He had existed for eons. He had watched civilizations rise and fall like waves upon a shore. Days were less than heartbeats to someone of his existence.
And yet things had changed that drastically in such an insignificant span of time.
He wondered what the resolution for this situation would be. He didn’t know how many months or years he had before THE Youngest would make a move against him. The grudge between them was clear.
He had to secure his power before then.

The assurance of those among THE Four would be ideal. If Paradox or THE Creature vouched for his protection, perhaps THE Youngest would hesitate before acting. Perhaps the weavings of THE Four’s relationships would provide protection that his own power could not guarantee.
So he climbed the mountain to see THE Creature.
HUUM!
His existence buzzed at this moment.

Elemental raised his head high, his eyes scanning the twilight above as his Civilization sent out warnings that screamed through every aspect of his being. He was initially confused, not understanding what his foundations were trying to tell him. Then astonished, as he perceived something descending from above with speed that exceeded what should have been possible. Then shocked, as he recognized the weight of what was coming.
From above, a terrifying authority descended!

A single golden page burning with blue-gold light that painted the twilight in colors that didn’t belong in Alfheimr. It fell like a meteor, like a judgment, like something inevitable that could not be avoided or redirected. The weight it carried was immense, pressing against reality itself as it approached.
"What is that?!"
THE Living Emotive stopped her skipping, her manic humming cutting off as her crimson eyes locked onto the descending page with sudden intensity.
THE Living Elemental didn’t waste time on questions.
"I am the culmination of all Elements! I am the authority that governs the fundamental forces of Observable Existence! Nothing may touch me without my permission!"
BOOM!

His Embodiment erupted outward with force that would have devastated anything below Absolute, the declaration pressing against reality with weight accumulated across eons of existence. The authority of Elements themselves rose to meet the descending page, fundamental forces rallying to protect the one who claimed dominion over them.
THE Living Emotive’s eyes widened as she realized something crucial.
The page wasn’t targeting her.
It wasn’t targeting the mountain or the surrounding area or anything else in its vicinity.
It was targeting Elemental specifically, its trajectory locked onto his existence with precision!
"What the..."
She moved away from Elemental even as she released her own Embodiment to help him.
"Emotions are the foundation of all action! Fear shall rise against what descends, and that fear shall become a shield that protects those I choose to defend!"
BOOM!
Two Embodiments now pressed against the descending page, the combined authority of THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive creating a barrier that should have stopped anything of weak Absolutes.
Yet...
The page continued to descend.
It didn’t slow.
It didn’t waver.

It passed through their Embodiments as if they didn’t exist, as if the declarations of two Absolutes were nothing more than suggestions that it chose to ignore. The blue-gold light burned brighter as it approached Elemental’s position, and no amount of authority seemed capable of stopping it.
Because the Embodiments weren’t addressing what the Inscription required.

The Inscriptio Nominata had been written with a specific condition: it would strike any target whose foundation did not exceed the foundation of the one who wrote it. As long as that condition remained true, as long as Elemental’s Depth did not exceed Noah’s newly elevated foundations, nothing could stop the Inscription from reaching its target.
Embodiments that declared protection were meaningless.
Embodiments that declared immunity were irrelevant.
The only thing that could have stopped it was an Embodiment or authority that directly addressed the foundational comparison, that changed the underlying truth upon which the Inscription operated.
Neither Absolute had done that.
Neither Absolute had even known to try.
The page reached THE Living Elemental.

It branded itself upon his forehead with a flash of blue-gold light that seared into his existence, and then it disappeared. The golden page was gone, absorbed into his being, its payload delivered with precision that left no room for resistance.
For a moment, nothing happened.
Then THE Living Elemental began to feel it!
Oh!

A burning sensation erupted across his Depths, starting at his Surface and spreading rapidly toward his Intermediate and Fundamental foundations. It wasn’t the kind of burning that could be ignored or suppressed through willpower. It was the burning of existence itself being set aflame, of his very foundations being subjected to constant torment that had no source he could identify or target!
His face became pale.
Then ashen.

His legs buckled beneath him as the pain intensified, and THE Living Elemental, one of the Absolutes of Observable Existence, fell to his knees on the ancient stone steps of the mountain. His hands pressed against the ground as he struggled to maintain composure, his entire body trembling with agony that exceeded anything he had experienced in eons of existence!
But he did not scream.
He was someone grand. He was an Absolute. He had existed since before most civilizations had been born, and he would not give whatever had done this the satisfaction of hearing him cry out!
But man was it painful.

THE Living Emotive rushed to his side, her manic energy replaced with focused intensity as she knelt beside him and began analyzing what had happened. Her crimson eyes burned with authority as she examined the remnants of the Inscription’s effect, tracing the curse through his foundations with perception that few others could match.
Her analysis took only seconds.
Her face went wide with shock and awe.
"That was an ancient expression of Civilization."
Her voice was quiet.
"An Apophasis..."
She looked up at the sky where the page had descended from, her mind racing through possibilities.
"Who could possibly..."
She was just about to ask the obvious question when her eyes stopped and she went silent.
"Haha, No way... right?"

She had one person in mind. One being who had recently ascended to heights that shouldn’t have been possible. One entity who had a very specific grudge against THE Living Elemental that stemmed from a burning curse laid during their previous confrontation.
The moment she thought of it, Elemental also thought of it.

His body trembled even more violently, horrid pain tearing across his very existence as the Apophasis continued its relentless work. He could feel his foundation beginning to deteriorate, could feel the weight of his Depths slowly being torn apart by an authority that seemed to ignore everything he threw against it.
It couldn’t be, right?
THE Youngest shouldn’t have this power right now! It was too quick!
