paragraphs: Not many beings knew, but in THE Infinite Unfurling, before THE Primordial Paradox even took on a student that was a peasant, he stood beside a young woman who called herself Eon.

This woman was being hunted by many in thePrimordial Realm of Svartalfheim. Her crimes were unclear, her origins unknown, but those who pursued her did so with the fervor of beings who believed they were performing a righteous duty. She had been running for what felt like centuries, never staying in one place long enough to call it home.

She had met THE Primordial Paradox while she was running away, stumbling upon him in a valley that should not have existed, a place that was both sanctuary and trap simultaneously. Her eyes had been wild with exhaustion and fear and something else entirely, something that looked almost like hunger for answers that no one had been willing to provide. She stayed with him as he didn’t shoo her away, eventually becoming a little familar.
She had asked him a question that would echo across eons.
"How...can I be as strong as you? How can I go across existence fearlessly, without worry?"
THE Primordial Paradox had looked at this young woman with eyes that held the weight of contradiction itself. And he had answered her.

"Strength is a paradox unto itself. The beings who pursue strength most desperately are often the ones who never attain it, while those who pursue other things entirely find strength arriving as an unexpected companion. You ask how to be fearless, but fearlessness is not the absence of fear. It is the presence of something greater than fear. Purpose. Conviction. Understanding of what you are and why you are it."

"Existence will test you in ways you cannot anticipate. It will offer you power in exchange for pieces of yourself. It will present shortcuts that seem efficient but lead to dead ends that span eternities. It will show you reflections of what you could become if only you were willing to compromise on what you currently are. These are the traps that fell even the grandest beings across Observable Existence."

"My advice to you is simple in its statement and impossible in its execution. Stay true to yourself, regardless of what happens. Never lose what makes you... you. Your identity is the only anchor that remains constant when everything else shifts and changes and transforms around you. Abandon that anchor, and you will drift across existence without direction, becoming whatever the currents wish you to become rather than what you chose to become."

"As long as you hold onto that truth, as long as you remember who you are when existence tries to convince you to be something else, then existence is yours. Not because you conquered it, but because you remained unconquered by it. That is the paradox of strength. It is not found in domination but in persistence. It is not found in power...but in principle."
At this moment.
It was not a memory, as existence was unfolding in real time. In a terrifying unfolding of events within THE Stoa of Dogmata, THE Primordial Paradox looked at THE Secretive Eon as he spoke calmly.
"Eon, are you in there?"
His voice held weight that pressed against the converted Embodiments and Apophasis surrounding them, against THE Entity that wore the face of someone he had once counseled.
"I always told you to stay true to yourself, no matter what happened. So how did you allow this to happen?"
His questions were booming and heavy, echoing across the space with authority that demanded response from whatever remnant of the original Eon might still exist beneath the infection.

A moment later, it almost seemed like the gaze of THE Secretive Eon flickered. It almost seemed like something stirred beneath the surface of those eyes that had been speaking with THE Entity’s voice. As if whatever was buried underneath had been trying to come up to the surface, trying to reach toward the being who had once given her advice that she had clearly not followed!
But it faded away just as quickly.

The flicker of recognition, of individuality, of the Eon that had existed before THE Entity consumed her identity... it vanished back into the depths of collective consciousness that now ruled her form.

THE Primordial Paradox looked at the scene and shook his head with disappointment. He sighed with the weariness of someone who had watched countless beings fail to heed wisdom that could have saved them.
"I came to test things out and see the extent of how far you’ve grown. You cannot possibly stop me from leaving, as we...were paradoxically here and never here."

The eyes of THE Secretive Eon became somber as understanding dawned across her features. She raised her hand, authority gathering around her fingers as she prepared to do something, to prevent their departure, to trap them within THE Stoa of Dogmata where her converted constructs could eventually wear down even their defenses.
But before she could do anything...
WAP!

The figures of Noah and THE Primordial Paradox disappeared as if truly they may have never been there to begin with. Paradoxically! Their presence and absence existed simultaneously, and THE Entity could not trap what had never definitively arrived.

Even the terrifying sea of Paradox that she had commandeered tried to fade away alongside its creator’s departure, but this one she had already gained control of. After a brief moment of flickering between existence and non-existence, it stayed, becoming a permanent addition to her arsenal rather than a temporary manifestation.
And while surrounded by glory and Immensity that had just grown through THE Primordial Paradox’s inadvertent contribution, THE Secretive Eon turned her head slowly.
She looked toward the direction of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment with eyes that held patience accumulated across eons.
She could wait.
She had always been good at waiting.
And even while she waited, many parts of her moved.

Noah returned to THE Shores of Kleos inside THE Agora of Primordial Judgment with THE Primordial Paradox beside him, his expression still holding the frown that had formed during their encounter with THE Entity.
First he needed to let THE Primordial Chaos know not to send any bombardment of attacks toward THE Secretive Eon, as they could very well be absorbed and simply turned against them.
And when he thought about this monstrous entity themselves, about the implications of what they had witnessed and what it meant for any future confrontation... he turned to THE Primordial Paradox.
"Tell me there is some form of solution that you had after being partly taken over by that thing all those eons ago."

THE Primordial Paradox turned to him as it seemed like he was thinking of something else, distant thoughts occupying his mind before Noah’s words broke his concentration. He looked at Noah and nodded calmly as he began to speak.

"The solution actually lies with my disciple. After all, Erwin knows the exact origins of THE Entity. He knows how he utilized it to achieve his ends. He knows how he took over my Claim with it and yet kept it at bay when it should have consumed him as thoroughly as it consumed Eon. And he knows why it has emerged now, after all these eons of remaining dormant."
He paused.

"The first answer to taking care of THE Entity lies within THE Living Paradox. We extract that knowledge from him, willingly or otherwise, and we gain understanding that no one else in Observable Existence currently possesses. Easy, yes?"
His smile was thin and knowing.
"Of course, extracting anything from my disciple will require subduing him first. So while this remains the most direct path to understanding our enemy, it is not a path we can walk immediately."
THE Primordial Paradox continued, his voice shifting to something more contemplative.

"The nature of the problem we face here is a unique one. Collapsing THE Entity does not work. I learned this the hard way. Undifferentiating THE Entity may not work either, as undifferentiation is already its fundamental nature. It exists as a force of existential homogenization, and returning it to proto-state may simply be returning it to its preferred form of being. Conventional methodologies fail because this is not a conventional threat."
He began to pace slowly.

"This brings us to the second possible answer against THE Entity. I have spent considerable time contemplating unconventional solutions, turning the problem over in my mind across eons of imprisonment within THE Antinomia Prismatica. And the one that has won... is THE Existential Severance."
His voice grew heavier.

"The principle is elegant in its cruelty. Destruction removes a being from existence. Undifferentiation returns a being to formlessness. But THE Existential Severance does neither. It allows the being to remain exactly as they are, conscious and aware and present. What it removes is everything else. Their Definition and Undefinition. Their Existence as a significant entity. Their Depth. Their achievements. Their accomplishments. Every single thing they have ever done that distinguished them from absolute insignificance."

"Existence itself forgets that they ever mattered. The record of their significance is erased so completely that reality no longer acknowledges they were ever anything but nothing. Everything in Observable Existence would even forget about them, or whether they even existed at all."
His eyes met Noah’s.

"The being persists, you understand. They continue to exist. They continue to think. They continue to have awareness of themselves and their surroundings. But they possess no authority whatsoever. No Definition or Undefinition. No Civilization. No foundation. No weight. They become entities of pure presence without any capacity to affect anything around them. Less than the weakest mortal, because even the weakest mortal has potential for growth. Those who have been subjected to THE Existential Severance have had their potential erased alongside everything else."

"And everything that the target possessed, everything they accomplished, everything they represented and built across their entire existence... it does not simply disappear. It transfers. It flows to the one who performed THE Existential Severance upon them. Their eons of accumulation become fuel for another’s advancement. Their foundations become stones in another’s edifice. Their authority becomes another’s authority."
He spread his hands.

"The only thing negative about this is that this capability requires proximity to THE Second Scale of Existence, or attaining that Scale yourself. Among those currently in Observable Existence... hmm, maybe THE Creature may be able to do it."

The words were ridiculous in their implications, presenting a solution that was simultaneously perfect and currently impossible to execute. Noah opened his mouth to respond, to ask more questions about this capability and what it would take to develop it, but before he could reply...
"Sir... sirs!"

The figure of Paradoxos appeared in the distance, his massive dual-faced form rushing toward them. His gaze seemed ashen as he came to float meters away from them, his earlier submission to THE Primordial Paradox seemingly forgotten in the face of whatever had driven him to seek them out.
"Something is happening to the Crack of Observable Existence. Something is happening with THE Prima Indifferentia!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4899: The Second Cause I
paragraphs: Something was happening to the Crack of Observable Existence in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment. Something was happening to THE Prima Indifferentia.

This alone by itself was astounding enough as it made Noah and THE Primordial Paradox frown before they moved with Paradoxos. The three of them traversed THE Agora with speed that made the space between locations meaningless, racing toward the region where THE Acropolis held the ancient fracture that connected Observable Existence to what lay beyond it.

It was a change, and like any changes, sometimes they occurred across existence without warning or explanation. But changes involving THE Prima Indifferentia were never minor, and changes involving Cracks of Observable Existence were never safe.
In THE Wastes of THE Fallout, another body of Noah was with THE Fisherman, Ains, and his very good dog, Skoll, as he had been discussing a few things with THE Great Usurper.

Eckert had a very complex expression as if he had developed a unique skill for himself and another person now seemed to be using the same skill and utilizing it so much more complexly and better than he was. He looked like a man in his prime, similar to Noah, even though the memories and ages of countless things whose existences he had usurped flowed within his eyes. The weight of accumulated identities pressed against his features as he processed everything Noah had shared about THE Entity and its potential origins.
But eventually, after learning all he could from Noah regarding THE Entity and its capabilities, he said something that surprised Noah.
He leaned forward with eyes that held the cunning of someone who had survived by understanding how predators thought.

"My greatest fear has always been that I would one day attempt to usurp the mind of something utterly terrifying that I did not understand. Something that, upon feeling my connection establish itself, would choose to self-destruct rather than be taken. Something capable enough to recognize what was happening and destroy both itself and me through the very link I had created to consume it. The connection that allows me to devour works in both directions, you see. What I reach toward can reach back toward me."
His smile was thin and knowing.

"If you trust yourself enough, if your Infinities are truly as protective as you believe them to be, then a potential solution presents itself. Allow yourself to be infected by THE Entity. Establish that connection deliberately rather than accidentally. And then, once the link exists, destroy it from within. Your Infinite nature should prevent the infection from actually taking hold, but the connection would still exist. You would be inside it while it failed to get inside you. From that position, what could you not accomplish? What vulnerabilities could you not identify? What weaknesses could you not exploit?"
He spread his hands.

"This is merely a thought from someone who has spent his existence understanding how connections between minds can be manipulated. THE Entity believes its infection is a one-way process, but no process is truly one-way. Every link carries traffic in both directions, even if one direction carries more than the other. If you can establish a connection without being consumed by it, you gain access to everything THE Entity is while it gains access to nothing that you are. The hunter becomes the hunted without ever realizing the reversal has occurred."
This was a proposed solution given by THE Great Usurper, and Noah couldn’t help but frown at the audacity of it. Deliberately allowing THE Entity to infect him was...well, it was something!
And yet the logic was sound in its own twisted way.
But at this time...
"Woof!"
Skoll’s tail began to wag as he looked around with ears perked and eyes alert, as if there was something he sensed that nobody else could perceive.
In the next moment...
BOOM!
It felt like existence split in half!

THE Great Usurper’s face became ashen as he felt something happening in the distant region where his existence had come from, where he had already covered his idle existence over the landscapes of THE Wastes where the Axiom he had fused into remained.

In that distant region, a terrifying crack formed in the fabric of reality itself. The fracture tore through space like a wound that refused to close, its edges burning with light that belonged to no part of Observable Existence. And from within that crack, roiling and billowing seas of proto-matter began to churn with violence that exceeded anything THE Wastes had witnessed before!

The proto-matter spilled out across THE Wastes like an ocean breaching a dam, undifferentiated potential flooding into differentiated reality with force that began dissolving everything it touched. THE Great Usurper’s territories, the landscapes he had claimed and converted into extensions of his existence, started coming apart at the seams.

Instantly, THE Great Usurper’s body began to dissolve as the proto-matter reached across his connections and started pulling him back toward the source of his power. He gasped with shock, his form flickering between stability and dissolution!
Noah moved right away.

His hand erupted with a light of Infinities and undifferentiation that proceeded to wrap around THE Great Usurper with protective force that rejected the proto-matter’s assault. Vibrant Absolute Seals released from him as they also wrapped around Ains and Skoll, creating bubbles of defined existence that the flooding undifferentiation couldn’t penetrate!
Change...was happening in many places.

Across THE Wastes in an entirely different direction, there was the silent and small miniaturized Infiniverse itself, which now housed a complete Primordial Realm within its structure. Muspelheim burned at the heart of Noah’s domain, its crimson-blue stellar fires fueling growth that exceeded what any territories could achieve.
At the very center of this grand home of THE Genesis Monarch, a humanoid manifestation of THE Infiniverse was floating in a terrifying region of utmost Immensity and glory.

This region held extremely concentrated and pure Civilizational Authority that would have crushed any being who entered without Noah’s explicit blessing. Boundless seas of Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue permeated all around, mixing with each other in configurations that produced multicolored light spanning every spectrum that existence could perceive. The Seals of Fire wove through Seals of Darkness, which intertwined with Seals of Chaos, which merged with Seals of Unity, creating patterns of authority so dense that space itself bent around them.
The only other being in existence who enjoyed the allure of Noah’s Infinities was THE Infiniverse herself.

This arguably made her one of the most important beings in Observable Existence, even if she forever planned to remain in the shadow of her master. Because without her master, she was nothing. She would still be that floating landmass in the Beast World, a territory without purpose, a domain without direction.
But with him, she was becoming something unprecedented.

In this domain of extremely concentrated weavings of existence, in the hands of THE Infiniverse, there was a budding singularity that blazed with the light of proto-matter and undifferentiation. She was currently filling it with the lights of Noah’s Infinities, variations of THE First Tongue permeating all around it as she carefully shaped something that had never been attempted before.

She wanted to form something significant for her master. Something similar to THE Prima Indifferentia but born from his authority rather than the ancient chaos that predated Observable Existence. And as many people as there were who truly did not understand the terrifying true potential and capability that she held, she alone was enough to understand what she was capable of.
Her immediate goal was something simple for her, something that she termedOperation Infinite Observable Existence.
And she was not referring to the Observable Existence that everyone knew when she planned this operation.
So she was proceeding carefully, layer by layer, Seal by Seal, when in the next moment...
BOOM!

Near the singularity filled with proto-matter, a terrifying crack bloomed as if reality was being torn as if it were a page! The fracture expanded with speed that exceeded what should have been possible within the protected confines of THE Infiniverse, its edges burning with corruption.

From this expanding crack, unstable seas of proto-matter filled with a sense of corruption flooded out with force that threatened to overwhelm everything she had been building. This wasn’t the pure proto-matter of THE Prima Indifferentia. This was something tainted, something that carried the signature of THE Fallout within its undifferentiated depths!
THE Infiniverse frowned and bellowed out!
"YAAA!"

Her shout was filled with majesty and undeniability shockingly holding the weight of an Embodiment, the full weight of her existence as the domain of THE Genesis Monarch pressing against the invasion with authority that refused to be overwhelmed!
The terrifying scenes that threatened to spill out across all of THE Infiniverse instantly became contained, caught by barriers that she manifested with speed born of glory and determination.

And then, with control that exceeded what the attacker had anticipated, she began funneling the corrupted proto-matter into the singularity she had been building this whole time. If they wanted to send her undifferentiation, she would take it. She would add it to her project. She would turn their attack into fuel for her master’s advancement.
Change was blooming here as well.
In Alfheimr, above a certain mountain where THE Creature resided, a crack tore through the twilight with violence that made the Primordial Realm itself tremble.
In Helheim, fractures bloomed across the frozen landscapes like wounds that bled proto-matter rather than blood.
In Vanaheimr, the realm of nature and growth, cracks formed among the ancient forests with corruption that began dissolving trees that had existed since THE Infinite Unfurling.
In the space where Muspelheim used to be, before THE Infiniverse absorbed it entirely, reality simply shattered as proto-matter flooded the void with purpose that transcended natural disaster.

In many Primordial Realms hidden from Observable Existence, in THE Wandering Territories that drifted between defined spaces, in corrupted Folds that had already been touched by THE Fallout... in every single crevice of Observable Existence, change bloomed.
The next phase had begun!

But at this time...
"Woof!"
Skoll’s tail began to wag as he looked around with ears perked and eyes alert, as if there was something he sensed that nobody else could perceive.
In the next moment...
BOOM!
It felt like existence split in half!

THE Great Usurper’s face became ashen as he felt something happening in the distant region where his existence had come from, where he had already covered his idle existence over the landscapes of THE Wastes where the Axiom he had fused into remained.
In that distant region, a terrifying crack formed in the fabric of reality itself.
The fracture tore through space like a wound that refused to close, its edges burning with light that belonged to no part of Observable Existence.
And from within that crack, roiling and billowing seas of proto-matter began to churn with violence that exceeded anything THE Wastes had witnessed before!
The proto-matter spilled out across THE Wastes like an ocean breaching a dam, undifferentiated potential flooding into differentiated reality with force that began dissolving everything it touched.
THE Great Usurper’s territories, the landscapes he had claimed and converted into extensions of his existence, started coming apart at the seams.
Instantly, THE Great Usurper’s body began to dissolve as the proto-matter reached across his connections and started pulling him back toward the source of his power.
He gasped with shock, his form flickering between stability and dissolution!
Noah moved right away.
His hand erupted with a light of Infinities and undifferentiation that proceeded to wrap around THE Great Usurper with protective force that rejected the proto-matter’s assault.
Vibrant Absolute Seals released from him as they also wrapped around Ains and Skoll, creating bubbles of defined existence that the flooding undifferentiation couldn’t penetrate!
Change...was happening in many places.
Across THE Wastes in an entirely different direction, there was the silent and small miniaturized Infiniverse itself, which now housed a complete Primordial Realm within its structure.
Muspelheim burned at the heart of Noah’s domain, its crimson-blue stellar fires fueling growth that exceeded what any territories could achieve.
At the very center of this grand home of THE Genesis Monarch, a humanoid manifestation of THE Infiniverse was floating in a terrifying region of utmost Immensity and glory.
This region held extremely concentrated and pure Civilizational Authority that would have crushed any being who entered without Noah’s explicit blessing.

Boundless seas of Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue permeated all around, mixing with each other in configurations that produced multicolored light spanning every spectrum that existence could perceive.
The Seals of Fire wove through Seals of Darkness, which intertwined with Seals of Chaos, which merged with Seals of Unity, creating patterns of authority so dense that space itself bent around them.
The only other being in existence who enjoyed the allure of Noah’s Infinities was THE Infiniverse herself.
This arguably made her one of the most important beings in Observable Existence, even if she forever planned to remain in the shadow of her master.
Because without her master, she was nothing.
She would still be that floating landmass in the Beast World, a territory without purpose, a domain without direction.
But with him, she was becoming something unprecedented.
In this domain of extremely concentrated weavings of existence, in the hands of THE Infiniverse, there was a budding singularity that blazed with the light of proto-matter and undifferentiation.
She was currently filling it with the lights of Noah’s Infinities, variations of THE First Tongue permeating all around it as she carefully shaped something that had never been attempted before.
She wanted to form something significant for her master.
Something similar to THE Prima Indifferentia but born from his authority rather than the ancient chaos that predated Observable Existence.
And as many people as there were who truly did not understand the terrifying true potential and capability that she held, she alone was enough to understand what she was capable of.
Her immediate goal was something simple for her, something that she termedOperation Infinite Observable Existence.
And she was not referring to the Observable Existence that everyone knew when she planned this operation.
So she was proceeding carefully, layer by layer, Seal by Seal, when in the next moment...
BOOM!
Near the singularity filled with proto-matter, a terrifying crack bloomed as if reality was being torn as if it were a page!
The fracture expanded with speed that exceeded what should have been possible within the protected confines of THE Infiniverse, its edges burning with corruption.
From this expanding crack, unstable seas of proto-matter filled with a sense of corruption flooded out with force that threatened to overwhelm everything she had been building.
This wasn’t the pure proto-matter of THE Prima Indifferentia.
This was something tainted, something that carried the signature of THE Fallout within its undifferentiated depths!
THE Infiniverse frowned and bellowed out!
"YAAA!"

Her shout was filled with majesty and undeniability shockingly holding the weight of an Embodiment, the full weight of her existence as the domain of THE Genesis Monarch pressing against the invasion with authority that refused to be overwhelmed!
The terrifying scenes that threatened to spill out across all of THE Infiniverse instantly became contained, caught by barriers that she manifested with speed born of glory and determination.
And then, with control that exceeded what the attacker had anticipated, she began funneling the corrupted proto-matter into the singularity she had been building this whole time.
If they wanted to send her undifferentiation, she would take it.
She would add it to her project.
She would turn their attack into fuel for her master’s advancement.
Change was blooming here as well.
In Alfheimr, above a certain mountain where THE Creature resided, a crack tore through the twilight with violence that made the Primordial Realm itself tremble.
In Helheim, fractures bloomed across the frozen landscapes like wounds that bled proto-matter rather than blood.
In Vanaheimr, the realm of nature and growth, cracks formed among the ancient forests with corruption that began dissolving trees that had existed since THE Infinite Unfurling.
In the space where Muspelheim used to be, before THE Infiniverse absorbed it entirely, reality simply shattered as proto-matter flooded the void with purpose that transcended natural disaster.

In many Primordial Realms hidden from Observable Existence, in THE Wandering Territories that drifted between defined spaces, in corrupted Folds that had already been touched by THE Fallout... in every single crevice of Observable Existence, change bloomed.
The next phase had begun!

chapters.title: Chapter 4900: The Second Cause II
paragraphs: As immense changes began to unfold across Observable Existence, in THE Infiniverse, Noah’s body that had been discussing with THE Mnemonic Leviathan was forced to pause.

He sensed the many changes that were occurring through different bodies as he was currently in multiple positions across Observable Existence. One body wrapped protective Infinities around THE Great Usurper and his companions as proto-matter flooded THE Wastes. Another body raced alongside THE Primordial Paradox toward the Crack in THE Agora. Another sensed as THE Infiniverse bellowed with authority and funneled corrupted undifferentiation into her budding singularity.

The eruption of power caused him to think about many things. The synchronicity of it all pointed toward deliberate orchestration rather than natural disaster. Someone had initiated this, and whoever they were possessed the capability to affect every corner of Observable Existence simultaneously, and of course...

Before he could theorize too much regarding what was coming, the ancient voice of the lazy dolphin in front of him began to talk. This creature with all the knowledge, or most of the knowledge in Observable Existence, spoke with weight that demanded attention despite the chaos unfolding around them.
"The Vakochev Scales of Existence whisper the names of some who are grand and distinguished."
Her massive form shifted in the stellar seas of Muspelheim as her eyes, ancient beyond measure, fixed upon Noah with intensity that belied her typically sleepy demeanor.

"Not all who achieve power earn such whispers. But there are those whose actions resonate so profoundly through the foundations of Existence that the Scales themselves take notice, recording their deeds as reference points for all who might follow. One such being is Masamuk, whose name I speak now so that you might understand what is unfolding around us."

She had begun to babble about some nonsense, and Noah almost asked what any of this had to do with the proto-matter currently flooding across Observable Existence. But when she spoke the last sentence, when she connected this ancient history to current events, he fell quiet and continued to listen.
THE Mnemonic Leviathan continued with a voice that held the weight of memories accumulated across eons.

"In the age before ages, when Existence was young and the boundaries between what was and what was not remained fluid and uncertain, there existed a being who looked upon the formless expanse of primordial Chaos and saw within it the potential for something greater. This being was Masamuk, and unlike those who came before, Masamuk did not merely exist within Chaos or alongside it. Masamuk acted upon it with intention."
Her massive tail shifted through the stellar currents as she spoke.

"Masamuk split the body of Chaos itself. Not with authority, for authority as we understand it had not yet been differentiated from raw potential. Masamuk split Chaos through the sheer force of will that declared division where unity had reigned since before time learned to flow. The act was violent and beautiful and necessary, a severing that created possibility where only homogeneity had existed before."

"From the halves of that sundered Chaos, Masamuk fashioned the territories that would become the first Domains. These were not Primordial Realms as you know them, not structured territories governed by laws and principles. They were the precursors to such things, the rough sketches from which later beings would learn to draw their own weavings. Masamuk looked upon the divided Chaos and shaped it, molded it, convinced it to remember the forms that Masamuk envisioned rather than collapsing back into undifferentiated potential."
Her eyes grew distant as if she was recalling whispers that echoed across dimensions Noah couldn’t perceive.

"This was the first great Cause of differentiation through Chaos under the record of Masamuk, as only at this time did he become a true follower of Vakochev. Masamuk understood something that many beings across eons would fail to grasp: that Chaos is not the enemy of creation but its raw material. That undifferentiation is not the opposite of civilization but the clay from which civilization is sculpted. By splitting Chaos rather than fleeing from it or being consumed by it, Masamuk demonstrated that the formless could be given form by those with sufficient will and vision."

"Through this act, Masamuk embarked upon a Civilization unlike any that had existed before, becoming worthy of having his name whispered across the Scales of Existence. The methodology that Masamuk pioneered became the path that others would walk."

"The Scales of Existence recorded Masamuk’s name not because of power accumulated or enemies defeated, but because Masamuk changed the fundamental nature of what existence could be in his domains. This is what it means to walk a grand path. This is what it means to earn The Whisper of THE Scales."
THE Mnemonic Leviathan dropped such ridiculous bombs casually, as if she was discussing the musings of minor things.

Noah was wondering in the beginning as to who this Masamuk could refer to, but it now became abundantly clear that they weren’t even someone belonging to what he knew as Observable Existence. Yet their names were whispered in the Vakochev Scales of Existence, recorded as reference points for all who might follow.
This led him to ask himself a question that he had not considered before.
How could he hear these same whispers that THE Mnemonic Leviathan heard?

Was this also the same way that THE Primordial Paradox came to know regarding adversity and hardship being required toward THE Second Scale of Existence? Had THE Primordial Paradox heard whispers from the Scales that told him what was necessary for progression?
As Noah was thinking all of this, THE Mnemonic Leviathan continued with her ancient voice that held the weight of accumulated knowledge.

"Another such being is Ongatala, whose methodology differed from Masamuk’s but whose impact proved equally profound. Where Masamuk looked outward and divided external Chaos, Ongatala looked inward and created internal structure. Where Masamuk fashioned Domains from the halves of what was split, Ongatala fashioned lands from what was scattered within the depths of self."

chapters.title: Chapter 4901: The Second Cause III
paragraphs: Her form drifted closer to Noah as she spoke.

"Ongatala descended into the waters of nothing. I speak not of metaphor but of literal action that defies easy comprehension. There existed, in those early ages, spaces that held no substance whatsoever. Not emptiness, for emptiness implies the absence of something that could be present. These were waters of nothing, expanses where existence itself had not yet decided whether to manifest. Ongatala entered these spaces willingly, diving deeper and deeper into the void that consumed all definition."

"Within those waters of nothing, Ongatala scattered soil. From where did this soil come? From Ongatala’s own existence. From foundations that Ongatala sacrificed in order to create something greater than self-preservation. Each grain of scattered soil was a piece of Ongatala’s being, distributed across the nothing with intention that demanded reality acknowledge what was being given. And reality, faced with such deliberate sacrifice, had no choice but to comply."

"The scattered soil became the first lands within Ongatala’s own structure. A being who was once singular became a being who contained territories, a being whose internal landscape held mountains and valleys and spaces where other existences could eventually take root. This was differentiation turned inward, a Cause that proved one did not need external Chaos to divide. One could divide oneself and become greater through the division."

"Ongatala’s path demonstrated that the grand acts of existence need not be conquests or external transformations. Sometimes the most profound changes occur within, when a being chooses to become a territory rather than merely occupy one. The lands that Ongatala created within eventually became templates for how internal Civilizations could be structured, how beings could cultivate not just their power but their inner landscapes."

THE Mnemonic Leviathan paused at this moment, and her ancient gaze turned away from Noah. She looked toward the humanoid form of THE Infiniverse who floated in the distance, her other body still working to contain and redirect the corrupted proto-matter that had invaded her master’s domain.
"I find her unique."
Her voice held something that might have been wonder.

"Her weavings remind me of the whispers and stories of Ongatala. A being who chose to become a territory rather than merely occupy one. A being whose internal landscape holds realms and spaces where other existences take root. She is walking a path that echoes across the Scales, whether she knows it or not."
Noah’s eyes became even sharper at these words, his attention now fully locked upon THE Mnemonic Leviathan as she turned back to face him.

"I tell you of Masamuk and Ongatala because what is happening right now, this emergence of corrupted proto-matter across Observable Existence, is something similar. Whoever initiated this is walking a grand path. They are attempting to reshape the fundamental nature of what Observable Existence can be. They are using proto-matter as Masamuk used Chaos, as Ongatala used the waters of nothing. They are attempting a Cause of differentiation through undifferentiation, a paradox... a paradox... a glorious paradox."
Her ancient eyes held weight that pressed against Noah’s existence.

"The Scales of Existence may whisper. They may whisper his name if he is successful in this gambit. Whether that name will be remembered as pioneer or catastrophe remains to be seen. But the magnitude of what is being attempted cannot be denied. Someone is walking in the footsteps of Masamuk and Ongatala. Someone is attempting to reshape existence itself."
BOOM!
Noah’s expression became heavy at these words.
Fuck.

Paradox. Corruption. Change across Observable Existence. Noah instantly honed in on THE Living Paradox as it seemed far too many people were underestimating this being, himself included. THE Living Paradox had now done something or begun embarking on something unfathomably grand!
His own Cause!

Though it wouldn’t be the same as THE First Cause, so was THE Living Paradox attempting a Second Cause? Was that what this terrifying change was? An attempt to reshape Observable Existence itself through flooding it with corrupted proto-matter?
If THE Living Paradox succeeded in whatever his final grand design was...it truly was not clear who would be the victor in this eon long war!
At the center of THE Infiniverse, in a realm of concentrated authority that no being but her master could survive, THE Infiniverse worked alone.
Multicolored light suffused everything around her as boundless seas of Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue swirled and merged and created patterns of power that defied comprehension.
And before her, the crack in reality continued to spew corrupted proto-matter with force that would have overwhelmed any other territory in Observable Existence.

She funneled it into the singularity she had been building, her will pressing against the corruption with authority that refused to acknowledge its threat. The budding domain at the center of her working consumed the proto-matter greedily, growing denser and more defined with each passing moment. What THE Living Paradox had intended as an attack was becoming fuel for her creation.
But as she worked, as she directed the endless flood into her forming domain, the words of THE Mnemonic Leviathan echoed through her consciousness.
"Ongatala descended into the waters of nothing."
She repeated the phrase silently as she continued her work, her hands guiding corrupted proto-matter into channels that led to the singularity.
"Within those waters of nothing, Ongatala scattered soil. From Ongatala’s own existence. From foundations that Ongatala sacrificed in order to create something greater than self-preservation..."
Her movements slowed as the words resonated through her being with weight that demanded attention.
"Each grain of scattered soil was a piece of Ongatala’s being, distributed across the nothing with intention that demanded reality acknowledge what was being given."
THE Infiniverse stopped.

Her eyes, which burned with the Infinities of her master, began to shine even brighter as understanding bloomed within her consciousness. THE Mnemonic Leviathan had said that her weavings reminded her of Ongatala. That she was walking a path that echoed across the Scales of Existence.
But she had not been walking that path fully.
She had been containing. She had been directing. She had been building a domain within herself, yes, but she had been doing so defensively and reactively.
Ongatala had not merely received the waters of nothing.
Ongatala had descended into them willingly.
Ongatala had scattered soil with purpose.

THE Infiniverse looked at the crack of Observable Existence that had formed within her core, that wound in reality through which corrupted proto-matter continued to surge. It was a violation of her territory, an intrusion that she had been working to minimize and contain.
But what if she didn’t minimize it?
What if she didn’t contain it?
What if she made it...bigger?

Her eyes blazed with light that painted her multicolored realm in shades of blue-gold brilliance as the epiphany crystallized into decision. She was THE Infiniverse. She was the domain of THE Genesis Monarch himself. She contained a Primordial Realm within her structure alongside Wheel of Existence, Folds, and so much more.
And her foundations grew alongside her master’s Infinite nature without theoretical ceiling.
She was not prey to be overwhelmed by corrupted proto-matter.
She was grand, and she...would scatter her soil across the waters of nothing.
Her figure pulsed with determination.

chapters.title: Chapter 4902: The Second Cause IV
paragraphs: THE Infiniverse raised her hands toward the crack and made a move that would have seemed like madness to any observer.
She tore it wider.
BOOM!

The crack expanded under her authority, its edges spreading apart as she commanded reality itself to open further rather than close. What had been a wound became a gateway. What had been an intrusion became an invitation. And through that expanded crack, seas of corrupted proto-matter surged out with force that exceeded everything that had come before!
The corruption flooded into her core with violence that should have been catastrophic!
But THE Infiniverse was ready.

From her existence, from the foundations that comprised her being, she began to release Infinite Absolute Seals in quantities that would have drained any other entity entirely. Endless seals of The First Tongue scattered into the surging proto-matter like soil being distributed across the waters of nothing.
This was her endless soil!
These were the pieces of her existence that she was sacrificing in order to create something greater than mere survival!

The Infinite Seals merged with the corrupted proto-matter, their blue-gold light suffusing the undifferentiated potential with the signature of THE Genesis Monarch himself. The corruption didn’t disappear, but it changed. It became something hybrid, something that held both the undifferentiation of THE Prima Indifferentia and the Infinite nature of her master’s authority.
And then THE Infiniverse did something even more drastic.

One, she allowed this blue gold brilliance to flow into the crack and spread out in different directions across it, so it could mix with that sea and flow to any other areas that Proto-matter was flowing across Observable Existence.
Two...
She formed a channel.

Not inward toward her singularity, but outward toward THE Wastes where in a small corner, another body of her master currently protected THE Great Usurper and his companions from the very corruption she now commanded.
The channel punched through her boundaries with precision of absolute control, creating a pathway through which her newly transformed proto-matter could flow.
And flow it did!

Endless seas of corrupted proto-matter filled with Noah’s Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue flooded out across existence through the channel she had created! The corruption that THE Living Paradox had sent to overwhelm and change Observable Existence now carried the signature of THE Genesis Monarch within its depths!
It was like seeing someone initiate an avelance or and endless train, and then jumping on it to obtain the benefits of their hard work as well!
Every wave of undifferentiation that washed across THE Wastes in this area and beyond now scattered Infinite Seals like soil being distributed across the waters of nothing!

And as the endless seas of infinity also flooded into the Crack of Observable Existence, she sought for them to flow out from other sources or cracks as fully and truly...the aspect of Infinity of Noah’s weavings was allowed to express itself here.
It survived the corrupted proto-matter because...it was Infinite. Just like against Bazuman, it couldnt be differentiated further.
It flowed.
Oh, it flowed!
Everywhere the proto-matter spread, Infinite Seals would spread alongside it. Everywhere the undifferentiation touched, the blue-gold light of THE Genesis Monarch would touch as well.

If THE Living Paradox wanted to reshape Observable Existence through flooding it with proto-matter, then THE Infiniverse would ensure that what emerged from that reshaping...they would have a large piece of the pie.
She continued to scatter her soil, continued to release Infinite Seals into the surging seas, continued to transform corruption into conquest with unfathomable immensity!
Far from the wonders and actions of THE Infiniverse.
In THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, Noah and THE Primordial Paradox arrived before the expanded Crack of Observable Existence with speed that made distance meaningless.
What they witnessed was chaos unlike anything THE Agora had experienced in its entire history.

The Crack that had existed peacefully at the heart of THE Acropolis for eons had been torn wider, its edges burning with light that belonged to no part of Observable Existence. Through that expanded fracture, corrupted proto-matter flooded outward in endless waves that threatened to dissolve everything they touched.
The undifferentiation carried the signature of THE Fallout within its depths, a corruption that went beyond mere formlessness into something actively hostile.
And standing against this tide were the other Strategoi of THE Agora.

Glossikos held her position closest to the Crack, her luminous dryad form radiating authority as she attempted to impose definition upon the undifferentiated flood. Her voice rang out with Embodiments that declared what the proto-matter was not, trying to negate its spread through sheer linguistic authority.

Ontikos stood beside her with the calm weight of Existence itself pressing outward from his form. His methodology was different, attempting to convince the proto-matter that it already existed as something defined rather than something formless. The approach should have worked against normal undifferentiation.
It wasn’t working.
Khaotikos flanked their fellow Strategoi, their own authorities adding to the combined effort.
As soos as Paradoxos arrived back, Paradox wove contradictions into the flood, trying to make the proto-matter uncertain about whether it was differentiated or not.
Chaos attempted to destabilize the corruption’s unified flow, to break it into fragments that could be dealt with individually.
None of it was enough!

The Crack continued to expand despite their efforts, and the proto-matter continued to surge with force that slowly pushed the four Absolutes backward. They were losing ground inch by inch, and if this continued, THE Agora itself would be covered!
Noah’s eyes pulsed with Immensity soon after as if he sensed something that the others couldn’t perceive.
’Fucking...’
His eyes shone sharply as if he couldn’t believe what he felt!
Something was coming through the Crack. Something was using the corruption as cover for its approach. Something was about to strike!

A page containing a defensive Inscription instantly appeared before the dryad body of Glossikos, the golden sheet burning with blue-gold light as it materialized from Noah’s reserves of Inscriptiones Dormientes. The Sleeping Inscription awakened at his command, its Apophasis blazing to life with authority that declared protection through negation.

|The one shielded by this Inscription is not capable of being consumed. Their existence is not susceptible to what seeks to devour. Their definition is not something that can be unmade by forces of undifferentiation. This truth persists so long as the foundation of the attacker does not exceed the foundation of the one who wrote these words.|
HUUM!
The Apophasis shone with brilliant blue-gold light just as jaws of undifferentiation closed in on Glossikos from within the proto-matter flood!
Massive. Hungry. Invisible until the moment of attack!
The jaws would have devoured her with the light of undifferentiation, would have consumed an Absolute Strategos as casually as a beast consuming prey!

chapters.title: Chapter 4903: The Second Cause V
paragraphs: But the defensive Inscription’s Apophasis caused them to pause, the negation pressing against the attack with authority that declared this consumption was not possible!
The jaws snapped shut on nothing, their target protected by words that Noah had written!

THE Primordial Paradox made a move in that same instant, his obsidian form blurring with speed that exceeded what should have been possible. Paradoxical authority wrapped around the shocked Glossikos and the other three Strategoi, pulling them away from the Crack with force that brooked no resistance.
He deposited them behind Noah and himself with a calm and glorious expression that held no fear despite what had just nearly occurred!
Glossikos looked towards Noah with a shocked gaze as she touched her body, half expecting it be undifferentiated.
But she had been saved as she saw that radiant golden page which actually still burned in front of her as it felt...glorious and immense!
This...was his power now!?
"We...are no longer alone."
His voice was steady.
And then, from the Crack, something emerged.

Noah watched with eyes that saw everything clearly as a figure he had not truly missed made its entrance into Observable Existence. The jaws that had just tried to devour Glossikos didn’t disappear but rather pulled back toward their source, revealing themselves as merely one small part of something far larger.
Bazuman.
Bazuman!

THE Undivided One that had chased Noah across THE Prima Indifferentia with relentless hunger emerged from the expanded Crack with the casual grace of a predator entering territory it intended to claim. Its body was round and glorious, a horror that defied conventional description through its sheer wrongness. Countless eyes dotted its surface in patterns that shifted constantly, each one burning with crimson light that held intelligence and hunger in equal measure.

Tentacles extended from its mass in every direction, writhing appendages that ended in mouths or eyes or configurations that served purposes Noah couldn’t identify. The body itself seemed to pulse with internal rhythms that didn’t match any biological function, as if it was breathing existence rather than air.

And covering every inch of its horrific form, the light of corrupted proto-matter burned with brilliance that painted the surrounding space in shades of wrongness. Bazuman had bathed in the corruption, had absorbed it, had made it part of itself.
Those countless crimson eyes all turned toward Noah with fucking.. giddiness.

And Bazuman spoke with a voice that emerged from every mouth simultaneously, each one contributing to words that pressed against reality with weight that exceeded what Noah remembered from their previous encounters.
"You... have run away from me across time."
The voice was eerie and pleased and utterly certain of its own supremacy.
"And yet existence brings us together again, little thing."
Those countless eyes blinked in patterns that might have been amusement.
"I have waited. I have been patient. I knew that eventually, you would return to where you belonged. And here you are. Here we are. Together again."
Its tentacles spread wider as if embracing the entirety of THE Agora.
"This time, there is nowhere left to run."
Noah looked at Bazuman with an expression that held no fear.
Well, since he had come back from Prima Indifferentia, he had gotten a few precious moments to breathe before adversity thundered down again.

The last time he had encountered this Undivided One, he had been forced to flee. He had been weaker then, less refined, still learning what his Infinities could accomplish. He had used tricks and misdirection and ultimately temporal displacement to escape.
What about...now?
He knew it was a high ask. He actually knew it should be impossible. But hey, why not try?
At this moment in time, there were many things Noah could say or do but while he looked at Bazuman...he directed his words towards the calm Primordial Paradox beside him.

"This whole time, I had a bias that in the future, THE Creature and you would win over THE Living Paradox. There may be some hiccups here and there, but victory would be in place. But based on what is happening right now..."
He thought of THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s words. Of what THE Living Paradox was truly attempting.
He shook his head as he focused on the giddy Bazuman as he continued.
"We may be underestimating THE Living Paradox far too much. He...might surprise everyone."
His words were heavy, and they may not even be fitting as the terrifying aura of an Undivided One stood before them.
But he felt like saying them, and so he did.
Beside him, THE Primordial Paradox was thoughtful before he nodded.
"Mm. It seems my disciple has come far. But first, there is this."
This.
THE Undivided One!
Their gazes fully turned towards it as it radiated shocking waves of brutality and immensity.
Far from THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
In Alfheimr, THE Creature remained calm.

Endless seas of corrupted undifferentiation had spilled out from a blooming crack above his mountain, the proto-matter flooding across the radiant twilight with force that began dissolving the ancient landscapes of his Primordial Realm. Trees that had existed since before THE Infinite Unfurling came apart at the seams. Mountains that had witnessed the birth of civilizations crumbled into formless potential.
And from within that corruption, terrifying auras had bloomed.
Three figures had emerged from the crack with hunger that pressed against reality itself.

The first was an Undivided One whose body resembled a great winged lion with the face of something that had never been mortal. Its mane was made of writhing serpents that hissed with individual malice, and its wings stretched wide enough to cast shadows across entire territories. Where its paws touched, existence forgot what solidity meant.This one descended toward the lower slopes where THE Living Emotive and THE Living Elemental currently stood.

The second was another Undivided One, this one taking the form of a massive serpent-dragon whose scales shifted between states of matter with each breath. Its body coiled through the corrupted proto-matter as if swimming through water, and from its back rose seven heads that each bore different expressions of hunger. Eyes of molten gold fixed upon THE Creature’s temple with desire.

The third was a Formless Terror, and unlike THE Undivided Ones, it had no stable shape whatsoever. It was a churning mass of potential that occasionally resolved into hints of forms before collapsing back into chaos. Claws appeared and vanished. Jaws manifested and dissolved. It was hunger without direction, destruction without purpose, and it drifted toward THE Creature alongside the serpent-dragon with the inevitability of a tide coming in.
THE Creature observed all of this from his temple with eyes that held multicolored flames burning within their depths.

Below his mountain, THE Living Elemental was struggling. The curse that Noah had written upon him continued its relentless work, burning across his Depths and deteriorating his foundations with every passing moment. He could barely stand, let alone defend himself against the winged lion that descended toward him with killing intent!

chapters.title: Chapter 4904: The Second Cause VI
paragraphs: THE Living Emotive stood between THE Undivided One and her fallen companion, her colorful hair blazing with authority as she released Embodiment after Embodiment against the approaching horror.
|Emotions are the foundation of existence! Fear shall become my weapon, and the fear you feel at facing an Absolute shall consume you!|
BOOM!
Her Embodiment crashed against the winged lion with force that would have devastated any weak Absolute!
THE Undivided One didn’t even slow down.

It passed through her Embodiment as if it were mist, its serpent-mane hissing with amusement at her attempt to weaponize its emotions. This creature had existed since before emotions were differentiated from raw experience. It did not know fear. It only knew hunger.
Emotive released another Embodiment, and another, her voice growing more desperate amd grand with each Embodiment that failed to halt the approaching predator.
"Rage shall become a wall! Fury shall become a shield! The intensity of my passion shall-"
BOOM!
THE Undivided One’s paw swiped through her Embodiment and caught her across the torso, sending her tumbling down the mountainside with force that cracked the ancient stone beneath her impact.
She looked up at THE Creature’s temple with fury and desperation blazing in her eyes.
"CREATURE! HELP US!"
Her voice rang across Alfheimr with the weight of an Absolute’s full attention.

THE Creature remained in his temple, his multicolored flames burning steadily as he looked at THE Undivided One and THE Formless Terror approaching his position. The words of Emotive rang in his ears, demanding response, demanding action, demanding that he save her from the horror that was about to devour her.
But...
He spoke with a voice that held the authority of Existence itself.
"Adversity is good for your existence."
His tone was calm, almost gentle.
"See if you can get out of it yourself first."

Below the mountain, Emotive’s expression transformed from desperation into absolute rage. THE Undivided One was approaching her fallen position with leisurely pace, savoring the moment before consumption. Elemental lay nearby, trembling with pain that he couldn’t suppress, unable to contribute anything to their defense.
Emotive’s voice burned with fury that transcended her usual manic energy.
"If I die, I will haunt you endlessly, O Creature! I will haunt you! I will-"
THE Creature was no longer listening.

His attention had turned fully to THE Undivided One and THE Formless Terror that approached his temple with hunger written across every aspect of their being. The serpent-dragon’s seven heads all oriented toward him with anticipation. THE Formless Terror churned with increased intensity as it drew closer to prey that radiated more authority than anything it had encountered in eons.
They looked at THE Creature hungrily.
They saw an Absolute surrounded by multicolored flames.
They saw a meal beyond anything they had consumed before!
They did not see what THE Creature truly was.
THE Creature spoke a single measly Embodiment.
"Existence...acknowledges my grasp."

The words were simple. Almost casual. They held none of the elaborate declarations that other Absolutes used, none of the lengthy descriptions of authority and power that Embodiments typically contained.
And yet.
BOOM!
THE Creature stretched his hands outward from his temple, his multicolored flames extending with them as his authority pressed against reality with weight that defied comprehension.

The serpent-dragon, whose coiled body stretched for miles across the corrupted proto-matter, suddenly found itself shrinking. Not shrinking in the sense of becoming smaller, but shrinking in the sense of being compressed, being contained, being forced into a space that its existence should not have been able to occupy.

THE Formless Terror, whose churning mass had no fixed boundaries, suddenly found those boundaries being defined against its will. It was being given form. It was being forced into shape. It was being compressed alongside the serpent-dragon with authority that brooked no resistance.
Both of them ended up in THE Creature’s palm.

THE Undivided One that had been miles long now fit within his grasp. THE Formless Terror that had been an ocean of potential now occupied the space between his fingers. They writhed and struggled and released authority that should have devastated everything around them, but THE Creature’s definition of existence overwrote their definitions entirely.
He was the glimmer of Existence.
They existed only because he permitted it.
And now, he chose not to permit it.
THE Creature squeezed.

The sound that emerged was not a sound at all, but rather the absence of sound where existence was being unmade. The serpent-dragon’s seven heads screamed silently as their forms compressed beyond what any form could sustain. THE Formless Terror churned with desperate intensity as the chaos that comprised its being was forced into order, into structure, into definition that it had never possessed and could not survive.
They became mush in his palm.

THE Undivided One and THE Formless Terror, beings that had existed since before THE Infinite Unfurling, became nothing more than paste squeezed between THE Creature’s fingers. Their authority, their power, their eons of accumulated existence, all of it compressed into something that could be held in a single hand.
THE Creature brought that hand to his mouth.

He threw what remained of their existence past his lips with casual grace, consuming the paste of two primordial entities as if it were nothing more than a light snack. His multicolored flames burned brighter for a moment as he absorbed what they had been, adding their weight to his own already incomprehensible foundations.

His figure continued to be shrouded with multicolored flames as he did such a thing, his expression never changing from its calm composure. This was not a battle to him. This was not even an inconvenience. This was simply maintenance, the removal of pests that had wandered too close.
Below the mountain, Emotive yelled out for him again as THE Undivided One drew closer to her position.
But THE Undivided One that was attacking her had frozen in place.
Its serpent-mane had stopped hissing.
Its wings had stopped beating.
Its eyes, which had held hunger moments before, now held something else entirely as they gazed upward at THE Creature’s temple.
Fear...bloomed.

THE Undivided One had just watched two beings of equivalent power and origin...become paste in THE Creature’s palm. It had just witnessed an Absolute demonstrate power that exceeded anything it had encountered in its entire existence!
Very few understood the power of THE Creature.
Very few... understood his Immensity.

She looked up at THE Creature’s temple with fury and desperation blazing in her eyes.
"CREATURE!
HELP US!"
Her voice rang across Alfheimr with the weight of an Absolute’s full attention.
THE Creature remained in his temple, his multicolored flames burning steadily as he looked at THE Undivided One and THE Formless Terror approaching his position.
The words of Emotive rang in his ears, demanding response, demanding action, demanding that he save her from the horror that was about to devour her.
But...
He spoke with a voice that held the authority of Existence itself.
"Adversity is good for your existence."
His tone was calm, almost gentle.
"See if you can get out of it yourself first."
Below the mountain, Emotive’s expression transformed from desperation into absolute rage.
THE Undivided One was approaching her fallen position with leisurely pace, savoring the moment before consumption.
Elemental lay nearby, trembling with pain that he couldn’t suppress, unable to contribute anything to their defense.
Emotive’s voice burned with fury that transcended her usual manic energy.
"If I die, I will haunt you endlessly, O Creature!
I will haunt you!
I will-"
THE Creature was no longer listening.
His attention had turned fully to THE Undivided One and THE Formless Terror that approached his temple with hunger written across every aspect of their being.
The serpent-dragon’s seven heads all oriented toward him with anticipation.
THE Formless Terror churned with increased intensity as it drew closer to prey that radiated more authority than anything it had encountered in eons.
They looked at THE Creature hungrily.
They saw an Absolute surrounded by multicolored flames.
They saw a meal beyond anything they had consumed before!
They did not see what THE Creature truly was.
THE Creature spoke a single measly Embodiment.
"Existence...acknowledges my grasp."
The words were simple.
Almost casual.
They held none of the elaborate declarations that other Absolutes used, none of the lengthy descriptions of authority and power that Embodiments typically contained.
And yet.
BOOM!
THE Creature stretched his hands outward from his temple, his multicolored flames extending with them as his authority pressed against reality with weight that defied comprehension.
The serpent-dragon, whose coiled body stretched for miles across the corrupted proto-matter, suddenly found itself shrinking.
Not shrinking in the sense of becoming smaller, but shrinking in the sense of being compressed, being contained, being forced into a space that its existence should not have been able to occupy.
THE Formless Terror, whose churning mass had no fixed boundaries, suddenly found those boundaries being defined against its will.
It was being given form.
It was being forced into shape.
It was being compressed alongside the serpent-dragon with authority that brooked no resistance.
Both of them ended up in THE Creature’s palm.
THE Undivided One that had been miles long now fit within his grasp.
THE Formless Terror that had been an ocean of potential now occupied the space between his fingers.
They writhed and struggled and released authority that should have devastated everything around them, but THE Creature’s definition of existence overwrote their definitions entirely.
He was the glimmer of Existence.
They existed only because he permitted it.
And now, he chose not to permit it.
THE Creature squeezed.
The sound that emerged was not a sound at all, but rather the absence of sound where existence was being unmade.
The serpent-dragon’s seven heads screamed silently as their forms compressed beyond what any form could sustain.
THE Formless Terror churned with desperate intensity as the chaos that comprised its being was forced into order, into structure, into definition that it had never possessed and could not survive.
They became mush in his palm.
THE Undivided One and THE Formless Terror, beings that had existed since before THE Infinite Unfurling, became nothing more than paste squeezed between THE Creature’s fingers.
Their authority, their power, their eons of accumulated existence, all of it compressed into something that could be held in a single hand.
THE Creature brought that hand to his mouth.
He threw what remained of their existence past his lips with casual grace, consuming the paste of two primordial entities as if it were nothing more than a light snack.
His multicolored flames burned brighter for a moment as he absorbed what they had been, adding their weight to his own already incomprehensible foundations.
His figure continued to be shrouded with multicolored flames as he did such a thing, his expression never changing from its calm composure.
This was not a battle to him.
This was not even an inconvenience.
This was simply maintenance, the removal of pests that had wandered too close.
Below the mountain, Emotive yelled out for him again as THE Undivided One drew closer to her position.
But THE Undivided One that was attacking her had frozen in place.
Its serpent-mane had stopped hissing.
Its wings had stopped beating.
Its eyes, which had held hunger moments before, now held something else entirely as they gazed upward at THE Creature’s temple.
Fear...bloomed.
THE Undivided One had just watched two beings of equivalent power and origin...become paste in THE Creature’s palm.
It had just witnessed an Absolute demonstrate power that exceeded anything it had encountered in its entire existence!
Very few understood the power of THE Creature.
Very few... understood his Immensity.

chapters.title: Chapter 4905: The Information Paradox I
paragraphs: Noah frankly had far too many things happening all at once across multiple bodies.

He was monitoring the terrifying process that THE Infiniverse had just started while also having another body in THE Interstices writing Inscriptions. Another body in THE Wastes was stabilizing THE Great Usurper alongside Ains and Skoll.

An illusory consciousness floated with Ul’moreth and THE Primordial Chaos in Alfheimr. And another body now stared at Bazuman, THE Undivided One, in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment as four Strategoi and THE Primordial Paradox stood beside him.
Truly, it was a lot on his plate, and lesser multitaskers would have crumbled under the weight of simultaneous existential crises unfolding across Observable Existence.
But in the midst of all of this...
|Master.|

THE Infiniverse sent him information as her mixing of the corrupted proto-matter with his Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue made the two intertwine. They now flowed across different parts of existence as a hybrid substance that held both undifferentiation and Infinity within its depths.
In this mixing, there was a pulsing signal that was now being sent. A signal for communication between the Infinities of Noah and the corrupted proto-matter!

It was a unique thing as Noah could feel this signal for communication was paradoxical, with it existing in an undefined state as it had no power or capacity for action. Only communication in the span of an instant. If he accepted this signal, he would likely converse with whatever consciousness sent it within the span of an instant as no time would pass externally.
And this paradoxical signal caused Noah to be immensely curious as he already knew what its origins were.

So even though he was already multitasking on so many things, he designated this as an action that fell in line with what THE Infiniverse was already doing by jumping aboard a terrifying process. She had opened the floodgates, and now he would see what lay on the other side.
So...
He accepted the signal of communication as it was like neuronal signals coming together, as if existential synapses were communicating across the vast distances of Observable Existence!
And...
HUUM!
A part of his consciousness found itself drawn into a flash of singularities, eventually finding itself in a space between spaces that existed outside of normal reality.

Around him flickered seas of corrupted proto-matter and his Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue swirling amidst each other as they reflected an endless multicolored sky above and a blue-gold sea below. The two substances wove through each other in patterns that spoke of forced coexistence, neither fully merging nor fully separating.
He had an illusory consciousness form here.
And a few meters away was the illusory consciousness of... THE Living Paradox.

Noah looked at the visage of this being that looked exactly like Schrodinger. He remained in that grand beggar-like attire as if he wanted to remember his origins even while wielding power that could reshape Observable Existence. He was looking toward Noah with surprise that seemed genuine.

It felt like such a long time had passed since Noah last talked to this being. He had gone back eons in time and come back, had witnessed THE Prima Indifferentia, had met THE Primordial Paradox in his prime. But in relative time, these events were still approximately within the span of a day since THE Fallout began!
THE Living Paradox definitely seemed surprised as he spoke with a voice that held calm authority.
"Out of all things I accounted for across Observable Existence, I didn’t expect it to be you."
His eyes, which held the weight of accumulated eons, studied Noah with intensity.
"I’ve just come to learn you are somehow involved in the resurgence of my old Master. And now, you’ve managed to jump aboard something I’ve worked eons to make happen."
He shook his head slowly.
"I can’t even be mad. You seem to be doing your best across existence and having much better luck than others."
His smile was thin and knowing.
"Tell me, Osmont... what do you know about THE Information Paradox?"
Noah looked at this being with raised brows.

Were they really doing this? He was a sucker for knowledge and information, and he loved letting these ancient beings talk and talk as they revealed their power and the different weavings of existence out there. He simply didn’t expect such a thing from THE Living Paradox, and now of all times.
But he replied calmly as endless Seals spun around his illusory form.
"No. Enlighten me."
HUUM!

THE Living Paradox folded his hands behind his back as waves of definition and undefinition surrounded him, the corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals reflecting off his form in patterns that spoke of someone who existed at the center of what was currently unfolding.
"THE Information Paradox...is one of the oldest contradictions in existence. It is, perhaps, the most fundamental paradox there is."
His voice held profound calmness that seemed at odds with the chaos currently flooding across all realms.

"Consider the nature of information itself. Every being that exists, every Civilization that is built, every action that is taken... all of these generate information. Weavings of cause and effect. Records of what was and what will be. The very fabric of existence is threaded with information that cannot be destroyed, because destroying information would be equivalent to making something that happened... unhappen."
He began to pace slowly through the space between spaces.

"This is the first principle. Information is conserved. What exists must continue to exist in some form. What is known must remain knowable. What has occurred must remain recoverable, even if that recovery requires power beyond what most beings possess. The Vakochev Scales themselves manifest this principle. They record. They remember. They whisper the names of those who have done grand things because that information cannot simply vanish."
His smile grew thinner.

"But here is where the paradox emerges. There exist phenomena across existence that consume without releasing. Voids of definition and undefinition of authority that draw in everything around them, including the information that defines what they consume. When existence enters these voids, these black holes of undifferentiation and differentiation, it is crushed beyond recognition. When Civilizations fall into them, they are compressed into states that should not be able to contain what they once were."
He turned to face Noah directly.

"And when these voids eventually dissolve, when they release their accumulated weight back into existence through emanations that carry none of the original information... what happens to everything that fell in? Where does the information go?"
His eyes held something that might have been melancholy.

"The answer, according to conventional understanding, is that the information is lost forever. Destroyed. Unmade in a way that violates the most fundamental principle of existence. And yet it happens. The voids consume. The voids of undifferentiation and differentiation dissolve. And what emerges carries no trace of what went in."
He spread his hands.

"This is THE Information Paradox. Information cannot be destroyed, and yet these phenomena destroy it. Information must be conserved, and yet these phenomena do not conserve it. The contradiction has driven greater minds than mine to madness, because it suggests that existence itself operates on rules that contradict each other at the most fundamental level."
