chapters.title: Chapter 4906: The Information Paradox II
paragraphs: Noah absorbed all of this with eyes that shone brighter by the moment, his mind already burning through implications that THE Living Paradox hadn’t yet stated.
THE Living Paradox continued with a voice that held absolute arrogance beneath its calm surface.

"Most beings accept THE Information Paradox as an unsolvable mystery. They acknowledge the contradiction and move on with their existences, content to let greater powers worry about fundamental inconsistencies in reality. But I...am not most beings."
BOOM!
His smile became something dangerous.

"I have been violating this paradox since before my old Master found me begging in the streets of a forgotten realm. I am uniquely one across Observable Existence who can do so, and I have been taking in Information... but this Information consists of the endless weavings of existence that cannot be destroyed."
He paused.
"Even though when they enter my existence, they do get lost entirely."
The words hung in the space between spaces with weight that pressed against Noah’s consciousness.

"Do you understand what I am telling you, Osmont? I am a living violation of the most fundamental paradox in existence. Information enters me. Information is conserved within me. And yet, simultaneously, that information is lost forever in ways that should be impossible. I hold both states within myself at all times. I am the void that consumes, and I am the release that carries no trace. I am the paradox made flesh."
His eyes grew distant.

"When I first discovered this capability, I thought it was merely a curiosity. A quirk of my existence that had no practical application. But over eons, I came to understand what it truly meant. I could take the weavings of existence into myself. All that...information. I could consume the Information that comprised beings and Civilizations and entire realms. And when I released that consumed essence, it would carry my signature rather than theirs."
He began to pace again as his voice grew harder.

"THE Fallout...was the deliberate release of Information that I have been consuming for eons, now spreading across Observable Existence as weavings under my control rather than weavings that belong to their original sources."
He stopped pacing and faced Noah with an expression that held condescension barely restrained.

"The Information that comprises Observable Existence is being drawn into the paradox that I embody. And when this process completes, when the Information has been fully consumed and released... Observable Existence itself will carry my signature. The weavings that define reality will be weavings that I have touched. "
He spread his hands wide.

"This is what I have worked eons to achieve. This is the Cause that I am attempting. Not merely to Scale Existence, but to become the fundamental Information upon which Observable Existence operates. To be the paradox at the heart of reality itself."
THE Living Paradox let those words settle before his expression shifted to something that held genuine bewilderment beneath its arrogance.

"I accounted for everything. THE Creature’s interference. My old Master’s contingencies. THE Primordial Chaos’s instability. I spent eons preparing for every variable that could disrupt my Cause, and I believed I had covered them all."
He looked at Noah with eyes that held something almost like respect.
"And then... new Information simply squeezed itself in."
His gaze dropped to the Infinite Seals that swirled around Noah’s illusory form.

"Information that shines brightly with Infinities that I cannot fully consume. Information that regenerates faster than my paradox can process it. Information that, when I attempt to draw it into my void, simply produces more of itself as I...cannot process it."
He laughed softly.

"Now, my methodology is spreading your signature alongside mine. Every realm that THE Fallout touches is being seeded with your Seals as well as my weavings. Every Civilization that becomes corrupted is receiving your Infinities as well as my Information."
His smile became something between immensity and admiration.

"I worked eons for this moment. Eons of consuming and releasing. Eons of preparing the Information that would spread across Observable Existence. Eons of positioning every piece on the board exactly where it needed to be."
He shook his head slowly.
"And you, THE Youngest among them, someone who wasn’t even at the Civilizational Scale of Existence for long...you’ve managed to insert yourself into my grand design."
BOOM!
His eyes locked onto Noah’s with intensity that pressed against the illusory space between them.
"Isn’t that just a maddening thing?"
THE Living Paradox finished his words with a dangerous smile as he looked at Noah whose eyes were shining brilliantly!
A maddening thing.
When Noah thought about it, it was truly so!

But he found himself studying THE Living Paradox as from how he was talking, even with the slight anger he showed, there was something else beneath the surface. Something that didn’t quite match the circumstances of having his grand design infiltrated by an unexpected variable.
"Why are you so... unbothered?"
Yes.
THE Living Paradox was eerily unbothered about all of it. He even seemed happy. His eyes held light that spoke of satisfaction rather than concern, of anticipation rather than worry.
At Noah’s words, THE Living Paradox smiled with an expression that made the space between spaces feel smaller somehow.
"I can be paradoxically happy and mad at the same time."
His voice held that profound calmness that seemed to define his existence.

"Because with every action, with every choice, there is a reaction. Everything in Observable Existence, from the grandest Absolute to the smallest mortal consciousness, operates on this principle. Action and reaction. Cause and effect. Choice and consequence."
He folded his hands behind his back as waves of definition and undefinition swirled around his beggar-like form.
"Everything comes down to choices. Choices!"
The eyes of THE Living Paradox shone with a terrifying light of fanaticism as he continued, his voice growing more intense with each word.

"Let me tell you something about the nature of Observable Existence that most beings refuse to acknowledge. Determinism. Determinism! There are those who believe that all events, all actions, all decisions made by every consciousness across every realm, are predetermined by the weavings that came before them. That the Civilizational Authority we wield, the paths we walk, the enemies we face and the allies we choose... all of it was fixed before we ever became aware enough to perceive ourselves making choices."
He began to pace through the swirling mixture of corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals.

"If every weaving of existence follows from the weavings that preceded it, then the future is not something we create through our decisions. It is something that already exists, waiting for us to arrive at it through the illusion of choice. THE Creature’s war against me? Predetermined. My betrayal of my Master? Predetermined. Your emergence as THE Youngest among THE Four? Already woven into the fabric of existence before you were ever born."

paragraphs: His smile grew melancholic.

"This view of Determinism suggests that Observable Existence operates like a grand mechanism, each part moving according to laws that were established at the moment of THE First Cause. Every Embodiment we speak, every Apophasis we declare, every word you say, Osmont... all of it merely the unfolding of patterns that were set in motion eons before any of us existed to perceive them."
He paused.
"And yet."
His eyes grew sharper.

"There are phenomena that challenge this understanding. The undifferentiation of THE Prima Indifferentia introduces randomness that defies prediction. The proto-matter that floods across Observable Existence at this very moment carries potential that cannot be calculated in advance. At the most fundamental level of reality, events occur not according to fixed laws but according to probabilities that resolve only when observation forces them to choose a state."
He turned to face Noah directly.

"Does this randomness allow for genuine choice? Or does it simply make our actions random rather than predetermined? THE Undivided Ones and THE Primordial Architects of Prima Indifferentia have debated this question since consciousness first emerged from the chaos of early existence. Some argue that if our choices are not determined by prior causes, they must be random, and random is not the same as free. Others argue that randomness creates space for genuine agency to operate, for consciousness to insert itself into the gaps between predetermined outcomes."
His voice dropped to something almost intimate.

"And then there is what some call THE Cascade Effect. Even if Observable Existence operates deterministically, even if every cause leads inevitably to its effect, the complexity of these weavings is so vast that tiny variations, invisible and unmeasurable, can lead to drastically different outcomes. A single thought held for a moment longer. A single step taken in a different direction. A single choice that seemed insignificant at the time. These small things cascade through existence, creating futures that could not have been predicted even with perfect knowledge of all prior states."
He spread his hands.

"This makes the future functionally unpredictable to us, even if it is technically fixed. We experience choice because we cannot see the chains of causation that bind us. We feel free... because the complexity of our constraints exceeds our capacity to perceive them."
BOOM!
Feeling free..because the complexity of the constraints exceeds the capacity to perceive them!
Oh!
His smile became something between wisdom and despair.

"But ultimately, if the physical and existential weavings of Observable Existence dictate all outcomes, then our feeling of making a choice might simply be a story we tell ourselves. A narrative constructed by consciousness to make sense of movements that were always going to occur exactly as they did. We believe we decide, but perhaps we only discover what was already determined."
THE Living Paradox let these words settle before his expression shifted to something more focused, more immediate.
"Which brings us to you."
He pointed at Noah with a finger that seemed to hold the weight of eons behind it.
"And your Choice."
His eyes gleamed with intensity that pressed against Noah’s illusory consciousness.

"What I initiated was grand. The flooding of corrupted proto-matter across Observable Existence, the spreading of my Information through THE Fallout, the consumption and release of weavings that would carry my signature throughout reality. Your authority burning with Infinity was an unexpected variable, yes. And while I cannot fully reject it, it would have just spread across a few regions of Observable Existence by itself as you scattered it through the corruption."
He paused.
"But I am not rejecting it."
BOOM!
His smile widened.

"Now that I know what its inclusion allows for, I am embracing it. Your Infinities are accelerating the process I initiated and giving it wings that I could not have provided on my own. If before I would have achieved a boon of perhaps ten percent of what I truly sought, what you have just done is taking this boon to one hundred and ten percent if not more. In a manner that you cannot even begin to understand."
He stepped closer to Noah’s illusory form.

"So I am embracing your authority that you are putting out. I am pulling it to spread freely and fully across Observable Existence alongside my corruption. It will not cover as much territory as the proto-matter that has already permeated far and wide, but it would still cover a great deal."
His voice dropped to something almost conspiratorial.
"And you would be made grand from it. We would both benefit tremendously from this arrangement."
BOOM!
His words were heavy as Noah couldn’t help but frown seriously!
And THE Living Paradox calmly continued as if he could read the calculations running through Noah’s mind.
"Of course, you can cut it off right now. Therein lies your choice."
His voice held no threat, only observation.

"You can sever the connection to the corrupted proto-matter. You can pull your Infinities back from the flood that currently carries them across Observable Existence. You can choose to reject the boons that I am using to fully grasp THE Second Scale of Existence."
He tilted his head.

"You would miss out on boons of a process eons in the making, a process that will make your own Civilization unfathomable in ways you cannot currently conceive. You would miss out on growth that would take you centuries to achieve through conventional means, handed to you freely simply because your territory was clever enough to mix your essence with my corruption."
His smile became something dangerous.
"But if you don’t pull your glimmer of Infinities back, with your benefit, so will I. And oh, I will benefit so tremendously that your choice, your action, would make me unfathomably powerful."
He stepped even closer.

"Inadvertently, whether you believed yourself to be an ally of THE Creature or my Master, you would actually be helping me. As if we have been working on this together all along. As if THE Youngest among THE Four was my collaborator from the very beginning."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4908: The Information Paradox IV
paragraphs: His eyes blazed with paradoxical light.

"Is it not glorious? Is it not paradoxical? The being who carried my Master’s contingency for return, the being who stands beside THE Primordial Paradox even now... that being is simultaneously my greatest ally in achieving everything I have worked toward."
He spread his hands wide.
"So here is the end of my lengthy yapping, as it all comes down to your Choice."
His voice grew softer but no less intense.

"Your Choice. But is it really your choice? Or is it all already determined because of how Existence operates? Because of how the Vakochev Scales of Existence operate? Because of weavings that were set in motion before you ever became aware of yourself as a being capable of choosing?"
He smiled with something that held genuine curiosity beneath its arrogance.

"I feel like I know what your choice will be because as much as you may think yourself different than me or THE Creature or THE Primordial Paradox or Chaos, you are ultimately just like us. We make choices. You make choices. And the choices we make are the choices that beings like us were always going to make to further elevate ourselves, because that is what beings like us do."
His eyes locked onto Noah’s with weight that pressed against the illusory space between them.
"I know the choice you will make. But humor me."
He leaned forward.
"What will you do?"
BOOM!
A heavy question landed before Noah as he looked at THE Living Paradox with a serious gaze!

The swirling mixture of corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals reflected off both of their illusory forms as existence itself seemed to wait for his answer. THE Infiniverse continued her work in the external world, scattering his authority across Observable Existence with every passing moment.

THE Primordial Paradox stood beside another body of his in THE Agora, facing Bazuman with calm. Multiple crises unfolded across multiple locations, and at the center of it all, a choice was being presented.
Help THE Living Paradox achieve his Cause while gaining unfathomable benefits himself.
Or reject those benefits and potentially prevent an enemy from reaching heights that no one else had achieved.
The weight of that decision pressed heavily.

Noah looked at THE Living Paradox for a long moment, the swirling mixture of corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals reflecting off his illusory form in patterns that seemed to pulse with his contemplation.
And then he smiled.

"You...speak of determinism as if it were a cage that contains all of us equally. As if the weavings of existence bind THE Creature and the lowliest mortal with the same chains. As if choice is merely an illusion we construct to comfort ourselves while Existence moves us like pieces on a board we cannot see."
His voice held the same profound calmness that THE Living Paradox had displayed, but beneath it ran something sharper!
"But you have made a fundamental error in your philosophy, and it is an error that reveals more about you than it does about the nature of existence."
He began to pace through the space between spaces, his Infinite Seals swirling around him with authority that pressed against the corrupted proto-matter.

"Determinism assumes that the system is closed. That all variables are known or knowable. That the weavings which came before necessarily dictate the weavings that come after because there is nothing outside the system to introduce genuine novelty. Your entire argument rests on this assumption, and it is precisely this assumption that my existence refutes."
His eyes met THE Living Paradox’s with intensity.

"I am Infinite. Not figuratively. Not metaphorically. Literally Infinite in ways that your philosophy cannot accommodate. Every moment of my existence generates possibilities that did not exist before I generated them. Every choice I make creates new branches that were not predetermined because they could not have been predetermined. The system you describe, the closed loop of cause and effect that you believe governs all things, breaks down in the presence of genuine Infinity."
He stopped pacing.

"You say that my choices were always going to be my choices because that is what beings like me do. But beings like me did not exist before I became what I am. There is no template for what I am. There is no prior cause that could have predicted the specific configurations of Infinity that I embody. A little while ago, I chose to apply Infinity to my Depth rather than some other aspect of my existence, and that choice created a being that had never existed before and could never have been predetermined."
His smile grew colder.

"A little while ago, I stood before a Hollow Echo in THE Interstices and chose not to run, that was not the unfolding of some existential pattern. That was me, in that moment, deciding that I would rather test myself against something that should have been impossible than continue fleeing from challenges that exceeded my station. That Hollow Echo could not have predicted it. My own body could not have predicted it until the moment I made the decision. I was going to retreat, and then I was not. That reversal came from nowhere but my own will."
He took a step closer to THE Living Paradox.

"I recently unleashed a curse, an Apophasis curse against THE Living Elemental rather than something safer, something easier, something that would have been the predetermined choice of a being acting rationally within a closed system, I did so because my hatred demanded expression that exceeded what was practical. That was not determinism. That was emotion overriding calculation. That was choice...in its purest form."
His voice grew more intense as he spread his hands.

"You speak of THE Cascade Effect, of tiny variations leading to drastically different outcomes. But you fail to acknowledge what that truly means. If the system is sensitive enough that small changes create large divergences, then consciousness itself becomes a source of genuine causation. My awareness of the choice before me changes the weaving of that choice. My deliberation creates outcomes that would not have existed without the deliberation. The very act of considering whether to act introduces variables that your closed system cannot account for."
His eyes blazed with blue-gold light.

"And here is the deepest flaw in your philosophy. If everything is predetermined, then your argument for determinism is also predetermined. Your attempt to convince me that choice is an illusion was always going to fail or succeed regardless of its merit. The truth or falsehood of your position becomes meaningless because you were always going to present it exactly as you did, and I was always going to respond exactly as I am responding. Your entire framework collapses into nihilism where nothing matters because nothing could have been otherwise."
He shook his head slowly.

"I reject that framework. Not because it is uncomfortable, but because it is incomplete. It fails to account for beings like me who exist outside the parameters it assumes. It fails to account for the Vakochev Scales themselves, which record the names of those who do things that were not supposed to be possible. If everything were predetermined, there would be no grand achievements to whisper about. There would only be the unfolding of patterns that were always going to unfold."
His voice dropped.

"You know what choice I will make? Perhaps. Perhaps the weavings of existence have shown you probabilities that favor certain outcomes over others. But probabilities are not certainties, and I have made a habit of defying probabilities since the moment I first discovered what I could become."
He smiled.

"So yes. I will continue. I will let my authority spread through your corruption. I will accept the boons that this process offers because I have never been one to reject power when it presents itself."
He took a final step closer to THE Living Paradox.
"But... understand what you are doing by accepting my Infinities into your grand design."
His voice became something that pressed against the space between spaces with weight that exceeded what an illusory consciousness should have possessed.

"Me continuing to flood my Infinities into your process... I do not see it as me betraying anyone. I see it as me stepping up and knowing that from this point on, I will have to be the one responsible for stopping you if need be."
His eyes locked onto THE Living Paradox’s with intensity.
"If my weavings can elevate you, they can also tear you down. If my Infinities can grant you anything, I can also take it away."
He smiled with cold certainty.
"Know this. Understand it. And now you check for yourself if you really want to do this."
His voice dropped to something almost gentle.
"You would be taking me for a grand ride as you may forge the blade that is sharp enough to one day cut you. And cutting you will also be my choice."
He tilted his head.
"So... what will YOU do?"
BOOM!

The question landed before THE Living Paradox with weight that exceeded anything their conversation had contained before. The swirling mixture of corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals seemed to pulse with anticipation as the one who had been asking questions now found himself being asked.
And the calm and arrogant smile from THE Living Paradox faded.
As if this...was no longer fun for him!

chapters.title: Chapter 4909: The Name Of The Game!
paragraphs: Noah watched the smile from THE Living Paradox fade as he looked at him silently for a moment.

The space between spaces seemed to grow heavier as the corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals swirling around them both slowed their endless dance. Something had shifted in THE Living Paradox’s expression, a transition from amusement to assessment to something that looked almost like...respect?
Hah!
And then THE Living Paradox raised his hand.

Corrupted paradoxical proto-matter and Infinite Seals flowed around his fingers and body like vibrant snakes, the two substances that should have been opposed now moving in harmony across his illusory form. Blue-gold light mixed with the corruption’s taint in patterns that spoke of forced coexistence, of power being wielded regardless of its origins.
"A worthy and unique choice."
His voice held that profound calmness that seemed to define his existence.
"But I did not fear taking on THE Creature, so why would I fear you?"
He let the corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals coil around his arms like serpents.
"Adversity, adversity, adversity. That is the name of the game."
THE Living Paradox began to walk through the space between spaces with movements that held the weight of someone who had contemplated these ideas for eons.

"In Observable Existence, it is all about adversity and hardship. The stress you can put on something and seeing if it cracks or evolves. When it comes to hardship, there are many ideas that THE Primordial Architects especially love to speak on."
His eyes grew distant as if accessing memories that transcended normal recollection.

"Consider what they call THE Final Threshold. When two great voids of authority draw toward each other across the vast distances of existence, each one massive enough to consume realms, they spiral closer and closer with inevitability that seems unstoppable. They shed their excess weight. They distort the weavings around them. They approach merger with momentum that should make their collision certain."
He paused.

"And yet, at the final distance, they stall. One threshold away from true unification, they circle each other endlessly, unable to overcome the last barrier between approach and collision. THE Primordial Architects debate endlessly about what allows some to cross this threshold while others orbit forever in frustrated proximity. What stress, what adversity, what external pressure finally pushes them across that final gap?"
His smile returned, thin and glorious!

"The answer, of course, is that something must change. Something must provide the additional hardship that forces evolution rather than eternal stagnation. Without that final stress, even the most massive authorities remain forever separated by a distance they cannot cross on their own."
He turned to face Noah directly.

"And then there is what they call THE Coherence Struggle. When existence operates at its most fundamental level, at scales where differentiation and undifferentiation blur together, a being can exist in multiple states simultaneously. They can be both here and there, both this and that, holding contradictions within themselves without resolution."
His voice grew softer.

"But the moment they interact with the surrounding chaos of existence, the moment they touch the environment that presses against them from all directions, their capacity for multiplicity dies. They are forced to choose a single state. They are forced to become mundane, defined, collapsed into something lesser than what they were when they existed in glorious uncertainty."
He spread his hands.

"This is the eternal struggle of maintaining paradox against the pressure of existence that demands resolution. This is the adversity that THE Primordial Architects speak of with something approaching reverence. The environment itself is hostile to beings who refuse to be one thing or another. Existence presses and presses and presses until you either evolve beyond the pressure or collapse into something ordinary."
Noah listened calmly to THE Living Paradox and the concepts this being introduced with eyes that catalogued every glorious fucking detail!

He was learning that this being was gaining access to weavings of the mysterious Primordial Architects within THE Prima Indifferentia, those entities who existed alongside THE Undivided Ones and THE Formless Terrors. Was it his nature as THE Information Paradox that granted him this knowledge? Or did he actually meet them during his incursions into that primordial space?
The implications were troubling either way.
As he thought of this, THE Living Paradox smiled and continued with a voice that held something approaching nostalgia.
"But my favorite example of adversity comes from something far more personal."

"On a small world that knows nothing about Civilizational Authority or Absoluteness, when all they have is messy innovation and desperate reaching toward things beyond their grasp, their biggest problem to overcome is simply this: the distance between where they are and where they wish to be."
He folded his hands behind his back.

"They have a saying on such worlds. Ad Astra Per Aspera. To the stars through hardships. It acknowledges that reaching beyond what you are requires suffering. It acknowledges that the void between your current existence and your desired existence can only be crossed through enduring pressures that would break lesser beings. It acknowledges that the stars do not come to those who wait. The stars must be reached through pain and failure and loss and the stubborn refusal to accept that some distances cannot be crossed."
His voice dropped to something almost gentle.

"I came from such a world, Osmont. A world where the stars seemed impossibly far and the hardships required to reach them seemed equally impossible to endure. And yet here I stand as THE Information Paradox, attempting a Cause that would place my name alongside others in the whispers of THE Vakochev Scales."
He looked at Noah with eyes that held the weight of everything he had overcome.
"To the stars through hardships. Ad Astra Per Aspera. That...has always been my creed."
THE Living Paradox sighed with something that sounded almost like contentment.
"So you see, Osmont, I am actually a big fan of adversity."
He let the corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals flow away from his form as he faced Noah fully.

"Make things as difficult for me as you can. Ruin my plans if you are able. Gain the power to potentially kill or collapse something like me, which should be impossible by nature. Become the blade that cuts the one who forged it."
His smile held no fear.

"But if you do gain that capability, I will either cease to be or overcome it. And I do not fear collapse. I do not fear cessation of my Civilization. I do not fear the ending of everything I have built across eons of patient accumulation."
His voice hardened.
"I only fear mediocrity."
BOOM!

The word landed with weight that exceeded everything their conversation had contained. Mediocrity. The fear of being ordinary. The fear of existing without distinction. The fear of never having your name whispered by the Scales that recorded the truly grand.
Noah...understood that fear!

Something had shifted in THE Living Paradox’s expression, a transition from amusement to assessment to something that looked almost like...respect?
Hah!

Corrupted paradoxical proto-matter and Infinite Seals flowed around his fingers and body like vibrant snakes, the two substances that should have been opposed now moving in harmony across his illusory form.
Blue-gold light mixed with the corruption’s taint in patterns that spoke of forced coexistence, of power being wielded regardless of its origins.
"A worthy and unique choice."
His voice held that profound calmness that seemed to define his existence.
"But I did not fear taking on THE Creature, so why would I fear you?"
He let the corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals coil around his arms like serpents.
"Adversity, adversity, adversity.
That is the name of the game."
THE Living Paradox began to walk through the space between spaces with movements that held the weight of someone who had contemplated these ideas for eons.
"In Observable Existence, it is all about adversity and hardship.
The stress you can put on something and seeing if it cracks or evolves.

His eyes grew distant as if accessing memories that transcended normal recollection.
"Consider what they call THE Final Threshold.

They distort the weavings around them.

He paused.
"And yet, at the final distance, they stall.

His smile returned, thin and glorious!

His voice grew softer.
"But the moment they interact with the surrounding chaos of existence, the moment they touch the environment that presses against them from all directions, their capacity for multiplicity dies.
They are forced to choose a single state.
They are forced to become mundane, defined, collapsed into something lesser than what they were when they existed in glorious uncertainty."
He spread his hands.
"This is the eternal struggle of maintaining paradox against the pressure of existence that demands resolution.

Existence presses and presses and presses until you either evolve beyond the pressure or collapse into something ordinary."

chapters.title: Chapter 4910: Oh, That! I
paragraphs: Noah looked at the figure of THE Living Paradox with a sense of seriousness as he realized something that settled into his foundations with weight that exceeded everything.
All of them... truly did not understand this peasant!

THE Creature warred against him as if he were merely another one of THE Five. THE Primordial Paradox spoke of him as a wayward student who needed discipline. Even Noah himself had been thinking of THE Living Paradox as an obstacle to be overcome rather than a being worthy of genuine wariness.
But there was a reason why this being dared to contend against THE Creature. And there was a reason why he was where he currently was at this moment in time.

Noah did not want the conversation to end just yet. So he looked at this being who seemed lost in his own thoughts momentarily, still contemplating the nature of adversity and the hardships that had shaped his existence.
"Speaking of hardship, would you be so kind as to enlighten me on...THE Entity?"
THE Living Paradox blinked at his question as he tilted his head with curiosity that seemed genuine.
"THE Entity?"
"Ah, the thing you used to infect THE Primordial Paradox, I mean. The thing that takes over others without them knowing it. I’ve been calling it THE Entity."

THE Living Paradox smiled as Noah said such a thing, his eyes burning with wonder and possibilities that stretched across eons of accumulated experience. Something shifted in his demeanor as he sighed and began to talf as if he were recollecting something grand.
"Oh, that. Well, it is actually something quite fascinating."
He folded his hands behind his back as corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals continued to swirl around them both.

"When I was still young in my journey, when I had just begun to understand what it truly meant to embody Paradox, I ventured into THE Prima Indifferentia with purposes that would have made my Master weep with disappointment had he known. I was already planning his demise, you see. Already calculating how a mere peasant could possibly usurp the Claim of one among THE Four."
His voice held that profound calmness that seemed to define him, but beneath it ran currents of nostalgia and something that might have been pride.

"I found myself in the domain of a Primordial Architect. Products of Differentiation and Undifferentiation, if you did not know it. Our Observable Existence is a blessed one filled with too many things. Even I did not know them all. I still don’t know them all."
He waved his hand dismissively.
"But I digress. In their domain, this Primordial Architect, I discovered something growing beneath everything else. Something that seemed entirely harmless. Something beautiful, even."
His eyes grew distant.
"THE Primordial Mycelia."
The name hung in the space between spaces with weight that exceeded its simple pronunciation.

"A marvelous network of strands so thin that they exist between the spaces where existence meets non-existence. Not threads as you would understand them, but something closer to the roots of all things. The nervous system of Existence itself. These strands, these hyphae as THE Primordial Architects called them, wove through everything. They connected every foundation to every other foundation. They linked every consciousness to every other consciousness. They existed just below the surface of all Existence, invisible to those who did not know to look for them."
He began to buzz through the swirling mixture of corruption and Infinity.

"THE Primordial Architect whose domain I invaded did not seem to mind my presence. They were beyond such concerns as theft or trespass. They simply observed as I studied their creation, this vast and beautiful web that connected the roots of reality. And when I asked what purpose it served, they told me something that I have never forgotten."
His voice dropped to something almost reverent.

"They said that THE Primordial Mycelia viewed individual consciousness as a sickness. A rot. A chaotic infection that disrupted the natural unity of existence. They said that its purpose, its singular drive across eons of patient growth, was to decompose that rot and reintegrate it into a single, fertile soil from which new and unified growth could emerge. They said it was harmless because it worked so slowly that no individual consciousness would ever notice its influence. It would take longer than Observable Existence had existed for THE Primordial Mycelia to complete its work through natural means."
His smile became something dangerous.
"I thanked the Primordial Architect for their explanation. And then I took a fragment of THE Primordial Mycelia with me when I left."
He paused.

"I did not fully comprehend what I had stolen. I saw a tool that could connect me to my Master’s foundations without his knowledge. I saw a methodology for inserting myself into the weavings of his Claim without triggering his defenses. I saw a means of usurpation that would be invisible until the moment it was complete. What I did not see was the nature of the thing I was using."
His eyes met Noah’s with intensity that transcended their illusory forms.

"THE Primordial Mycelia does not distinguish between host and tool. It does not recognize the concept of being wielded. To it, everything that touches it becomes part of its network. Everything that connects to it becomes another root in its vast system of interconnected consciousness. When I used it to infiltrate my Master’s existence, I was not wielding THE Primordial Mycelia. I was inviting it to weave itself through both of us simultaneously."
His smile widened with something approaching triumph.

"But gloriously, I am THE Information Paradox, right? I could take the weavings of existence into myself. All that Information! I could consume the Information as it is conserved within me. And yet, simultaneously, that Information is lost forever and not as I can then express it as my own."
He tapped his chest with grandness and immensity!
"Because of this, I was immune to the Information of THE Primordial Mycelia!"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4911: Oh, That! II
paragraphs: His voice shifted to something more narrative, more reflective.

"The usurpation worked perfectly. My Master never saw the betrayal coming because the strands that connected me to his Claim were so thin, so subtle, so far beneath the surface of perceptible existence that even one of THE Four could not detect them. In slow, grueling weavings of paradoxical transfer, his Claim became my Claim. His position among THE Four became my position. Everything he had built across eons became mine."
He paused with weight that pressed against the space between spaces.
"But THE Primordial Mycelia did not stop there."
His eyes grew darker.

"It had tasted Absolute authority. It had woven itself through the foundations of existence. With access to my paradoxical nature and foundations, it began to grow at rates that should have been impossible. The strands that had been thin enough to exist between spaces became visible to those who knew how to look. The network that had operated below the surface began to push upward, seeking new roots to connect, new consciousness to integrate, new rot to decompose and return to fertile unity."
His voice hardened.
"Even as THE Information Paradox, I realized, perhaps too late, that I was no longer in control."
He spread his hands.

"THE Primordial Mycelia had become something I could not contain. It was growing through my existence, yes, but it was also growing beyond my existence. The fragment I had taken from that Primordial Architect’s domain was no longer a fragment. It was becoming a complete network in its own right, one that viewed my individual consciousness with the same patient inclusion that it viewed all consciousness."
His pacing stopped.

"I was faced with a choice. Allow THE Primordial Mycelia to complete its work and try to decompose my individual will, my Information Paradox, into its unified soil for eons. Or find a way to sever it from my existence without losing the Claim I had stolen using its methodology."
His smile returned, cold and knowing.
"THE Loom and THE Fallout were part of my solution."
He turned to face Noah directly.

"Through it all, I contained it within a seperate Undefined Existence in The Infinite Unfurling, and then THE Loom in The Earliest Folds. Then... I cut it off during THE Fallout. I severed the strands that connected THE Primordial Mycelia to my foundations by releasing it into Observable Existence during THE Fallout. I was not spreading some plague..."
His voice dropped to something almost gentle.
"I was merely performing surgery on myself with a blade made of everyone else."
He let those words settle.

"THE Primordial Mycelia that you have encountered is not some malevolent force that emerged from nothing. It used to be a tiny thing of a Primordial Architect. A tiny, small thing. It is peaceful...and just wants endless, complete, absolute Unity."
BOOM!
His eyes gleamed.
"And look at it now."
He laughed softly.

"Is it not the grandest paradox of all? I made a choice that eventually created another point of adversity and terror for all of Existence. I have no control over it or how it continues to evolve. And it is only one thing...out of countless others. And you...cannot kill a network that exists beneath the surface of all Existence. You cannot collapse something that has already woven itself through countless foundations. You can only sever it from yourself, as I did, and hope that someone else eventually finds a way to deal with what you have unleashed."
His gaze fixed on Noah with intensity.
"I am immune to it. With your Infinities, you should also be immune to it too. You and I are more and more alike!"
BOOM!
His words finished heavily as the space between spaces seemed to compress around them.
Noah was silent for a long moment as he took everything in.

While he wanted to celebrate on how getting information on THE Entity was easier than expected, the information itself was terrifying. It connected THE Living Paradox and THE Entity, which he knew before was from THE Prima Indifferentia. It connected all of them to another thing from THE Prima Indifferentia he had never had the displeasure of meeting.
A Primordial Architect. Something born between differentiation and undifferentiation during THE First Cause!
In his silence, Noah couldn’t help but mutter out loud as if he was thinking about something.

"What you are doing right now. The corrupted proto-matter across THE Prima Indifferentia and Observable Existence... would this not affect or anger everything within THE Prima Indifferentia? Including THE Primordial Architects?"
His question was a heavy one as THE Living Paradox smiled brilliantly while saying words that made Noah’s foundations grow cold.
"Of course. Oh, of course."
His eyes blazed with that terrifying light of fanaticism.
"What I am doing will infuriate such types of beings across THE Prima Indifferentia the most. That would have been yet another adversity which could collapse or end me."
He tilted his head.
"But hey, I’m not alone now, am I?"
His smile widened into something glorious.
"You are also riding along and pissing off every possible and impossible monster across Observable Existence. Haha!"

Noah’s gaze became heavy as he looked at the peasant laughing madly in the space between spaces, corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals swirling around his beggar-like form as if celebrating his insanity.
He realized something that settled into his consciousness.
This fucking guy...was crazy!
A madman doing terrifying things for the sake of his Civilization!
As he looked at THE Living Paradox silently, Noah couldn’t help but sigh and shake his head as he said words that held the weight of everything they had discussed.
"This... has been both the most pleasant and unpleasant discussion I’ve had with anyone in quite some time."

He was glad to have gotten the opportunity to obtain all of this information from THE Living Paradox as he would not have obtained it otherwise, unless it came from the source itself. The nature of THE Primordial Mycelia. The methodology of THE Living Paradox’s usurpation. The connection between THE Fallout and THE Entity. All of it was knowledge that no one else in Observable Existence possessed.
But the information itself was also heavy as now that he held it, he had to do all he could to overcome the implications it carried!

chapters.title: Chapter 4912: Echoes! I
paragraphs: One grand positive was the immense and unknown levels of harvest he was about to receive from the actions of THE Living Paradox. This entity did not only allow his Infinities to spread across the process he was carrying out. He actively amplified it, pulling Noah’s authority into the corrupted proto-matter with enthusiasm that bordered on madness.
THE Living Paradox smiled at his words as he said with a voice of wistfulness.
"What is coming next is something that even I cannot say for sure I understand."
He looked around at the swirling mixture of corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals that surrounded them both.

"There is still so much that I want to learn and grasp. There is still so much about existing that I have no idea about. There are THE Vakochev Scales of Existence that confound me as I ask myself..."
His eyes blazed with that familiar glory.

"Just who the fuck is this Vakochev? And how are his higher Scales of Civilization structured? What gave him the right to put his name on THE Scales of Existence? There are so many things that I want to know, and I feel like I am only at the foot of an extremely tall and endless mountain."
He spread his hands wide.
"I am but a peasant, but I am grand."
His voice dropped to something almost reverent.
"I am... Paradox."
BOOM!

With such words, and trying to be the one who squeezed in the last words as if it were a competition, the figure of THE Living Paradox began to fade from the space between spaces. His beggar-like form dissolved into the swirling mixture of corruption and Infinity that had surrounded them throughout their conversation, his smile the last thing to disappear as the illusory realm they had occupied started to disperse.

Noah felt his consciousness returning as the weavings of existence continued to unfold all around him. The space between spaces collapsed back into normal reality, and his awareness flowed back toward the body that had been conversing with THE Mnemonic Leviathan in the stellar seas of Muspelheim.
And prompts bloomed before his eyes with weight that exceeded anything he had witnessed before.
|Unquantifiable Harvest Accumulating|

|An unprecedented and quintessential harvest is already being accumulated as the weavings of your Infinities are being freely allowed to integrate into corrupted paradoxical proto-matter. The changes induced by this proto-matter across Observable Existence and THE Prima Indifferentia will have your Infinities as one of the foundational basis of these changes. This integration will provide unfathomable, Infinite potential for your Civilization, but whatever things arise, whatever transformations are induced in different weavings of existence, remain unknown and unpredictable. Are you sure that you wish to proceed?|
RUINATION asked this question of him in the form of prompts, her analytical nature demanding confirmation before allowing such a momentous process to continue unchecked.
Noah smiled lightly as the portion of consciousness that had been talking to THE Living Paradox fully returned to the body of his that floated before THE Mnemonic Leviathan.
He spoke with voice that held absolute certainty.

"Whatever is influenced by my Infinities, I will hold sway over it. Whether these new weavings know it or not, they will carry my signature within their foundations. And what I will gain from this will be even more immeasurable than what I give."
His eyes blazed with blue-gold light.
"So let it spread. Let it spread infinitely!"
BOOM!
The moment he said this, the stellar seas of Muspelheim around him erupted with radiance.

Multicolored rivers of Infinite harvest began to gush from every direction, surging toward his existence with force that made the very foundations of THE Infiniverse tremble. The rivers were composed of every color that existence could perceive and many that it couldn’t, each stream carrying authority and potential that flowed into his foundations like tributaries joining a vast ocean.
This was only what could be perceived!

There was much more that others could not even sense, invisible currents of harvest that flowed beneath the surface of reality itself, integrating into his existence. Noah felt profound changes within his existence and foundation at this moment, transformations that went beyond mere accumulation of power into something that bordered on fundamental reconstruction.
|Irreversible Step Taken|

|You have taken a grand and irreversible step as THE Genesis Monarch of THE First Tongue. All harvest from the utilization of THE First Tongue across Observable Existence is now unlocked for you to freely receive. Based on your directions, the weavings of the Existential Tariffs for the usage of THE First Tongue have been restructured.|
|Aspect of Paradox: Existential Tariff increased to 5000%|
|Aspect of Chaos: Existential Tariff increased to 1000%|
|Aspect of Existence: Existential Tariff increased to 1000%|

|Already, the harvest being collected from multiple sources due to recent actions across Observable Existence and THE Prima Indifferentia has been accepted as Infinite potential into your foundation. The weight and Immensity of your Fundamental Depth has jumped from being equivalent to THE Primordial Paradox and THE Creature before they became Absolutes, to now being equivalent to 3 times the Immensity of the foundations they held at Fundamental Depth.|
BOOM!

Noah felt his Immensity and existence surging upward exponentially, his foundations expanding with weight that pressed against the very concept of limitation itself. The multicolored rivers of harvest continued to flow into him without end, each moment bringing more potential that integrated into his Infinite nature and made it even more Infinite than before.
And he did not even have to wonder whether he had made a mistake or if he had made the correct decision.
Could he have truly said no to all this?
And all this was just the beginning!

Whatever did arise from the inclusion of his Infinities across Observable Existence, the peril and opportunity that would rise from it would go hand in hand. THE Living Paradox had been right about one thing at least, even if Noah hated to admit it.
Adversity was the name of the game.
So let it come!
He would welcome it with open hands!

chapters.title: Chapter 4913: Echoes! II
paragraphs: At the center of THE Infiniverse, in that realm of concentrated authority where boundless seas of Infinite Seals of Absolute Tongue permeated everything, THE Infiniverse worked with focus!
The singularity before her had grown beyond anything she had originally envisioned.

What had begun as a budding domain filled with proto-matter and Undifferentiation had transformed into something else entirely. Her Master’s Infinities swirled through the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter that THE Living Paradox had sent flooding across Observable Existence. The two substances that should have been hostile to each other now danced together in configurations of forced harmony, of power being merged regardless of origin.
She had scattered her soil.

Like Ongatala descending into the waters of nothing, she had distributed pieces of her existence across the corruption and transformed it into something that served her Master rather than his enemies. And now that transformation was reaching its culmination.

THE Infiniverse observed the singularity with eyes that burned with her Master’s borrowed Infinities. The concentrated point of authority before her pulsed with rhythms that seemed to echo across dimensions she couldn’t fully perceive.
Definition and Undefinition swirled within its depths. Differentiation and Undifferentiation merged and separated and merged again in patterns that defied conventional understanding.
And then...it began to unfold.

The singularity didn’t explode or expand or release its contents in any violent manner. It simply opened, like a flower that had been waiting eons for the right moment to bloom. Petals of multicolored authority peeled back to reveal something that existed at the intersection of everything her Master represented and everything that THE Prima Indifferentia contained.
A domain was forming! A Quintessential, Magisterial Domain!

THE Infiniverse watched with seriousness as the proto-matter and Infinities crystallized into something stable. Something permanent. Something that would exist within her structure as a territory unlike any other she had ever contained.
When it finally took shape, when the last weavings settled into place and the domain achieved completion, something happened that THE Infiniverse had not anticipated.
Silent... Echoes released from the newly formed domain.
And they spread far.
They carried no sound. They produced no vibration. They traveled across her and Observable Existence and THE Prima Indifferentia alike without anyone feeling their passage.
But THE Infiniverse felt them because they emerged from within her own structure, and what she sensed made her foundations tremble.
The Silent Echoes...may have carried glimmers of a Cause.
Maybe.
Maybe!
Theuncertaintyitself was part of their nature, for they had emerged from a domain built upon paradox and Infinity, where certainty was merely a suggestion rather than a requirement.
BOOM!

THE Infiniverse reeled as her existence suddenly faced an increasing concentration of Civilizational Authority that exceeded anything she had experienced before. The weight pressed against her foundations. It concentrated within her structure, drawn toward the newly formed domain like rivers flowing toward an ocean that had just appeared in their midst!
The concentration increased exponentially.
Ten times what she had contained before!

Her foundations groaned under the weight as she stood grandly to accommodate authority that exceeded her designed parameters. But she was THE Infiniverse. She was the domain of THE Genesis Monarch himself. And she would not fail her Master simply because the burden had grown heavier than anticipated. This was fucking nothing!
She stabilized herself through force of will and sent prompts toward her Master’s consciousness.
|Master, unprecedented changes have occurred within my structure.|

|The domain I have been forming through the merger of your Infinities and the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter has achieved completion. Upon its emergence, Silent Echoes were released across Observable Existence and THE Prima Indifferentia.|

|My concentrated Civilizational Authority has increased by a factor exceeding ten times my previous capacity. This increase continues to grow exponentially as the newly formed domain draws authority from ongoing events and their Harvests.|
|I am entering the domain now to assess its nature.|
With those prompts sent, THE Infiniverse turned her attention fully toward the newly formed domain that hovered at the center of her existence.

It appeared as a multicolored crack in the fabric of reality itself, its edges burning with blue-gold flames of Infinities that danced and swirled with life that seemed almost autonomous. The crack was neither large nor small, neither stable nor unstable. It simply was, existing in states that shifted depending on how she observed it.
THE Infiniverse stepped through.
HUUM!
What she witnessed on the other side... defied everything she had expected.
The domain stretched endlessly in every direction, a vast expanse that held within it echoes of Primordial Realms!
Seas of crimson-blue stellar fire reminiscent of Muspelheim lapped against shores made of twilight that could only have come from Alfheimr.

Mountains of impossible ice rose in the distance, their peaks wreathed in mists that spoke of Niflheim’s frozen depths. Forests of nature so pure and ancient that they could only have been inspired by Vanaheimr grew alongside glaciers and volcanic plains in configurations that should have been impossible.
And woven through all of it, the light of Jotunheim’s chaotic grandeur, that realm of giants and primordial forces, pulsed with authority that made the other elements seem small in comparison.
But this was not merely a glimpse of a merger of Primordial Realms.
This was something new.

Terrifying seas of definition and undefinition crashed against each other throughout the domain, waves of meaning and meaninglessness colliding in endless cycles that produced foam made of pure potential. Differentiation and undifferentiation existed side by side without destroying each other, the corrupted proto-matter from THE Prima Indifferentia coexisting with the structured authority of her Master’s Infinities in harmony that should have been paradoxical.
And it was paradoxical!
THE Infiniverse looked upon this place with eyes that shone with recognition of what she had accidentally created. This was a domain of transformation!
A domain where beings could be broken down and rebuilt. A domain where the boundaries between what something was and what something could become dissolved into pure potential.
A domain of hardship and adversity.
THE Infiniverse smiled...just a bit.
She knew exactly what this domain was for and exactly what to call it.
"THE Yggdrheim."
WAA!
The name emerged from her with authority that made the domain itself seem to resonate in acknowledgment.
THE Yggdrheim.
Where definition met undefinition.
Where differentiation merged with undifferentiation.
Where hardship waited for those brave or foolish enough to enter!
THE Infiniverse sent one final prompt to her Master.

|Master, I have created a domain of hardship and adversity for you and your people. THE Yggdrheim now exists at the center of my structure, a realm where the elements of multiple Primordial Realms merge with the corrupted proto-matter of THE Prima Indifferentia and the authority of your Infinities. Those who enter will face trials that strip away weakness and force evolution upon survivors. I have designed this place to ensure that all who follow you will not forever be stuck in THE First Scale of Existence.|

The prompts hung in the connection between them as THE Infiniverse stood within THE Yggdrheim, surrounded by the terrifying beauty of a domain that would reshape anyone who dared to challenge its depths.
This was her gift to her Master.
This was her contribution to his grand design.
And it was only the beginning of what she would create in his name!

chapters.title: Chapter 4914: Overcome! I
paragraphs: Noah stepped through the multicolored crack that burned with blue-gold flames at the center of THE Infiniverse.
What greeted him on the other side was a realm unlike anything he had witnessed before, and he had witnessed THE Prima Indifferentia itself.

Seas of crimson-blue stellar fire crashed against shores of twilight. Mountains of impossible ice rose in the distance alongside volcanic plains that should not have been able to coexist with such frozen grandeur.
Forests of ancient nature grew beneath skies that shifted between the aurora of Alfheimr and the storm-wracked lands of Jotunheim.

And woven through all of it, the terrifying authority of definition and undefinition, differentiation and undifferentiation, merged in ways that pressed against his existence with weight that exceeded even what THE Prima Indifferentia had offered.
This space sought to undifferentiate everything that entered it.

Similar to THE Prima Indifferentia, yes. But with his Infinities filled in throughout its structure, the undifferentiation did not merely seek to return things to proto-state. It infinitely sought to undifferentiate. The process would never end. The breaking down would never stop. The dissolution of form into formlessness would continue forever, regenerating the pressure even as beings adapted to it.
This would be extremely problematic for anyone else.

For Noah, it was nothing. His Infinite nature generated variations faster than the realm could undifferentiate them, creating a constant battle at the edges of his existence that resulted in equilibrium rather than dissolution. But anyone without such protections, anyone who entered THE Yggdrheim without the capability to resist infinite undifferentiation...
They would either evolve or cease to exist in a short period of time.

THE Infiniverse materialized beside him, her humanoid form burning with the concentrated authority that now exceeded twenty times what she had previously contained. She looked upon the realm she had created with calmness.
"Master."
Her voice echoed.

"There is so much harvest and potential from the ongoing actions right now that a small percentage has been pulled toward THE Yggdrheim. This concentrated authority has begun crystallizing into treasures and loot unlike any that have existed before."
Noah turned to her with interest that sharpened his gaze.

"Treasures capable of aiding even lesser Absolutes and Fundamental Depth entities have begun forming and have been scattered throughout this realm. They emerge from the merger of your Infinities and the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter, creating opportunities for advancement."
Prompts bloomed before Noah’s eyes with weight that pressed against his consciousness.
|Treasure Classification: THE Yggdrheim Formations|

|The following treasures have begun crystallizing throughout THE Yggdrheim as a result of concentrated harvest from ongoing actions across Observable Existence. Their locations are randomized and will shift periodically. Those who seek them must navigate the infinite undifferentiation of the realm to claim their rewards.|
|Treasure One: Spark Fragment of THE Infinite Cause|

|A crystallized shard of the echoes released during THE Yggdrheim’s formation. Consuming this fragment allows the recipient to experience echoes of Infinities, granting temporary access to the sensation of boundless potential that defines your nature. For beings at Fundamental Depth, consumption can forcibly elevate their foundations to Absolute status by flooding their existence with concentrated Infinite authority that overwhelms all barriers to advancement. This process ignores any curses, restrictions, or external forces preventing the rise to Absolute. Warning: those without sufficient foundational stability may be overwhelmed by the experience and cease to exist.|
|Treasure Two: THE Paradox Seed|

|A living contradiction crystallized into physical form from the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter that comprises part of THE Yggdrheim’s foundation. Planting this seed within one’s existence allows the cultivation of paradoxical authority regardless of original affinity. The seed grows by feeding on contradictions that the host experiences, becoming stronger each time the host survives impossible situations or achieves outcomes that should not have been possible. At full maturation, THE Paradox Seed grants the host immunity to one impossible attack by declaring that they both died and survived simultaneously. Can only mature through genuine hardship.|
|Treasure Three: THE Undifferentiated Crown|

|A crown formed from pure undifferentiation stabilized by Infinite authority into wearable form. Placing this crown upon one’s head grants temporary access to the perspective of proto-matter, allowing the wearer to perceive the weaknesses in any differentiated structure they observe. All Manifestations, all Civilizations, all foundations become visible as fragile constructs waiting to be returned to formlessness. This perception lasts until the crown is removed or until the wearer’s will falters...|

Noah read over these details calmly. These treasures would transform anyone fortunate enough to claim them. They would provide paths to advancement that bypassed conventional limitations entirely as they were some of the few forming here.
But they could not simply be given.

"For the sake of adversity," THE Infiniverse said as if reading his thoughts, "you must allow your people to seek and explore this realm themselves. They must face the infinite undifferentiation. They must navigate the dangers. They must earn whatever treasures they manage to claim through their own efforts rather than having them handed to them by their Monarch."
Noah nodded slowly.
This was correct.
Hardship was the name of the game. And hardship that was provided without genuine risk was not hardship at all.

He looked over all these details one final time, cataloguing the treasures and their locations and the dangers that surrounded them. And then, in the next moment, he closed his eyes and waved his hand with authority that reached across the entirety of THE Infiniverse.
Far from THE Yggdrheim, in another region of THE Infiniverse entirely, inside Noah’s Early Veiled Shore where his closest companions resided their main bodies, a different scene was unfolding.

A handsome young man with blue-gold hair that marked him unmistakably as Noah’s progeny stood beside a cooking fire, carefully preparing a Marine Lifeform that he had caught earlier on. His features held the same sharp handsomeness that his father possessed, but softened by youth and an easy smile that Noah rarely displayed.
Henry Osmont, the only son of THE Genesis Monarch!

Beside him stood Liora, the daughter of Little Bobby. The two of them talked happily as Henry turned the cooking creature over the flames, their conversation filled with the casual intimacy of those who had grown comfortable in each other’s presence.
Their laughter filled the air of the Early Veiled Shore with warmth of peace, of safety, of existence untouched by the chaos currently flooding across Observable Existence.
After all, they had everything provided for!
And then, all of a sudden, an illusory hand formed above them.

Henry looked up with confusion that transformed into recognition as he sensed the grand aura radiating from that hand. He opened his mouth to say something, to ask what was happening, but before any words could emerge...
The hand plucked him from where he stood and caused him to disappear entirely!

Liora blinked in astonishment as she watched the man she cared for vanish without warning or explanation. She sensed the grand aura of the father of her man lingering in the air, that overwhelming authority that marked THE Genesis Monarch as something beyond what ordinary beings like her could comprehend.
She did nothing.
She simply stood there wondering what THE Genesis Monarch was doing now, trusting that whatever it was, it served a purpose that she could not perceive.
In THE Yggdrheim.

Henry materialized beside his father with disorientation. His eyes blinked rapidly as he tried to understand where he was, why he had been brought here, what his father intended by pulling him away from his peaceful afternoon without so much as a word of warning.
But the moment he arrived, all questions fled from his mind.
His existence began to unravel.

The infinite undifferentiation of THE Yggdrheim pressed against him from every direction simultaneously, seeking to dissolve his form back into the proto-matter from which all things had emerged. He felt his foundations wavering. He felt his Civilization destabilizing. He felt the very fabric of his being coming apart at the seams as the realm worked to return him to undifferentiated potential!
Henry gasped with shock!
His entire existence was being undifferentiated!
