Mountains of impossible ice rose in the distance alongside volcanic plains that should not have been able to coexist with such frozen grandeur.
Forests of ancient nature grew beneath skies that shifted between the aurora of Alfheimr and the storm-wracked lands of Jotunheim.

And woven through all of it, the terrifying authority of definition and undefinition, differentiation and undifferentiation, merged in ways that pressed against his existence with weight that exceeded even what THE Prima Indifferentia had offered.
This space sought to undifferentiate everything that entered it.
Similar to THE Prima Indifferentia, yes.
But with his Infinities filled in throughout its structure, the undifferentiation did not merely seek to return things to proto-state.
It infinitely sought to undifferentiate.
The process would never end.
The breaking down would never stop.
The dissolution of form into formlessness would continue forever, regenerating the pressure even as beings adapted to it.
This would be extremely problematic for anyone else.
For Noah, it was nothing.

His Infinite nature generated variations faster than the realm could undifferentiate them, creating a constant battle at the edges of his existence that resulted in equilibrium rather than dissolution.
But anyone without such protections, anyone who entered THE Yggdrheim without the capability to resist infinite undifferentiation...
They would either evolve or cease to exist in a short period of time.
THE Infiniverse materialized beside him, her humanoid form burning with the concentrated authority that now exceeded twenty times what she had previously contained.
She looked upon the realm she had created with calmness.
"Master."
Her voice echoed.
"There is so much harvest and potential from the ongoing actions right now that a small percentage has been pulled toward THE Yggdrheim.
This concentrated authority has begun crystallizing into treasures and loot unlike any that have existed before."
Noah turned to her with interest that sharpened his gaze.
"Treasures capable of aiding even lesser Absolutes and Fundamental Depth entities have begun forming and have been scattered throughout this realm.
They emerge from the merger of your Infinities and the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter, creating opportunities for advancement."
Prompts bloomed before Noah’s eyes with weight that pressed against his consciousness.
|Treasure Classification: THE Yggdrheim Formations|
|The following treasures have begun crystallizing throughout THE Yggdrheim as a result of concentrated harvest from ongoing actions across Observable Existence.
Their locations are randomized and will shift periodically.
Those who seek them must navigate the infinite undifferentiation of the realm to claim their rewards.|
|Treasure One: Spark Fragment of THE Infinite Cause|
|A crystallized shard of the echoes released during THE Yggdrheim’s formation.
Consuming this fragment allows the recipient to experience echoes of Infinities, granting temporary access to the sensation of boundless potential that defines your nature.

For beings at Fundamental Depth, consumption can forcibly elevate their foundations to Absolute status by flooding their existence with concentrated Infinite authority that overwhelms all barriers to advancement.
This process ignores any curses, restrictions, or external forces preventing the rise to Absolute.
Warning: those without sufficient foundational stability may be overwhelmed by the experience and cease to exist.|
|Treasure Two: THE Paradox Seed|
|A living contradiction crystallized into physical form from the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter that comprises part of THE Yggdrheim’s foundation.
Planting this seed within one’s existence allows the cultivation of paradoxical authority regardless of original affinity.
The seed grows by feeding on contradictions that the host experiences, becoming stronger each time the host survives impossible situations or achieves outcomes that should not have been possible.
At full maturation, THE Paradox Seed grants the host immunity to one impossible attack by declaring that they both died and survived simultaneously.
Can only mature through genuine hardship.|
|Treasure Three: THE Undifferentiated Crown|
|A crown formed from pure undifferentiation stabilized by Infinite authority into wearable form.
Placing this crown upon one’s head grants temporary access to the perspective of proto-matter, allowing the wearer to perceive the weaknesses in any differentiated structure they observe.
All Manifestations, all Civilizations, all foundations become visible as fragile constructs waiting to be returned to formlessness.
This perception lasts until the crown is removed or until the wearer’s will falters...|
Noah read over these details calmly.
These treasures would transform anyone fortunate enough to claim them.
They would provide paths to advancement that bypassed conventional limitations entirely as they were some of the few forming here.
But they could not simply be given.
"For the sake of adversity," THE Infiniverse said as if reading his thoughts, "you must allow your people to seek and explore this realm themselves.
They must face the infinite undifferentiation.
They must navigate the dangers.
They must earn whatever treasures they manage to claim through their own efforts rather than having them handed to them by their Monarch."
Noah nodded slowly.
This was correct.
Hardship was the name of the game.
And hardship that was provided without genuine risk was not hardship at all.
He looked over all these details one final time, cataloguing the treasures and their locations and the dangers that surrounded them.
And then, in the next moment, he closed his eyes and waved his hand with authority that reached across the entirety of THE Infiniverse.
Far from THE Yggdrheim, in another region of THE Infiniverse entirely, inside Noah’s Early Veiled Shore where his closest companions resided their main bodies, a different scene was unfolding.
A handsome young man with blue-gold hair that marked him unmistakably as Noah’s progeny stood beside a cooking fire, carefully preparing a Marine Lifeform that he had caught earlier on.
His features held the same sharp handsomeness that his father possessed, but softened by youth and an easy smile that Noah rarely displayed.
Henry Osmont, the only son of THE Genesis Monarch!
Beside him stood Liora, the daughter of Little Bobby.
The two of them talked happily as Henry turned the cooking creature over the flames, their conversation filled with the casual intimacy of those who had grown comfortable in each other’s presence.
Their laughter filled the air of the Early Veiled Shore with warmth of peace, of safety, of existence untouched by the chaos currently flooding across Observable Existence.
After all, they had everything provided for!
And then, all of a sudden, an illusory hand formed above them.
Henry looked up with confusion that transformed into recognition as he sensed the grand aura radiating from that hand.
He opened his mouth to say something, to ask what was happening, but before any words could emerge...
The hand plucked him from where he stood and caused him to disappear entirely!
Liora blinked in astonishment as she watched the man she cared for vanish without warning or explanation.

She sensed the grand aura of the father of her man lingering in the air, that overwhelming authority that marked THE Genesis Monarch as something beyond what ordinary beings like her could comprehend.
She did nothing.
She simply stood there wondering what THE Genesis Monarch was doing now, trusting that whatever it was, it served a purpose that she could not perceive.
In THE Yggdrheim.
Henry materialized beside his father with disorientation.

His eyes blinked rapidly as he tried to understand where he was, why he had been brought here, what his father intended by pulling him away from his peaceful afternoon without so much as a word of warning.
But the moment he arrived, all questions fled from his mind.
His existence began to unravel.
The infinite undifferentiation of THE Yggdrheim pressed against him from every direction simultaneously, seeking to dissolve his form back into the proto-matter from which all things had emerged.
He felt his foundations wavering.
He felt his Civilization destabilizing.
He felt the very fabric of his being coming apart at the seams as the realm worked to return him to undifferentiated potential!
Henry gasped with shock!
His entire existence was being undifferentiated!

chapters.title: Chapter 4915: Overcome! II
paragraphs: He struggled to keep it together, pouring every ounce of his will into maintaining the coherence of his form.
But the undifferentiation did not stop. It did not pause. It infinitely continued its assault, regenerating pressure faster than he could adapt to it.
Why would his father bring him here?!

Henry felt genuine pain as his existence truly was unraveling, the edges of his being dissolving into the multicolored chaos that surrounded him. He looked toward his father for help, his eyes filled with desperation and confusion as this was his main body and not a clone!
What he saw was Noah and THE Infiniverse looking at him calmly.
No concern.
No urgency.
Just observation!

Noah stepped closer to his struggling son, his blue-gold flames burning with authority that seemed entirely unaffected by the infinite undifferentiation pressing against them. His eyes held weight that exceeded anything Henry had witnessed from his father before.
"Boy."
His voice was heavy, each word emerging with authority that made the realm itself seem to listen.
"There are countless monsters across Existence. Even I am unsure of what is coming. Existence is too vast. Existence is dangerous."
He watched his son struggle without offering any assistance.
"I have come to realize that should anything happen to me... and nothing should or can happen to me... but if in the infinite possibilities there is one where something happens..."
His eyes hardened.
"I know that you and all others will not survive for long. You will die even quicker."
Henry gasped as another wave of undifferentiation tore at his foundations, his form flickering between stability and dissolution.
"As my only progeny, you need to be strong, Boy. And strength comes from adversity."
Noah gestured at the realm around them.
"This is adversity. Overcome it or you will be left behind."
His voice dropped to something that held no compromise.
"It is merely undifferentiation filled with Infinities. With my blood coursing through you... why should you fall to this?"
BOOM!
Henry struggled as his existence continued to unravel, his eyes locked onto his father with an expression of absolute disbelief!
This could not be happening!
His own father was watching him dissolve and offering nothing but words about adversity!
But even as the shock flooded through him, even as the pain of undifferentiation tore at every fiber of his being, somewhere deep within Henry’s foundations, something began to stir!
Far from a terrifying trial.
In THE Prima Indifferentia.

Across regions of endless corrupted paradoxical proto-matter filled with a blue-gold light of Infinities, chaos reigned supreme. The flooding corruption that THE Living Paradox had initiated merged with the Infinite Seals that THE Infiniverse had scattered, creating storms of authority that tore through the primordial expanse with violence that exceeded anything this ancient space had witnessed since THE First Cause itself.

Undivided Ones burned with the light from the corruption or became granderby it. Formless Terrors churned with increased instability as the paradoxical nature of the proto-matter confused their already confused existences, making them even more terrifying. Other Lifeforms with their own names....prospered.
And through this chaos, new lifeforms may yet emerge.
THE Prima Indifferentia, that realm of undifferentiation that had existed since before Observable Existence fully took shape, was being transformed by forces that had no right to transform it.
And yet.
There was a region within this place that was unfathomably calm.

No particles of proto-matter entered a circular region that existed like an eye of peace within the hurricane of chaos. The storms raged around it, the corruption swirled past it, but nothing crossed the boundary that separated this place from everything else.
At the very center of this calm region stood a white tree.

Its bark gleamed with light that held no color yet contained all colors simultaneously. Its branches stretched upward and outward in patterns that seemed to follow rules of geometry that had not yet been differentiated from pure mathematical potential. Its roots disappeared into ground that was not ground.

A calm and radiant circular white barrier emanated from that tree, pressing outward with authority that made the corruption and Infinities alike seem like children’s toys by comparison. Without its permission, absolutely no foreign Civilizational Authority or the authority of differentiation or undifferentiation would make its way there.
The barrier did not fight against intrusion. It simply declared that intrusion was not possible, and reality accepted that declaration without question.

The size of this tree seemed to be a meter long and a mile long and one light year long at the same time. Its dimensions continued to vary with each observation, never settling on a single measurement because measurement itself was a form of differentiation that the tree had not fully accepted. It was small. It was vast. It was both and neither simultaneously.
And near it sat a Primordial Architect.
The being’s form defied easy description, for it existed at the intersection of differentiation and undifferentiation that had birthed all Primordial Architects during THE First Cause.
Its body was humanoid in the loosest sense, possessing what might have been called a head and torso and limbs, but each component was composed of crystallized potential rather than solid matter.

Its face held features that were both present and absent. Eyes that burned with light older than Observable Existence gazed outward with an otherworldly and extraordinary attitude that transcended mortal concepts of attention.
There was gentleness in those eyes, yes, but also cunning that had been accumulated across eons of observation and manipulation.

It barely paid a glance at the raging storms of corrupted paradoxical proto-matter and Infinite Seals in the surroundings. Such chaos was beneath its concern. Such transformation was merely the latest iteration of changes that it had witnessed countless times across cycles that predated memory itself.
In front of the sitting Primordial Architect, there was a simple looking square board.
But terrifyingly, on this board were the auras of entities that would have made lesser Absolutes like that ugly, bent, and twisted fucker THE Living Elemental flee in terror.

Formless Terrors and Undivided Ones, beings that had existed since before THE Infinite Unfurling, were present on the board’s surface. But they seemed miniaturized and frozen, reduced to the size of game pieces despite their true forms being vast enough to consume Primordial Realms.
They were... mere pieces!

chapters.title: Chapter 4916: Death Comes For All Things!
paragraphs: The terrifying Primordial Architect waited for a moment, its body shifting with contemplation that exceeded mortal thought. Then it used its massive hand to move the pieces.

It moved two pieces. One a Formless Terror whose churning form had been stilled into something resembling a knight. The other an Undivided One whose countless eyes had been frozen mid-blink into something resembling a rook. The pieces slid across the board with weight that pressed against reality itself.
And they were only capable of movement after the Primordial Architect had moved them.

Once positioned in the center of the board, the two pieces came alive. The Formless Terror churned with violence that should have shattered the board. The Undivided One’s eyes blazed with hunger that should have consumed everything nearby. They fought in the center of the board with authority that exceeded most Absolutes, their conflict contained within the square’s boundaries by rules that the Primordial Architect had established eons ago.
The winner would advance to the next round.
It was unknown what would happen to the loser.
As the Primordial Architect played such a terrifying game, near it was actually someone familiar.

A humanoid entity surrounded by multicolored flames of Existence sat beside the white tree with posture that held no deference despite the company it kept. The flames danced and swirled around its form with authority that declared this being as something beyond normal classification.
It was none other than THE Creature.

At this moment, his facial expression and eyes were a bit more clear than they had ever been during his appearances in Observable Existence. His eyes seemed grand and imperious, filled with a level of extraordinary calm that could not be explained through conventional understanding.
This was the calm of someone who had witnessed everything and found nothing capable of disturbing their equilibrium.

He was staring out into the storm around this calm white region, observing the corruption and Infinities that currently transformed THE Prima Indifferentia with attention that held neither concern nor satisfaction.
The Primordial Architect spoke without looking away from its game.
"I told you not to play games with that little thing for the longest time."
Its voice was quintessentially grand.
"Now you two have gone back and forth for eons as it all leads to this."
The Formless Terror on the board consumed part of the Undivided One’s mass, gaining advantage in their frozen conflict.
"Our Observable Existence is a grand one that shows marvels even to me to this day. We have to care for it and nurture it."
Its geometric patterns shifted with something that might have been emphasis.
"I grasped THE Second Scale of Existence through its wonders as I told you how you could do the same."
Its eyes finally turned toward THE Creature.
"But you were too impatient."
The words were utterly terrifying in their implications.
THE Creature’s multicolored flames flickered with response that held no defensiveness.
"Not all beings are like Primordial Architects."
His voice was calm, grand, carrying the weight of Existence itself within its tones.

"You were born with existences filled with clear musings of differentiation and undifferentiation. The path to THE Second Scale was visible to you from the moment of your emergence. You had merely to walk it at whatever pace suited your contemplation. You...voilated adversity and hardship as you have been stuck there this whole time."
He turned to face the Primordial Architect directly.

"Others do not have such clarity. Others must forge their paths through darkness and uncertainty and the constant pressure of enemies who would see them collapsed before they reach their potential. And others do not have the time that you possessed. Cycles upon cycles of peaceful contemplation while reality waited patiently for you to achieve what you sought."
His flames burned brighter.
"My path requires adversity. My path requires conflict. My path requires playing games with little things and seeing which of us emerges transformed from the exchange."
The Primordial Architect shook its head with a smile that made its weavings dance with amusement.
"Whatever your reasoning may be, things have now come to this."
It moved another piece on its board, an Undivided One that resembled Bazuman being positioned against a Formless Terror of equivalent magnitude.
"I am one of the few sane ones after all of these cycles and eons. Others like me are not at all sane."
Its eyes grew distant.

"Some are at your level or below. Some...are above you. They were lost in their own weavings and storms of differentiation and undifferentiation for eons upon eons. They had no reason to leave or do anything really. THE Prima Indifferentia was home enough. The game of existence held no appeal when they could simply be without purpose or direction."
Its gaze sharpened.
"What is happening right now gives things definition more than intended. Especially that glimmer of Infinity above."
The Primordial Architect gestured toward the storms beyond the white barrier.

"Things that have not moved or bothered to move for eons will now begin to walk these lands freely. They had all remained within THE Prima Indifferentia for all these eons, content to exist without acting. But all of this changes that."
Its smile faded.
"Even if you may be ready, what about all the others? The little friends you have made over the eons?"
The words were glorious and terrifying at the same time!
THE Creature remained calm as he replied with a voice that held no concern.
"For adversity to truly be adversity, it cannot be expected or known."
His multicolored flames burned with steady intensity.

"What is happening now will be a Cause for the emergence of multiple beings to THE Second Scale of Existence. I would never say that those destined for it will achieve it. It is those who make the choice to grasp it who will achieve it."
He looked out at the storms with eyes that held acceptance.
"As for death, death comes for all things. Inevitabilities die. Living Existences die. Absolutes die."
His gaze turned toward the Primordial Architect.
"Even Primordial Architects can die."
The white tree seemed to pulse with acknowledgment of that truth.
"All that is left is choices. Choices upon choices upon choices."
BOOM!

Such terrifying words were said by THE Creature as the Primordial Architect, THE Arboreal Warden Yggvaros, Keeper of THE White Tree and Observer of Cycles, First Among THE Sane to Grasp THE Second Scale of Existence...smiled.
And yes, he had a hefty set of titles.
He continued playing with the pieces on his board, moving multiple pieces carrying the auras of entities exceeding normal Absolutes as if he were merely playing a game that held no stakes whatsoever!

chapters.title: Chapter 4917: Change Has Come!
paragraphs: In THE Prima Indifferentia, things that had slumbered for eons were waking.
A group of Formless Ones drifted through the storms of corrupted paradoxical proto-matter and Infinite Seals. Their churning masses held no stable form.
Their auras exceeded most Absolutes.

These were not the lesser Formless Terrors. These were ancient things, beings that had existed since THE First Cause itself, that had chosen to remain in this space of undifferentiation because Observable Existence held nothing of interest for them. They had slumbered in the proto-matter for eons, content to simply be without acting or growing or pursuing anything resembling purpose.
But now they were awake.

The corrupted paradoxical proto-matter surged around them, and instead of fleeing from it or being dissolved by it, they opened themselves to its embrace. The corruption flowed into their churning masses alongside the blue-gold light of Infinities, and their existences became grander from the absorption. They grew denser. They grew heavier. They grew more real in ways that THE Prima Indifferentia had not witnessed since the earliest days of differentiation.
And then they scattered in different directions with glee.

One Formless One disappeared into a Crack that led to THE Wastes of THE Fallout, its churning mass compressing to fit through the fracture before expanding again on the other side. Another vanished into a Crack that opened onto THE Wandering Territories, those drifting spaces between defined realms where lost things gathered. A third entered a Crack that connected to a remnant corrupted Fold. A fourth found its way toward a Primordial Realm.
They spread across existence like seeds being scattered by a farmer who cared nothing for where they landed.
And they were not alone.
In another region of THE Prima Indifferentia, a massive humanoid form stirred from stillness that had lasted longer than most civilizations had existed.

A Primordial Architect was wrapped entirely in strips of white material that seemed to glow with inner light, each strip winding around its colossal form in patterns of containment rather than clothing. The wrappings covered every inch of its existence, leaving no feature visible beneath their luminous embrace. Only its eyes could be perceived through gaps in the binding, and those eyes burned with light that had witnessed THE First Cause.
Its aura seemed to almost be as immense as THE Creature himself.
Almost.
The difference was slight enough that comparison became meaningful, that observers might wonder whether this wrapped Primordial Architect could contend with one of THE Five in direct conflict.

The corrupted paradoxical proto-matter and Infinite Seals surged around this ancient being with violence that had awakened it from its slumber. The wrapped Primordial Architect did not flee or resist. It opened its existence to the corruption and the Infinities alike, drawing them into its wrappings with hunger that exceeded what its still form had suggested.
The wrappings glowed brighter.
The eyes burned with increased intensity.
And then THE Primordial Architect roared!

The sound that emerged from within those wrappings held no sanity whatsoever. It was a cry of awakening that had been building for cycles beyond counting, a release of dormant madness that had been contained within the binding strips for eons upon eons. The roar shattered proto-matter in every direction, creating ripples of definition that spread outward like waves from a stone dropped into still water.

The wrapped Primordial Architect moved toward a Crack with purpose that its insane eyes belied, its bound form drifting through THE Prima Indifferentia with speed that exceeded what something so massive should have been capable of.
It disappeared into the fracture.
And wherever it emerged, things would change.
In yet another region of the primordial chaos, something else was stirring.

It was adorned in armor unlike anything that existed in Observable Existence, ancient and archaic platinum plates that covered every inch of its colossal frame with craftsmanship that predated the concept of craftsmanship itself.
The armor seemed to have been forged from proto-matter that had been convinced to become metal, each plate holding the weight of undifferentiation that had been given form through will alone.
In its hand was a hammer.

The weapon was massive even compared to the already colossal form that wielded it, its head composed of condensed metallic proto-matter that had been compressed until it achieved density that exceeded what normal matter could sustain. The hammer’s surface shifted constantly, metallic proto-matter churning within its structure as if eager to be unleashed against whatever target its wielder chose.
And it was unclear if there was actually a body within the armor at all.

The gaps between plates revealed nothing but darkness. The helmet’s visor showed no eyes, no features, no indication of a being wearing the armor rather than the armor itself being the entity. Perhaps there had been a Primordial Architect within once. Perhaps the armor had consumed its wearer eons ago. Perhaps there had never been anything but the armor itself.

The corrupted paradoxical proto-matter and Infinite Seals surged around this armored entity, and the platinum plates drank deeply of both substances. The armor glowed with absorbed power that made its already immense presence grow even more terrifying.
And then the armored Primordial Architect moved.

It did not drift through a Crack like the others. It stepped through, its massive form compressing and expanding as it traversed the fracture between THE Prima Indifferentia and Observable Existence with purpose that held no hesitation.
It emerged in THE Wastes of THE Fallout.
And... it happened to be near a shelter of THE Loom.
The shelter was a massive hedron structure that rose from THE Wastes like a monument. Its faces gleamed with light that held the signature of THE Fallout’s corruption.
But more terrifying than its structure were its walls.

Countless tentacle-like Inevitabilities had been fused into the hedron’s surface, their forms writhing with pain that they could not escape. They had been captured and incorporated into the shelter itself, their authority used to reinforce the structure while their consciousness remained aware enough to suffer. Their screams were silent but their agony was visible in every twist and contortion of their bonded forms.
Inside the shelter were many Early Creatures and Living Existences and some Fold Dwellers.
They existed within the hedron’s protection, safe from the chaos currently flooding across Observable Existence, confident that the shelter’s defenses.
This shelter actually comprised most of the Living Concepts.
Because THE Living Concept was here.

Not the Half-Step Absolute body that Noah had collapsed in Muspelheim during his journey to claim that Primordial Realm. That had been merely an extension, a fragment of the true existence that THE Living Concept possessed. His genuine full form lay protected in the confines of THE Loom, surrounded by followers and defenses that should have made him untouchable.
And yet at this moment...

The armored Primordial Architect that had emerged from THE Prima Indifferentia gazed upon the shelter with visor that revealed nothing of its thoughts or intentions. It stood before the hedron structure with stillness that lasted for a single heartbeat.
And then it swung its hammer.

The massive weapon moved faster than many Absolutes could perceive, its head of condensed metallic proto-matter blurring through the space between the armored entity and the shelter with speed that defied the weight it should have possessed.
The hammer struck the shelter of THE Loom.
BOOM!
The hedron structure that had been reinforced by countless Inevitabilities, that had protected so many converted beings, that had housed THE Living Concept’s genuine full form, instantly shattered!

The impact didn’t crack the shelter or damage it or force it to slowly collapse. It simply destroyed it entirely, causing the hedron to splinter into a storm of fragments that exploded outward in every direction. The fused Inevitabilities screamed silently as they were torn apart alongside the walls they had been bonded to. The Early Creatures and Living Existences and Fold Dwellers within had no time to flee or defend themselves or even comprehend what was happening.
And then the fragments stopped scattering.

They were pulled toward the hammer as if gravity had decided to serve the weapon’s purposes, each piece of the shattered shelter flowing into the condensed metallic proto-matter with absorption that left nothing behind. The Inevitabilities. The converted beings. The structure itself.
THE Living Concept.
All of it was entirely absorbed as the hammer glowed gold-red after consuming everything that the shelter had contained. THE Living Concepts was collapsed as if he did not matter.
Because to this armored Primordial Architect, he did not matter.
None of them mattered.
What mattered were the sources of this Paradox and Infinity. Where...were they?

After that, the armored Primordial Architect gazed around THE Wastes of THE Fallout with visor that revealed nothing of its assessment. It observed the corruption and the Infinities that permeated this region as it continued to absorb.
And then it began to move calmly and slowly.
Each step covered distances that should have required spatial traversal.
Change had come.
And the change would be brutal as nobody was safe!

chapters.title: Chapter 4918: A Man Must Make Great Sacrifices I
paragraphs: When your own blood, when your only son was dissolving into a soup of undifferentiation in front of you, you may be panicked and regretful.
Noah was neither.

The more he understood existence, the more he realized he had been wrong about many things. It was great and all to protect others, to shield them from dangers that exceeded their capabilities, to use his power to ensure that those he cared about never faced threats that could end them. But if they had no power to protect themselves, if they relied entirely on his presence to survive, then everything was useless if a single accident occurred.
And existence was filled with accidents.

THE Living Paradox had just revealed that Primordial Architects and ancient Formless Terrors and slumbering Undivided Ones were waking across THE Prima Indifferentia. THE Entity continued to spread through THE Wastes and Primordial Realms with methodology that even THE Primordial Paradox could not fully counter.
Wars raged between beings of THE Five. Cracks appeared across Observable Existence flooding corruption everywhere.
What if Noah was occupied when danger came for his people?
What if he was fighting THE Living Paradox when something emerged from THE Prima Indifferentia to threaten THE Infiniverse?
What if an accident occurred and he simply was not there?

While he may not be hard on others, when it came to those closest to him, especially his son, he now realized he had to be stern for their own good. Kindness that produced weakness was not kindness at all. Protection that prevented growth was merely a different form of harm!

So even as his son looked at him with eyes that were asking why, oh why, as if his own son was accusing him of betrayal for bringing him to this place that sought to dissolve his existence into formless potential, Noah remained calm and did not interfere at all!

Henry’s form flickered between stability and dissolution, his features becoming indistinct as the infinite undifferentiation of THE Yggdrheim pressed against him from every direction. His hands, which had been cooking a meal moments ago, were becoming transparent. His blue-gold hair, the mark of his lineage, was losing its color as definition fled from his existence.
But Noah still had a soft spot.
He could not help but say words that might guide his son toward survival rather than simply watching him struggle without direction.
"You have my blood coursing through you."
His voice was slow and deliberate as it pressed against THE Yggdrheim itself.
"You have it easier than all others as you simply have to rely on this. Not even yourself, Boy."

The moment after he said this, the dissolving Henry grit his teeth with determination that transcended the fear and confusion and sense of betrayal that had been flooding through him. His father’s words were a hint. A direction. A path toward survival that he had not perceived on his own.
His blood.
His lineage.
The inheritance that flowed through his veins from THE Genesis Monarch himself!

From the very strands of his existence, from the very lineage passed down to him through blood that carried the weight of Infinities, threads of blue-gold light began to burn with intensity that pushed back against the undifferentiation pressing inward. The threads were squeezed out by the threat of dissolution, forced to the surface by the survival instinct that recognized death approaching and demanded response.

The blue-gold light permeated across his blood first, racing through vessels that carried more than mere nutrients. It spread into his muscles, his bones, his foundations that had been wavering under THE Yggdrheim’s assault. It covered him entirely in a cocoon of inherited Infinity that his father’s existence had passed down without Henry ever realizing its full potential.
His dissolving body began to regenerate!

Where undifferentiation had been winning, where his form had been losing coherence, the blue-gold light of inherited Infinity pushed back with force that matched the realm’s assault. His features solidified. His hands regained their substance. His hair blazed with color that exceeded what it had held before.
He was infinitely beginning to fight back against undifferentiation!

So long as he continued to exist in this space, he would continue to fight this battle with his existence. The undifferentiation would press inward. His inherited Infinity would press outward. The two forces would war against each other endlessly, and in that war, Henry would either grow strong enough to win or eventually falter and be consumed.
But for now, he was surviving.

Henry emanated a heavy aura of Surface Depth at this moment that exceeded any normal Surface Depth entity that Noah had encountered. The inherited Infinity had awakened something within his son that had been dormant, potential that had been waiting for sufficient pressure to force its emergence. His foundations burned with blue-gold light of growth already beginning.
But Noah sensed it clearly.
If he exerted less than a decimal percentage of his power, his son would be collapsed instantly. The aura that seemed heavy by normal standards was nothing compared to what Noah possessed!
The Surface Depth that exceeded normal parameters was still Surface Depth, still the first rung on a ladder that stretched toward heights that Henry could not yet perceive.
It was not enough.
Not yet!

Henry looked at his father with a complex expression that held too many emotions to fully identify. He had truly felt the threat of collapse. He had genuinely believed, for several terrifying moments, that his father had brought him here to die. And now that he had survived, now that his inherited Infinity which was just pulling from his father’s infinity was utilized to preserve his existence, he did not know how to feel about what had just occurred.
He could not thank his father for nearly leaving him to collapse, right?

But he also could not show disrespect to his father, to the being who had aided in giving him life and the very blood that had just saved him. So he was in a difficult spot as he did not know what to say to his father, his mouth opening and closing without words emerging.
In that silence, Noah spoke with voice that held the weight of decisions already made.
"This is only the start, my son."
His eyes held no apology for what he had just put Henry through.
"You have to struggle. You have to pass through all sorts of adversity. Otherwise you will not truly live."
He stepped closer to his son with flames that seemed to embrace rather than threaten.
"I have realized that you and the others need to truly live. So what I can at least promise you is that you will not do this alone."
After he said this, Noah waved his hands with authority that reached across the entirety of THE Infiniverse.
In the surroundings of THE Yggdrheim, many figures began to appear!

chapters.title: Chapter 4919: A Man Must Make Great Sacrifices II
paragraphs: Riya materialized first, her small body and vibrant blue hair instantly recognizable as she looked around with initial calm that came from trust in the one she looked upto the most. But that calm transformed into something drastic and horrified as she felt her existence begin to dissolve under THE Yggdrheim’s infinite undifferentiation!

Titano appeared next, that massive simple-minded Titan whose loyalty to Noah had never wavered as he always considered him a brother! His colossal form seemed to shrink as undifferentiation pressed against him from every direction, his features becoming indistinct as he roared with confusion and pain!

Moiraine emerged into the realm with paradoxical grace. Her form flickered between states as THE Yggdrheim could not decide whether she was one thing or another, and the uncertainty only added to the dissolution pressing against her!

Sigrid, THE Living Order herself, appeared with composure that cracked the moment undifferentiation touched her foundations. Order and undifferentiation were fundamentally opposed, and THE Yggdrheim’s assault felt like poison to everything she represented as she frowned and fought back!

THE First Farmer materialized with soil still on his hands from whatever he had been cultivating, his weathered features twisting with shock as his existence began to unravel in ways that no harvest or Effort had ever prepared him for!

THE Emperor Penguin, this wingless, talentless bird, waddled into existence with pride and dignity that dissolved alongside his form, his noble bearing becoming difficult to maintain as infinite undifferentiation sought to return him to proto-potential!

Khor appeared in her diminutive small form, that ancient being whose power belied her size, and even she gasped with surprise as THE Yggdrheim’s pressure exceeded anything she had prepared for! But her Hunger bloomed as her Depth and Sigrid’s and The First Farmer’s Depths were already at Fundamental because of THE Embodiment of THE Creature!

The Land Lifeforms arrived together, Heidrun the arrogant goat bleating with indignation that transformed into genuine fear, Malphas the butler attempting to maintain his composure even as his existence wavered, and Yoshinami’s many legs scrambling for purchase on reality that was becoming increasingly uncertain!
An Arch Lich cackled as he dissolved!
And then the Queens of THE Infiniverse appeared!
Barbatos emerged with darkness and death that could not find anchor in a realm of infinite undifferentiation, her form becoming indistinct as she struggled to maintain cohesion!
Adelaide materialized with beauty that began dissolving the moment THE Yggdrheim’s pressure touched her, her features blurring as undifferentiation sought to return her to formless potential!
Athena appeared with eyes that could not find solution, her eyes widening with recognition of what was happening to her existence!
And many others arrived alongside them, companions who had grown comfortable in THE Infiniverse’s protection, followers who had believed themselves safe under their Monarch’s shadow!
All of them were brought over!
All of them felt their existences begin to dissolve!
All of them looked toward Noah with expressions that ranged from confusion to fear to accusation to desperate hope for explanation!

THE Genesis Monarch looked upon his gathered people with eyes that held no mercy but also no cruelty. This was not punishment. This was not abandonment. This was the beginning of something that would either transform them into beings capable of surviving what was coming or reveal that they had always been destined to fall.
And again...destiny and fate were merely choices.
He...would truly have his people experience existence!
And existence, as he had learned, was adversity.

Most of those that Noah brought to THE Yggdrheim did not have his direct lineage like his son. Truly, for them, it would be only a few seconds before they faced complete collapse and dissolution without intervention. The infinite undifferentiation of this realm did not care about their accomplishments or their loyalty or their dreams. It simply sought to return all differentiated things to formless potential.

So for others, Noah gave a bit of his glimmers of Infinity to cover the core parts of their existence and preserve them from immediate dissolution. The blue-gold light wrapped around the foundations of each being he had brought here, creating scaffolding that would hold their existence together while the rest of them experienced the full pressure of undifferentiation.
He addressed all those present with voice that carried across THE Yggdrheim despite the chaos of the realm.
"Many of you did not have to struggle for power these past days and weeks."
His eyes swept across the gathered beings who were writhing and gasping and fighting against dissolution with varying degrees of success.
"But struggle is going to be critical going forward. The least that needs to be done is for all of you to survive the threat of undifferentiation. To make sure that your definition is sound."
He folded his hands behind his back.
"Survive this first. You will be even grander in the future. I have placed a glimmer of my Infinity within your existences that will give you scaffolding."
His voice hardened.
"But I will take this glimmer away fairly soon. Find a way to keep your definition amidst undifferentiation with your Civilizations. When my light fades, you will be on your own."
He paused.
"So survive. Persevere."

He said these grand words as he looked at his people who were struggling one way or another. The vast majority of their existences still felt that terrifying pressure of undifferentiation as only core parts of who they were remained protected by the faint blue-gold light that Noah had placed on each of them before they arrived here.
Yet this entire ordeal was still terrifying and heavy.

Noah could see the pleading gazes on many of them directed toward him, begging without words for mercy, for release, for anything other than this trial that dissolved the edges of their beings with every passing moment. Some looked at him with desperate hope. Some with resignation that came from understanding that Noah had made a decision that would not be reversed.
And then Barbatos sent him a message.

Her vibrant visage was melting on the edges of her limbs, her form struggling to maintain cohesion even with the scaffolding of his Infinity protecting her core. Despite her obvious distress, despite the dissolution pressing against her from every direction, her mental communication carried a threat that exceeded anything THE Yggdrheim could offer.
’Little Fish, you will not get any from me for at least...the next day if I have to go through this!’
Her voice in his mind held fury!
’A full day! I know you cannot handle that, Little Fish! I do not need to undergo this challenge!’

Barbatos sent him such words as they included a terrifying threat within them. The past him may have wavered in the face of such a declaration. The past him may have found reasons to exempt certain individuals from this trial, to make accommodations that preserved his own interests alongside theirs.
But at this moment...
He closed his eyes and became stoic.
Sometimes, a man had to sacrifice that which he loved the most to ensure those he loved were protected against everything.
Oh, the painful and great sacrifices he had to make for his people!
A whole day!
Ah!

Moments after Barbatos, he received similar threats from Adelaide, whose message carried promises of locked doors and cold shoulders that would last until she deemed him sufficiently punished. Then came Athena, whose arguments about why this was unnecessary were accompanied by implications about what would be withheld if he persisted.
Then came the others, each one wielding the singular weapon they knew could bring him to his knees!
They all threatened him with the one thing they knew he could not live without!
But he remained firm.
He had to be steady!
Noah whispered a mantra to himself as he stood with eyes closed and expression stoic, putting his people to the test while ignoring the increasingly creative threats flooding his consciousness.

"I stands firm against all storms. I do not bend to threats of warmth withheld. I remember that adversity builds strength, and that includes my own adversity. I will survive this day, and tomorrow, and however many days of punishment they deem necessary. I will be okay. Probably. Maybe. I cannot back down now..."

He repeated this mantra silently while maintaining his external composure, a pillar of stoic authority that revealed nothing of the internal calculations regarding just how long he could actually survive without what was being threatened!

chapters.title: Chapter 4920: Language I
paragraphs: Far from THE Infiniverse.
In THE Interstices.

Noah’s body in this place sat upon a throne of Absolute Seals before a desk that he had manifested through the same authority. The table was currently filled with Inscriptions, golden pages covered in sentences of THE First Tongue that burned with Embodiments and Apophasis waiting to be deployed. His campaign of writing had produced dozens of Inscriptiones Dormientes, each one a weapon or defense ready to be awakened at his command.
But at this moment, he had stopped writing Inscriptions.

His focus was on a unique change that was opening up due to the continued influx of endless Infinite potential that flooded into his existence with every passing nanosecond. The harvest from the process that THE Living Paradox had initiated, the process that Noah had jumped aboard through THE Infiniverse, continued to provide its terrifying Infinite potential toward his foundation and existence.
Many things within Noah were changing rapidly.

Apart from his foundation, one of the singular most important changes occurring was to his Civilization. Truly, to his weavings of THE First Tongue. His Absolute Seals. What he could do with THE First Tongue was transforming with every passing nanosecond as the influx of Infinite potential surged into this aspect of his existence.
And he was finding himself pondering many questions.

There were Phonemes, the letters of THE First Tongue. There were Logos, the words formed from those letters. And there were Philologies, the sentences constructed from those words, which could all correlate with the Principles of Existence.

Having altered THE First Tongue by adding his own Phonemes to the original 18, Noah had effectively expanded his vocabulary. He had opened up the pathway to Archai of Existence, his own variations of sentences in the language of existence that was THE First Tongue. So his weavings of THE Principles of THE Cheating Architect had become THE Arche of THE Cheating Architect. The same had occurred for Perpetual Harvest, for Undifferentiated Mana, for all the Principles he had mastered.

They were unique and elevated and allowed for much greater expressions of the alteration of existence through them. The continued harvest and Infinite potential he was gaining was amplified by his Archai.
But still, these were just sentences.

At this moment, as a Native Speaker, as someone with THE Civilizational Instinctus, he felt like he could do so much more with THE First Tongue now that it was flooded with his Infinities. That sensation of something missing, something that he could now grasp if only he understood what it was, became more pressing and grander as more and more Infinite potential filled him.
To the point that he found himself asking a question that echoed through THE Interstices.
"What is language?"
Yes. What was language?
Noah spoke to himself as Phonemes swirled around his form in galaxies of linguistic authority.

"Language...serves to mediate between the individual and the objective existence. It reflects the development of reason and consciousness. Language acts as a bridge between mind and existence, transforming raw experience into conceptual knowledge that can be communicated and shared..."
He thought a great deal about THE First Tongue and how it stood as the expression and language of existence itself.

In his home world, there had been many philosophers who babbled on a great deal regarding what language really meant. He had never paid much attention to them before. Philosophy had seemed like the domain of those with too much time and too little practical concern.
But now, sitting upon a throne of Absolute Seals while Infinite potential flooded his existence, those philosophical musings seemed suddenly relevant.
"Some would say that language imposes false divisions on the world."
He mused aloud.

"When we say ’the lightning flashed’, we suggest there is a thing called ’lightning’ that is separate from the action of ’flashing’. But in reality, there is only the flashing. The process. The event. Language...can create a separation that does not truly exist."
His eyes grew distant.

"When we use the word ’I’ as a separate subject, language reinforces the illusion that we are isolated observers rather than inseparable parts of the greater existential process. We... believe ourselves distinct from existence when we are merely existence observing itself."
HUUM!
He shook his head slowly.

"And many of the most important things in existence cannot be fully captured in words at all. The feeling of Infinity. The weight of Absolute authority. The sensation of foundations growing stronger. These things can be pointed toward with language but never fully contained by it."
Around him, an infinite swirling storm of Seals of Absolute Tongue spun in patterns that grew more complex with every passing moment.
The blue-gold light of his Infinities suffused the linguistic constructs, making them more than mere words, more than mere sentences, more than anything THE First Tongue had been designed to contain.
He found himself muttering words about languages, about words, about sentences, about the fundamental nature of communication and meaning.
And then a thought struck him with force that made his foundations tremble.
"What of... numbers?"
HUUM!
His mind buzzed with the implications of such a simple question!

A unique state of epiphany unfurled as he asked himself this because were numbers not intricately connected to words? Were they not their own language? Had he not come to learn how the Principles of Existence were analogous to mathematical equations that described how existence unfolded?
At the end of the day, all things were numbers.

Not just tools for counting, but the fundamental, qualitative, and sacred building blocks of Existence itself. Numbers represented relationships. Numbers represented ratios. Numbers represented the hidden architecture upon which reality was constructed.
THE First Tongue claimed to be the language of existence. How could it not include numbers in its vocabulary?
Noah searched within his existence as he thought about the mathematical truths that his home world had discovered.

The relationship between the sides of a right triangle. The ratio of a circle’s circumference to its diameter. The patterns that emerged when numbers were arranged in sequences that nature herself seemed to favor.
These were not merely tools for calculation.

They were testaments to the belief that Existence was built upon hidden, orderly, and harmonious mathematical relationships. They symbolized the bringing together of diverse parts to create perfect, balanced unity. They were the bones beneath the flesh of reality, the structure that gave form its meaning.
Numbers were an intricate part of existence!
At this time, Noah uttered out grandly while surrounded by Infinities that burned brighter than they had ever burned before.
"Let me see... my existence infused with numbers."
His voice carried the weight of declaration.
"Let me add numbers to my grand vernacular."
HUUM!
And utter, glorious brilliance unfolded!

The swirling storm of Seals of Absolute Tongue around him began to transform as his words took effect. Phonemes that had been letters began incorporating numerical values. Logos that had been words began expressing mathematical relationships. Philologies that had been sentences began operating as equations that could be solved, balanced, manipulated.
THE First Tongue was expanding!

Not through the addition of new Phonemes this time, but through the integration of an entirely new dimension of expression. Numbers wove themselves through his linguistic authority like threads being added to an already intricate weaving, creating patterns of meaning that had not existed before.
And Noah, THE Native Speaker, THE Genesis Monarch, felt his understanding of THE First Tongue reach heights that no other being in Observable Existence had ever achieved!

chapters.title: Chapter 4921: Language II
paragraphs: The brilliance that unfolded around Noah in THE Interstices exceeded anything he had witnessed from his own existence before.
The swirling storm of Seals of Absolute Tongue transformed with every passing moment as numbers integrated themselves into the very fabric of his linguistic authority.
Archai began operating as equations that could describe and alter reality through calculation as much as declaration.
And prompts bloomed before his eyes with weight that pressed against his consciousness with the significance of what he had just achieved.
|Unprecedented Integration Achieved|

|As THE Native Speaker of THE First Tongue, you have successfully integrated numerical expression into your unique variation of linguistic authority. This integration does not alter THE First Tongue itself but creates a personal methodology exclusive to your weavings that allows mathematical operations to augment your existing capabilities. This new dimension of expression has been designated to be...THE Numerical Sovereignty.|
|THE Numerical Sovereignty operates through the following core principles:|

|Principle One: All expressions of THE First Tongue now carry inherent numerical values based on their complexity, authority investment, and foundational weight. These values can be perceived, manipulated, and amplified through mathematical operations that you apply during composition or activation.|

|Principle Two: Mathematical operations applied to your weavings do not consume additional authority proportional to their effect.Instead, they restructure how your existing authority expresses itself, creating amplification without equivalent expenditure. This is possible because numbers describe relationships rather than create substance.|

|Principle Three: THE Numerical Sovereignty augments your existing capabilities rather than replacing them.Embodiments remain Embodiments. Inscriptions remain Inscriptions. Archai remain Archai. But all of them can now be modified through numerical operations that multiply their effects in ways that would otherwise require exponentially greater authority investment.|
Noah read over these foundational principles with eyes that burned brighter by the moment.
His own mind led the way, directing Harvests and Infinite Potential to flow across his existence as he maintained this glorious state of epiphany, his mind designing more and more things!
He thought how complex numbers could be as he forced them to be simple, to be compressed into something easily applicable for him!
More prompts unfolded as what he designed within himself became actualized.
|Core Operation One: Exponential Expression|

|You may now apply Exponents to any expression of THE First Tongue that you produce.When anExponentis applied, the effect of that expression is multiplied by itself according to the value of the Exponent available. An Exponent of 2 causes the expression to multiply by itself once. An Exponent of 3 causes the expression to multiply by itself twice. And so forth.|

|Example Application: An Inscriptio Nominata targeting an enemy’s foundation would normally cause deterioration proportional to the authority invested. With an Exponent of 2 applied, that deterioration multiplies by itself, causing the effect to grow not linearly but geometrically. The target experiences not twice the deterioration but the deterioration multiplied by the deterioration, a compounding that far exceeds simple doubling.|

|Critical Understanding: Exponentiation is not multiplication. When you apply an Exponent of 2 to an attack that would deal 100 units of damage, you do not deal 200 units. You deal 100 multiplied by 100, resulting in 10,000 units. When you apply an Exponent of 3, you deal 100 multiplied by 100 multiplied by 100, resulting in 1,000,000 units. The scaling is not additive or multiplicative but exponential, growing at rates that quickly exceed comprehension.|

|This operation can be applied to: Embodiments, Apophasis, Inscriptions of all types, Archai of Existence, Harvests, defensive constructs, foundational weight expressions, and any other weaving of THE First Tongue you produce. At your current level, an Exponent of upto 3 may be possible. Higher expressions will require a qualitative change.|
Noah felt his foundations tremble as he successfully set up the weavings of Exponential Expression.

An Inscription that would normally cause moderate damage to an enemy’s foundation could, with an Exponent of 3 applied, cause damage that exceeded what most shitty Absolutes like THE Living Elemental could survive. A defensive Embodiment that would normally block attacks from beings of equivalent foundation could, with an Exponent of 2 applied, block attacks from beings whose foundations exceeded his own by margins that should have been insurmountable.
And Harvests!

If he applied an Exponent to his Perpetual Harvest or his Rite of Paradoxical Inheritance, the resources he claimed from defeated enemies would multiply by themselves according to the Exponent chosen.

An enemy whose collapse would normally grant him theoretical 1000 units of foundational weight would grant him 1,000,000 units with an Exponent of 2 applied, or 1,000,000,000 units with an Exponent of 3.

THE Absolute Existential Palace of The Weavers, if he applied an Exponent of 2...would not be as if he doubled the rewards for killing an Absolute, but he effectively would be multiplying the rewards of a fallen Absolute...by themselves.
So not an Absolute times 2, but an Absolute times an Absolute!
He...really wanted to see what the result would be.
The scaling was terrifying!
More prompts continued.
|Core Operation Two: Multiplicative Amplification|

|You may now apply simple Multiplication to any expression of THE First Tongue that you produce. Unlike Exponentiation, Multiplication scales linearly but can be applied with values that exceed single digits. A Multiplier of 10 causes the expression to be 10 times more effective. A Multiplier of 100 causes it to be 100 times more effective. A Multiplier of 1000 causes it to be 1000 times more effective.|

|Multiplicative Amplification is less dramatic than Exponential Expression but more predictable and controllable. It is recommended for situations where precise scaling is desired rather than overwhelming force.|

|This operation can be combined with Exponentiation for compound effects. An expression with a Multiplier of 10 and an Exponent of 2 would first be multiplied by 10, then that result would be multiplied by itself. The compounding of operations creates amplification that exceeds either operation alone. Currently maximum Multiplication Value: 10|
|Core Operation Three: Divisive Reduction|

|You may now apply Division to expressions of THE First Tongue that target you or your allies. When Division is applied to an incoming attack or effect, its potency is divided by the value chosen. An incoming attack divided by 10 retains only one-tenth of its original effect. An incoming attack divided by 100 retains only one-hundredth.|

|This operation provides defensive applications that complement the offensive applications of Exponentiation and Multiplication. Attacks that would normally devastate your existence can be reduced to negligible inconveniences through sufficient Division.|

|Note: Division cannot reduce effects to zero. The minimum result of any Division is an infinitesimally small but still present effect. Complete negation still requires Apophasis declaration rather than numerical reduction. Current maximum value for Division: 10|

|Principle Three: THE Numerical Sovereignty augments your existing capabilities rather than replacing them.Embodiments remain Embodiments.
Inscriptions remain Inscriptions.
Archai remain Archai.
But all of them can now be modified through numerical operations that multiply their effects in ways that would otherwise require exponentially greater authority investment.|
Noah read over these foundational principles with eyes that burned brighter by the moment.
His own mind led the way, directing Harvests and Infinite Potential to flow across his existence as he maintained this glorious state of epiphany, his mind designing more and more things!
He thought how complex numbers could be as he forced them to be simple, to be compressed into something easily applicable for him!
More prompts unfolded as what he designed within himself became actualized.
|Core Operation One: Exponential Expression|

|You may now apply Exponents to any expression of THE First Tongue that you produce.When anExponentis applied, the effect of that expression is multiplied by itself according to the value of the Exponent available.
An Exponent of 2 causes the expression to multiply by itself once.
An Exponent of 3 causes the expression to multiply by itself twice.
And so forth.|
|Example Application: An Inscriptio Nominata targeting an enemy’s foundation would normally cause deterioration proportional to the authority invested.
With an Exponent of 2 applied, that deterioration multiplies by itself, causing the effect to grow not linearly but geometrically.
The target experiences not twice the deterioration but the deterioration multiplied by the deterioration, a compounding that far exceeds simple doubling.|
|Critical Understanding: Exponentiation is not multiplication.
When you apply an Exponent of 2 to an attack that would deal 100 units of damage, you do not deal 200 units.
You deal 100 multiplied by 100, resulting in 10,000 units.
When you apply an Exponent of 3, you deal 100 multiplied by 100 multiplied by 100, resulting in 1,000,000 units.
The scaling is not additive or multiplicative but exponential, growing at rates that quickly exceed comprehension.|

|This operation can be applied to: Embodiments, Apophasis, Inscriptions of all types, Archai of Existence, Harvests, defensive constructs, foundational weight expressions, and any other weaving of THE First Tongue you produce.
At your current level, an Exponent of upto 3 may be possible.
Higher expressions will require a qualitative change.|
Noah felt his foundations tremble as he successfully set up the weavings of Exponential Expression.

An Inscription that would normally cause moderate damage to an enemy’s foundation could, with an Exponent of 3 applied, cause damage that exceeded what most shitty Absolutes like THE Living Elemental could survive.

A defensive Embodiment that would normally block attacks from beings of equivalent foundation could, with an Exponent of 2 applied, block attacks from beings whose foundations exceeded his own by margins that should have been insurmountable.
And Harvests!

If he applied an Exponent to his Perpetual Harvest or his Rite of Paradoxical Inheritance, the resources he claimed from defeated enemies would multiply by themselves according to the Exponent chosen.

An enemy whose collapse would normally grant him theoretical 1000 units of foundational weight would grant him 1,000,000 units with an Exponent of 2 applied, or 1,000,000,000 units with an Exponent of 3.

THE Absolute Existential Palace of The Weavers, if he applied an Exponent of 2...would not be as if he doubled the rewards for killing an Absolute, but he effectively would be multiplying the rewards of a fallen Absolute...by themselves.
So not an Absolute times 2, but an Absolute times an Absolute!
He...really wanted to see what the result would be.
The scaling was terrifying!
More prompts continued.
|Core Operation Two: Multiplicative Amplification|
|You may now apply simple Multiplication to any expression of THE First Tongue that you produce.
Unlike Exponentiation, Multiplication scales linearly but can be applied with values that exceed single digits.
A Multiplier of 10 causes the expression to be 10 times more effective.
A Multiplier of 100 causes it to be 100 times more effective.
A Multiplier of 1000 causes it to be 1000 times more effective.|
|Multiplicative Amplification is less dramatic than Exponential Expression but more predictable and controllable.
It is recommended for situations where precise scaling is desired rather than overwhelming force.|
|This operation can be combined with Exponentiation for compound effects.
An expression with a Multiplier of 10 and an Exponent of 2 would first be multiplied by 10, then that result would be multiplied by itself.
The compounding of operations creates amplification that exceeds either operation alone.
Currently maximum Multiplication Value: 10|
|Core Operation Three: Divisive Reduction|
|You may now apply Division to expressions of THE First Tongue that target you or your allies.
When Division is applied to an incoming attack or effect, its potency is divided by the value chosen.
An incoming attack divided by 10 retains only one-tenth of its original effect.
An incoming attack divided by 100 retains only one-hundredth.|
|This operation provides defensive applications that complement the offensive applications of Exponentiation and Multiplication.
Attacks that would normally devastate your existence can be reduced to negligible inconveniences through sufficient Division.|
|Note: Division cannot reduce effects to zero.
The minimum result of any Division is an infinitesimally small but still present effect.
Complete negation still requires Apophasis declaration rather than numerical reduction.
Current maximum value for Division: 10|

chapters.title: Chapter 4922: Immensity I
paragraphs: In THE Interstices, Noah sat down with a serious expression of focused intent.

The space around him held no true temperature, yet he could feel something close coolness pressing against his skin where the void touched his existence. It was always this way in THE Interstices, a place that existed between places, where light had no source but illuminated everything with pale radiance that cast no shadows.
His throne of Absolute Seals was grand beneath him!

His blue-gold pen materialized in his grasp, and immediately he felt the familiar surge of connection that came with holding what he chose to be the sword and instrument of THE First Tongue. The sensation was difficult to describe to those who had never experienced it, and really, nobody in existence apart from him could!

It was like standing at the edge of an endless ocean that was somehow also inside him, waves of infinite potential lapping at the shores of his consciousness. The 27 Phonemes of his expanded First Tongue swirled around him in configurations that reflected his current state, their movements growing more precise as his focus sharpened.
He had theoretical understanding of THE Numerical Sovereignty now and how he wanted thr integration of numbers to be.
But theory was nothing without practical application.

Noah shifted his weight on the throne, rolling his shoulders once before settling into the stillness that composition required. A golden page unfolded before him, blank and waiting, its surface catching the sourceless light of THE Interstices. This would be an Inscriptio Dormiens, a Sleeping Inscription that would wait within his existence until he chose to awaken it. But unlike the Inscriptions he had written before, this one would carry numerical augmentation that exceeded anything he had previously produced.
He began...to write!

The pen moved across the golden page with deliberate strokes, and with each Phoneme that burned into existence, Noah felt the familiar sensation intensify. It was like drawing threads of fire and meaning from that infinite ocean, weaving them together into patterns that reality itself would be forced to acknowledge. The sensation of Primus Mana ran up his arm, across his shoulders, settled behind his eyes with pressure that was not quite pain.
Each letter carried weight. Each word demanded something of him. Each sentence reshaped the relationship between his will and the fabric of existence as this was the price he paid for Infinity!

"The Depths of my target are not beyond my reach. My strikes are not limited by the weight they carry, but are amplified by the difference between my foundation and the foundation of the one who stands against me. The greater the gap in my favor, the more devastating my assault becomes."

The words burned with blue-gold light as the Inscription completed itself, and Noah released a breath of blue gold fire. His fingers ached faintly where they gripped the pen, a reminder that even Infinite authority demanded something from its wielder!
The Inscription settled into the stable form of an Inscriptio Dormiens, hovering before him with patient malevolence.
He assessed its baseline potency with eyes that had learned to perceive the mathematical weight underlying all expressions of THE First Tongue.

At its current state, this Inscription was formidable. Against that wretched, curse-ridden fool of an Absolute like THE Living Elemental who suffered under his Apophasis, it would cause significant foundational damage.

Against stronger Absolutes, it would wound but not devastate.Against beings like Bazuman or THE Undivided Ones emerging from THE Prima Indifferentia, it would likely be insufficient to cause meaningful harm.
That was about to change.

Noah’s eyes shone as he reached toward the Inscription with his consciousness. This was different from writing, different from the creative act of composition. This was imposition. This was taking something that already existed and forcing it to become more than it was!

The Numerical Sovereignty responded to his intent like a door opening in his mind, revealing mathematical structures that had always existed within THE First Tongue but that no one before him had possessed the Infinite nature to perceive.

He could see the inherent value of the Inscription now. Numbers flickered at the edges of his vision, not truly visible but somehow present, describing relationships and ratios that the Inscription embodied without knowing it embodied them.
"Multiplicative Amplification. Factor of ten."
HUUM!
The sound was not truly a sound. It was Existence acknowledging that something fundamental had shifted.

The single golden page blazed with light that made Noah squint despite himself, brightness that seemed to press against his face like heat from a forge. But the transformation went beyond mere power increase!

Before his eyes, the Inscription began to divide, to multiply, to replicate itself with precision of mathematical law rather than simple duplication. It was like watching a single flame become ten flames, each one burning with a more vibrant hungry intensity as the original.
Where one Inscriptio Dormiens had existed, now ten identical pages burned with blue-gold radiance!

Noah leaned forward slightly on his throne, his earlier stillness forgotten as he observed the phenomenon with eyes that missed nothing. Each of the ten Inscriptions carried the same words, elevated authority, and grander potential for devastation. Ten offensive weapons where before there had been only one, and each of the ten now operated at amplified potency that made the original seem almost quaint by comparison.
Prompts bloomed before his eyes.
|Multiplicative Amplification Applied|

|Your Inscriptio Dormiens has been amplified by a Multiplicative Factor of 10. This amplification has manifested in two ways: the power of the Inscription has been multiplied tenfold, and the Inscription itself has been replicated into 10 identical copies.|

|Practical Assessment at Current Level: Each of these 10 Inscriptions now carries offensive potential that would devastate weakened Absolutes like that pathetic, kneeling wretch THE Living Elemental with a single activation. One hit, one kill.His deteriorating foundations would not survive even one strike enhanced by this amplified authority. Against standard Absolutes of equivalent or lesser foundation, these Inscriptions would cause severe foundational damage that could lead to collapse within sustained engagement.Against beings like Bazuman or THE Undivided Ones, these Inscriptions would now be capable of causing genuine wounds rather than superficial scratches.|
|You now possess 10 Multiplicatively Amplified Inscriptiones Dormientes (Offensive)|

Noah looked at the ten burning pages that now hovered before him, arranged in a loose circle like attendants awaiting command. The light they cast painted his features in shades of blue and gold, alternating as the Inscriptions pulsed with their newfound potency!
He could feel their readiness, their eagerness to be used, like hounds straining at leashes. What had been a single weapon was now an arsenal, each piece more potent than the original had been alone!
But he was not finished.

He straightened on his throne, drawing a deep breath that seemed to pull the scattered energies of THE Interstices into himself. The void around him responded to his focus, growing somehow more still, more expectant. Even the Phonemes that eternally danced around his form slowed their swirling, sensing that something significant was about to occur.
Now came Exponential Expression!
This was where THE Numerical Sovereignty truly revealed its terrifying potential.

Noah gathered all ten Inscriptions together with a gesture that was more will than motion, bringing them into alignment before him. They resisted slightly, each one possessing enough autonomous authority to have opinions about being manipulated. He imposed his intent upon them regardless, and they submitted to his dominion with reluctance that he felt as a faint pressure behind his temples.

The mathematical structures in his mind shifted, rearranged themselves, presented new possibilities that had not existed moments before. Exponentiation. Not multiplication, which merely added copies of a value to itself. Exponentiation multiplied a value by itself, again and again, creating growth that quickly exceeded comprehension.
"Exponential Expression. Exponent of three."
HUUM!
The ten Inscriptions transformed in ways that exceeded anything the Multiplicative Amplification had produced!
