chapters.title: Chapter 4923: Immensity II
paragraphs: Noah’s eyes buzzed! The sensation that washed over him was like nothing he had experienced before, like standing in a river that was suddenly revealed to be an ocean, like holding a candle that became a sun!
Oh!
Exponential Expression!

The golden pages burned with light so intense, but he did not look away for even a moment, spots dancing in his vision despite his grand nature. In moments, what hovered before him was something entirely different from what he had created.

The words on each page remained unchanged, but they now carried weight that pressed against Existence itself with authority that bordered on conceptual. The Inscriptions seemed to pulse with heartbeats of power, each pulse releasing waves of pressure that made his skin prickle, that made the void of THE Interstices itself seem to flinch away.
The fucking Interstices flinched!
He could feel them now in a way he had not felt the originals, a constant awareness at the back of his mind like the presence of dangerous predators that had chosen, for the moment, not to attack.
But the transformation went deeper than mere power increase.
The edges of each Inscription began to shimmer with dual lights that should not have coexisted. Blue-gold Infinities wove alongside something else, something that held the nature of paradox itself.
Differentiation and undifferentiation merged within the infinite constructs, creating weapons that could harm through definition and through dissolution simultaneously!
Prompts bloomed with weight that exceeded anything Noah had witnessed from RUINATION before.
|Exponential Expression Applied|

|Your 10 Multiplicatively Amplified Inscriptiones Dormientes have been subjected to Exponential Expression with an Exponent of 3. Through this process, they have transcended their original classification entirely.|
|New Designation: THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes|

|These elevated Inscriptions have gained a terrifying exponential power that incorporates both infinite undifferentiation and infinite differentiation into their offensive nature. They now exist in states that are simultaneously defined and undefined, allowing them to harm beings regardless of their existential composition.|
|Comprehensive Threat Assessment|

|Against Normal Absolutes: THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes would cause immediate and catastrophic foundational collapse. That sniveling, burn-ridden disgrace of an Absolute known as THE Living Elemental, already writhing under your curse like the pitiful creature he is, would be erased from existence with a single activation. Even healthy Absolutes of standard classification would find their foundations torn apart by the dual assault of differentiation and undifferentiation operating in exponential harmony.|

|Against Undivided Ones: These beings, which normally resist conventional attacks due to their undifferentiated nature, would find no refuge from Inscriptions that wield undifferentiation AND Differentiation as a weapon. THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones would speak to THE Undivided Ones in their own language while simultaneously imposing definition upon them, creating damage that their usual immunities cannot deflect. Beings like Bazuman would suffer genuine, lasting harm from these weapons.|

|Against Formless Terrors: Similarly, THE Formless Terrors that lack stable form would find themselves vulnerable to Inscriptions that attack through both form and formlessness. The exponential nature of the assault would catch them regardless of which state they occupied at any given moment.|

|Against Primordial Architects: Well, a lot about them is unknown but..even these ancient beings, products of differentiation and undifferentiation during THE First Cause, would not be immune. THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones speak the fundamental language of their existence and could potentially wound entities that have not faced genuine threat since before THE Infinite Unfurling. Whether such wounds would do much is uncertain, but the capacity to harm Primordial Architects at all represents power that few beings in Observable Existence possess.|
Noah read over these prompts with eyes that blazed with understanding. His hands had curled into fists without his conscious decision. Ten Inscriptions!

Each one capable of erasing standard Absolutes with single activations. Each one capable of genuinely wounding THE Undivided Ones and Formless Terrors that were currently flooding across Observable Existence. Each one potentially capable of harming even Primordial Architects themselves.
He set THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes aside carefully. The Inscriptions resisted separation from their creator, wanting to remain close, wanting to be used!
And oh, he would use them!
Their golden pages burned with dual lights that made the other Inscriptions on his desk seem like children’s toys by comparison, like drawings of weapons next to the actual blades.
Now for the defensive application.

Noah rolled his neck, hearing the faint crack of tension releasing, and took another golden page in hand. The Phonemes swirled around his form with increased intensity, responding to his intent before he had fully formed it, eager to participate in another act of glory.

He began to write once more, his movements carrying the same deliberate precision that had produced the offensive Inscription. The sensation of drawing from that infinite ocean returned, familiar now but no less demanding.

"I am not vulnerable to those whose foundations cannot match my own. The protection I receive is not static but scales with the difference between my weight and the weight of the one who seeks to harm me. The greater my foundation exceeds theirs, the more impenetrable my defense becomes."

The words settled into place as another Inscriptio Dormiens completed itself. Where the offensive Inscription had felt like a blade being forged, this one felt like armor being fitted, like walls being raised around something precious.

Noah looked at the completed Inscription and allowed himself a moment of satisfaction before beginning the augmentation process once more. The defensive application would follow the same pattern, but he found himself curious whether the sensations would differ.
"Multiplicative Amplification. Factor of ten."
HUUM!

The defensive Inscription blazed with light as the numerical operation took effect! The warmth that washed over him was different this time, not the hungry heat of a forge but the comfortable warmth of a hearth, of safety, of walls that nothing could breach.
As with the offensive Inscription, the single page divided and replicated, becoming ten identical defensive Inscriptions that burned with amplified protective authority!
|Multiplicative Amplification Applied|
|Your defensive Inscriptio Dormiens has been amplified by a Multiplicative Factor of 10, manifesting as both power increase and replication into 10 identical copies.|

|Practical Assessment at Current Level: Each of these 10 Inscriptions now provides protection that would render attacks from standard Absolutes negligible. That miserable, foundation-crumbling embarrassment THE Living Elemental’s strikes, even if he could muster them through his curse, would fail to register as threats. Attacks from beings of equivalent foundation would be significantly blunted. Even assaults from powerful entities like Bazuman would be substantially reduced, transforming potentially lethal strikes into manageable damage.|
|You now possess 10 Multiplicatively Amplified Inscriptiones Dormientes (Defensive)|
Noah nodded once, sharply, and continued without pause. His focus had narrowed to a point, all other concerns falling away like shed clothing. There was only this. Only the next step!
"Exponential Expression. Exponent of three."
HUUM!
The ten defensive Inscriptions transformed with radiance that matched their offensive counterparts!

The golden pages burned with light that seemed to create bubbles of absolute safety around them, spheres of impossibility that declared harm could not exist within their boundaries. Looking at them, Noah felt something loosen in his chest, some tension he had not realized he was carrying!

The dual lights of differentiation and undifferentiation wove through the protective declarations, creating shields that existed in states beyond conventional defense. They were and were not. They blocked through presence and through absence. They protected!
|Exponential Expression Applied|

|Your 10 Multiplicatively Amplified defensive Inscriptiones Dormientes have been subjected to Exponential Expression with an Exponent of 3. Through this process, they have transcended their original classification entirely.|
|New Designation: THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes (Defensive)|

|These elevated Inscriptions have gained a terrifying exponential protective power that incorporates both infinite undifferentiation and infinite differentiation into their defensive nature. They protect through simultaneous assertion of form and formlessness, creating barriers that cannot be bypassed by conventional means.|
|Comprehensive Protection Assessment|

|Against Normal Absolutes: Attacks from standard Absolutes would fail to penetrate these defenses entirely. Whether strikes of pure Civilizational Authority or exotic methodologies, they would encounter protection that speaks their language and negates their effectiveness.That worthless, groveling heap of deteriorating foundations known as THE Living Elemental could strike for eternity without causing meaningful harm.|

|Against Undivided Ones: THE Undivided Ones attack through undifferentiation, seeking to dissolve their targets back into proto-potential. These Inscriptions counter by wielding undifferentiation themselves, creating defensive resonance that nullifies such assaults. Bazuman’s attempts to consume would find nothing to grasp, as the protection exists in states that mirror his own methodology.|

|Against Formless Terrors: Similarly, the chaotic attacks of Formless Terrors would find no purchase against defenses that embrace formlessness as readily as form. Their violence would pass through without effect, unable to locate a stable target within the paradoxical protective field.|

|Against Primordial Architects: Even attacks from these ancient beings would besomewhatmitigated. While complete immunity cannot be guaranteed against entities who shaped the nature of differentiation and undifferentiation itself, these Inscriptions would provide substantial protection that could mean the difference between survival and collapse.|

And oh, he would use them!
Their golden pages burned with dual lights that made the other Inscriptions on his desk seem like children’s toys by comparison, like drawings of weapons next to the actual blades.
Now for the defensive application.
Noah rolled his neck, hearing the faint crack of tension releasing, and took another golden page in hand.
The Phonemes swirled around his form with increased intensity, responding to his intent before he had fully formed it, eager to participate in another act of glory.
He began to write once more, his movements carrying the same deliberate precision that had produced the offensive Inscription.
The sensation of drawing from that infinite ocean returned, familiar now but no less demanding.
"I am not vulnerable to those whose foundations cannot match my own.
The protection I receive is not static but scales with the difference between my weight and the weight of the one who seeks to harm me.
The greater my foundation exceeds theirs, the more impenetrable my defense becomes."
The words settled into place as another Inscriptio Dormiens completed itself.
Where the offensive Inscription had felt like a blade being forged, this one felt like armor being fitted, like walls being raised around something precious.
Noah looked at the completed Inscription and allowed himself a moment of satisfaction before beginning the augmentation process once more.
The defensive application would follow the same pattern, but he found himself curious whether the sensations would differ.
"Multiplicative Amplification.
Factor of ten."
HUUM!
The defensive Inscription blazed with light as the numerical operation took effect!
The warmth that washed over him was different this time, not the hungry heat of a forge but the comfortable warmth of a hearth, of safety, of walls that nothing could breach.
As with the offensive Inscription, the single page divided and replicated, becoming ten identical defensive Inscriptions that burned with amplified protective authority!
|Multiplicative Amplification Applied|
|Your defensive Inscriptio Dormiens has been amplified by a Multiplicative Factor of 10, manifesting as both power increase and replication into 10 identical copies.|
|Practical Assessment at Current Level: Each of these 10 Inscriptions now provides protection that would render attacks from standard Absolutes negligible.
That miserable, foundation-crumbling embarrassment THE Living Elemental’s strikes, even if he could muster them through his curse, would fail to register as threats.
Attacks from beings of equivalent foundation would be significantly blunted.
Even assaults from powerful entities like Bazuman would be substantially reduced, transforming potentially lethal strikes into manageable damage.|
|You now possess 10 Multiplicatively Amplified Inscriptiones Dormientes (Defensive)|
Noah nodded once, sharply, and continued without pause.
His focus had narrowed to a point, all other concerns falling away like shed clothing.
There was only this.
Only the next step!
"Exponential Expression.
Exponent of three."
HUUM!
The ten defensive Inscriptions transformed with radiance that matched their offensive counterparts!
The golden pages burned with light that seemed to create bubbles of absolute safety around them, spheres of impossibility that declared harm could not exist within their boundaries.
Looking at them, Noah felt something loosen in his chest, some tension he had not realized he was carrying!
The dual lights of differentiation and undifferentiation wove through the protective declarations, creating shields that existed in states beyond conventional defense.
They were and were not.
They blocked through presence and through absence.
They protected!
|Exponential Expression Applied|
|Your 10 Multiplicatively Amplified defensive Inscriptiones Dormientes have been subjected to Exponential Expression with an Exponent of 3.
Through this process, they have transcended their original classification entirely.|
|New Designation: THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes (Defensive)|
|These elevated Inscriptions have gained a terrifying exponential protective power that incorporates both infinite undifferentiation and infinite differentiation into their defensive nature.
They protect through simultaneous assertion of form and formlessness, creating barriers that cannot be bypassed by conventional means.|
|Comprehensive Protection Assessment|
|Against Normal Absolutes: Attacks from standard Absolutes would fail to penetrate these defenses entirely.

Whether strikes of pure Civilizational Authority or exotic methodologies, they would encounter protection that speaks their language and negates their effectiveness.That worthless, groveling heap of deteriorating foundations known as THE Living Elemental could strike for eternity without causing meaningful harm.|
|Against Undivided Ones: THE Undivided Ones attack through undifferentiation, seeking to dissolve their targets back into proto-potential.
These Inscriptions counter by wielding undifferentiation themselves, creating defensive resonance that nullifies such assaults.
Bazuman’s attempts to consume would find nothing to grasp, as the protection exists in states that mirror his own methodology.|
|Against Formless Terrors: Similarly, the chaotic attacks of Formless Terrors would find no purchase against defenses that embrace formlessness as readily as form.
Their violence would pass through without effect, unable to locate a stable target within the paradoxical protective field.|
|Against Primordial Architects: Even attacks from these ancient beings would besomewhatmitigated.

While complete immunity cannot be guaranteed against entities who shaped the nature of differentiation and undifferentiation itself, these Inscriptions would provide substantial protection that could mean the difference between survival and collapse.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4924: Infinite Harvest! I
paragraphs: Noah set THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes (Defensive) beside their offensive counterparts on his desk.

Twenty elevated Inscriptions now burned before him, arranged in two groups of ten, their twin radiances illuminating THE Interstices with authority that exceeded anything this space had contained before.
The light they cast was almost warm against his skin, almost like sunlight!
Offense and defense.
Both augmented to levels that transcended their original classifications.
Both capable of affecting beings that would have seemed untouchable before THE Numerical Sovereignty had been integrated into his weavings of THE First Tongue.

After he was done testing this out, Noah sat back on his throne of Absolute Seals. The crystallized authority pressed against his back, solid and reassuring. His blue-gold pen still swirled with Infinities pulsing around its form, still ready to write more Inscriptions if he desired.
The Phonemes had resumed their endless dance around his existence, galaxies of infinite authority that now carried numerical values alongside their semantic meanings.
The void of THE Interstices stretched out around him, patient and immense as when he thought about the capabilities of what he had just designed...
Oh, what he just forged?!
He could not help but lean his head back against the throne.
And then he used his hand to cover his face.

But through the gaps between his fingers, an utterly terrifying devilish smile could be seen rising across his features. His resplendent white teeth showed gloriously as the smile widened, as the implications of what he had just created settled fully into his consciousness. His shoulders shook once, twice, with laughter that he did not permit to escape his throat!

With THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes, he could erase standard Absolutes, wound THE Undivided Ones and Formless Terrors, and potentially gain a tiny footing even against Primordial Architects.
With their defensive counterparts, he could become nearly invulnerable to attacks from beings across all classifications of existence.
And these were merely his first tests of THE Numerical Sovereignty!
What would happen when he applied these operations to his Harvests? To his Archai of Existence? To his Perpetual Harvest that already claimed resources from enemies across Observable Existence?
The smile behind his hand grew even wider.
THE Genesis Monarch had just done something that Observable Existence was not prepared for, and he was only getting started!
After his tests designing and elevating Inscriptions with Multiplicative Amplification and Exponential Expression, Noah turned his gaze inward.
The Inscriptions were merely the beginning. Weapons and shields were useful, certainly, but they were tools.
What he was about to do was different.
What he was about to do would transform the very nature of how he grew!

Noah straightened on his throne of Absolute Seals, feeling the crystallized authority press against his back as he drew a breath that seemed to pull the scattered energies of THE Interstices into his lungs.
He called out grandly and unequivocally.

"Apply Multiplicative Amplification and Exponential Expression to all incoming harvest from the spread of my Absolute Seals across Observable Existence. Every single thing benefiting, every area covered, every harvest turned into Infinite Potential that further amplifies my existence and foundation..."
His voice dropped to something that pressed against reality itself.
"Multiply it and exponentially elevate it."
BOOM!

The sound was...well, not truly a sound. It was Existence acknowledging that something fundamental had shifted in the relationship between Noah Osmont and the resources that flowed toward him across all of Observable Existence!

He knew this would be one of the heaviest actions he could take. Such a configuration was not merely heavy. It was the kind of thing that would have overwhelmed foundations unprepared for the volume of power about to surge through them.
But he had Infinities!
So he could withstand it! He could pay the price!
Noah felt his Depth and Immensity moving in response to his words.

The sensation was grand. This was not external manipulation of Inscriptions that existed outside his existence. This was internal restructuring, his very being rearranging itself to accommodate the mathematical operations he had imposed upon his harvest. He could feel the numbers taking shape within him, not as abstract concepts but as physical structures that wove themselves through his foundations like new organs being grown.
His Absolute Seals surged around him with intensity.

They had always swirled. They had always danced in configurations that reflected his state of mind and authority. But now they moved with purpose. They flowed outward and inward simultaneously, streaming from his existence in rivers of blue-gold light that curved and bent and folded back upon themselves.
And they formed something.

A massive blue-gold infinity symbol materialized around him, its loops stretching across THE Interstices until they seemed to encompass the entire space here. Noah floated at its center while seated on his throne, the crystallized authority beneath him now simply another part of the greater configuration. The infinity symbol burned with light that pulsed in rhythms matching his heartbeat, and he could feel it not just as a visual phenomenon but as an extension of his own existence.
All incoming harvest flowed into this churning infinity symbol!

The first streams arrived within moments of the configuration completing itself. Harvest from his Absolute Seals spreading across Observable Existence. Harvest from the corrupted paradoxical proto-matter that THE Living Paradox was flooding everywhere, carrying Noah’s Infinities alongside his own Information. Harvest from every being who used THE First Tongue and paid the Existential Tariffs he had established.
The harvest flowed into the infinity symbol like rivers joining an endless sea.
And then the Multiplicative Amplification took effect.
Noah gasped as the incoming harvest was multiplied by ten!

The sensation was overwhelming in its immediacy. What had been a steady flow of resources became a torrent, a flood, an ocean of potential that surged through the loops of the infinity symbol with force that made his foundations buzz. He could feel the potency of each unit of harvest increasing tenfold, and simultaneously, the volume multiplied as well. Not just stronger harvest, but more of it, ten times as much crashing against his existence with every passing moment.

The infinity symbol churned with increased intensity, the blue-gold light brightening until Noah had to narrow his eyes against its radiance. The harvest surged along the loops, compressed and concentrated, building toward something that felt inevitable.
And then the Exponential Expression activated.
Harvest multiplied by itself.
And then multiplied by itself again.
And then multiplied by itself a third time!
Harvest times harvest times harvest!

The already-multiplied harvest didn’t merely increase in power. It compounded upon itself with mathematical precision that produced results exceeding comprehension. What had been tenfold became something else entirely, something that existed at scales where normal measurement lost meaning.
He watched as the churning harvest within the infinity symbol began to condense.

The streams of raw potential that had been flowing through the loops started to concentrate, to crystallize, to take on form that they had not possessed moments before. The blue-gold light shifted, became something more golden, more defined, more singular in its purpose!
And Noah understood what he was witnessing. He even came up with a name for it!
"THE Infinite Observable Harvest," he breathed.
The name emerged from him without conscious decision, pulled from some deep understanding that recognized what was forming before his eyes!

This was what he felt when he looked at the condensing power. Not mere harvest. Not simple resources being accumulated. Something elevated beyond normal classification through the mathematical operations he had imposed.
A single unit of THE Infinite Observable Harvest completed its formation.

It looked like a golden infinity symbol, smaller than the massive configuration surrounding him but burning with intensity that exceeded its size. The unit floated within the greater infinity symbol for a moment, beautiful and terrible and filled with potential that made his foundations ache with anticipation.
Then it flowed into him.
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4925: Infinite Harvest! II
paragraphs: Noah’s spine arched against his throne as THE Infinite Observable Harvest integrated with his existence!

The weight of his Absolute Seals rose up tremendously, their authority strengthening with speed that exceeded anything conventional harvest could have provided. His foundations felt the impact like a physical blow, but it was a blow that built rather than destroyed, that elevated rather than damaged. His Infinite Formless Depth expanded to accommodate what was being added to him!
And moments after the first unit, another unit of THE Infinite Observable Harvest formed.

It smashed into his existence with force that made him grip his armrests until the crystallized authority cracked beneath his fingers! His Infinite Formless Depth amplified again, its weight and immensity growing with speed that would have taken conventional beings eons to achieve. The sensation was almost painful, like growing too fast, like his existence was being stretched to accommodate power that exceeded its previous capacity.
But his Infinite nature adapted!
It always quintessentially adapted!

Unit after unit of THE Infinite Observable Harvest formed within the churning infinity symbol and flowed into his existence. Each one carried the compounded potency of harvest that had been multiplied tenfold and then raised to the third power. Each one elevated his foundations by margins that should have been impossible. Each one made him more than he had been moments before.
Prompts bloomed before his eyes with weight that pressed against his consciousness.
|Multiplicative Amplification and Exponential Expression Applied to Harvest|

|All incoming harvest from the spread of your Absolute Seals across Observable Existence is now subject to numerical operations before integration. Harvest is first multiplied by a factor of 10, increasing both potency and volume tenfold. This multiplied harvest is then subjected to Exponential Expression with an Exponent of 3, causing the harvest to compound upon itself three times.|

|The result has been designated THE Infinite Observable Harvest.Each unit represents harvest that has been amplified beyond conventional measurement, carrying potential that exceeds what standard harvest could provide by margins that approach infinity.|
|Storage and Application|

|THE Infinite Observable Harvest can be directly integrated into your foundations for immediate growth, as is currently occurring. Alternatively, units of THE Infinite Observable Harvest can be stored within THE Organ of Civilization that exists at the core of your existence.|

|Stored units of THE Infinite Observable Harvest serve as raw material for the production of resources at any scale you desire. THE Organ of Civilization can process stored Infinite Observable Harvest into Absolute Everythings for the elevation of your followers, into Infinite Everythings for the enhancement of your own capabilities, or into any other resource configuration that your Civilization requires.|

|Note: The production capacity of THE Organ of Civilization has increased proportionally with the quality of harvest being stored. Resources that previously required significant time to produce can now be generated nearly instantaneously when drawing upon THE Infinite Observable Harvest.|
|Foundation Status Update|
|Your Surface Depth Foundation has achieved weight and immensity equivalent to 15 times the comparative baseline of THE Primordial Paradox and THE Creature before they became Absolutes.|
|Your Intermediate Depth Foundation has achieved weight and immensity equivalent to 14 times the comparative baseline.|

|Your Fundamental Depth Foundation has achieved weight and immensity equivalent to 9 times the comparative baseline. At Fundamental Depth, you now possess foundations that exceed what THE Four held before their ascension to Absolutea by a factor approaching one order of magnitude.|
|Assessment: Your foundational weight at all Depths now exceeds any being below Absolute classification by margins that render comparison almost meaningless. Almost.|
Noah’s figure pulsed with grand power as he remained seated in THE Interstices.

But this entire region was now unfathomably bright. The blue and gold light that emanated from his existence and the churning infinity symbol around him permeated across THE Interstices from where he sat, painting the void in colors that it had never known before.
He could feel the harvest continuing to flow.

Unit after unit of THE Infinite Observable Harvest formed and integrated with his existence, each one adding to foundations that were already growing at rates that exceeded comprehension. The infinity symbol churned with endless activity, processing the incoming harvest through Multiplicative Amplification and Exponential Expression with efficiency that required no conscious attention from him.
This would continue indefinitely.

So long as his Absolute Seals spread and remained spread across Observable Existence, so long as THE Living Paradox’s process continued flooding corruption and Infinities everywhere, the harvest would flow. And that harvest would be multiplied and exponentially elevated before integration, producing growth that conventional beings could never hope to match.
Noah nodded to himself with a dangerous smile.
It was time to move.
He had to see just the true extent of his power!

Not even an Absolute yet, and yet he could utterly destroy the trashiest bum Absolutes like that pathetic heap of burning foundations known as THE Living Elemental.The gap between his existence and such weakened Absolutes had grown so vast that eliminating them would require less effort than swatting an irritating insect.
But what about stronger enemies?
What about the things that had seemed untouchable when he first emerged into this existential conflict?
"Oh, Bazuman, can I now reach you?"

Sometimes, an enemy was so far away that one knew they couldn’t do anything against them for some time. Bazuman had felt this way when Noah first witnessed him in THE Prima Indifferentia. THE Undivided One had chased him with hunger that spoke of inevitable consumption, and Noah had fled because fighting had seemed pointless against something so fundamentally beyond his capabilities.
But now?
Now he wondered.

Noah’s body in THE Interstices remained still, seated upon his throne at the center of the churning infinity symbol while THE Infinite Observable Harvest continued flowing into his existence.But another body of his in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment stood beside THE Primordial Paradox and the Strategoi, facing the crack from which Bazuman had emerged.
He would test his power through that body against an Undivided One!

And at the same time as this occurred, he dealt with multiple other things through different bodies across Observable Existence. One body monitored THE Yggdrheim where his people struggled against infinite undifferentiation.

Another body continued its work in THE Wastes with THE Great Usurper and gathering information. Another body remained with THE Mnemonic Leviathan in THE Infiniverse, observing the changes being induced by their grand actions.
But the body in THE Interstices did something else as well.

It continued looking at an illusory screen that had formed before his throne, displaying images from Alfheimr where THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive currently struggled. The screen showed that wretched, sniveling disgrace of an Absolute still suffering under Noah’s curse, his foundations deteriorating with every passing moment while he could barely stand.
In front of him, THE Living Emotive defended against an Undivided One alone.

The screen of THE Living Elemental struggling... he would continue to look at it. Even though Noah could kill this being with a thought, even though THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes would erase him from existence with a single activation, Noah wanted him to suffer for now!
Let him burn.
Let him feel the weight of the curse that would never lift until Noah decided to show mercy in death and collapse.
Let him understand what it meant to have made an enemy of THE Genesis Monarch!
But as he watched?
"Oh?"

Noah actually rose up from his throne slightly, his hands pressing against the armrests as his attention sharpened with sudden interest. Something unique was happening on the screen. Something he had not noticed before. Something that his newly elevated perception now made visible in ways that his previous sight could not have achieved.
He saw a flow of authority around Emotive.

It was uniquely filled with intense and profound Definition, that quality of existence that separated differentiated beings from the proto-potential of THE Prima Indifferentia. The flow was subtle, almost invisible, and it moved in a direction that seemed wrong.
It flowed from Emotive into THE Undivided One.
"Ho?"

Noah paid attention fully now, his dangerous smile fading into something more analytical as he observed the phenomenon with eyes that broke down both languages and numbers. His vision moved between Differentiation and Undifferentiation with ease that his existence had not possessed before THE Numerical Sovereignty was integrated into his First Tongue.
He could see the mathematical relationships underlying the flow, the ratios and proportions that described what was occurring.
Emotive was giving something to THE Undivided One.
Not fighting it. Not defending against it. Giving something to it while appearing to fight.
"Whatever are you doing, O Emotive?"

THE Undivided One had chased him with hunger that spoke of inevitable consumption, and Noah had fled because fighting had seemed pointless against something so fundamentally beyond his capabilities.
But now?
Now he wondered.

Noah’s body in THE Interstices remained still, seated upon his throne at the center of the churning infinity symbol while THE Infinite Observable Harvest continued flowing into his existence.But another body of his in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment stood beside THE Primordial Paradox and the Strategoi, facing the crack from which Bazuman had emerged.
He would test his power through that body against an Undivided One!
And at the same time as this occurred, he dealt with multiple other things through different bodies across Observable Existence.
One body monitored THE Yggdrheim where his people struggled against infinite undifferentiation.
Another body continued its work in THE Wastes with THE Great Usurper and gathering information.
Another body remained with THE Mnemonic Leviathan in THE Infiniverse, observing the changes being induced by their grand actions.
But the body in THE Interstices did something else as well.
It continued looking at an illusory screen that had formed before his throne, displaying images from Alfheimr where THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive currently struggled.
The screen showed that wretched, sniveling disgrace of an Absolute still suffering under Noah’s curse, his foundations deteriorating with every passing moment while he could barely stand.
In front of him, THE Living Emotive defended against an Undivided One alone.
The screen of THE Living Elemental struggling... he would continue to look at it.

Even though Noah could kill this being with a thought, even though THE Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptiones Dormientes would erase him from existence with a single activation, Noah wanted him to suffer for now!
Let him burn.
Let him feel the weight of the curse that would never lift until Noah decided to show mercy in death and collapse.
Let him understand what it meant to have made an enemy of THE Genesis Monarch!
But as he watched?
"Oh?"
Noah actually rose up from his throne slightly, his hands pressing against the armrests as his attention sharpened with sudden interest.
Something unique was happening on the screen.
Something he had not noticed before.
Something that his newly elevated perception now made visible in ways that his previous sight could not have achieved.
He saw a flow of authority around Emotive.
It was uniquely filled with intense and profound Definition, that quality of existence that separated differentiated beings from the proto-potential of THE Prima Indifferentia.
The flow was subtle, almost invisible, and it moved in a direction that seemed wrong.
It flowed from Emotive into THE Undivided One.
"Ho?"
Noah paid attention fully now, his dangerous smile fading into something more analytical as he observed the phenomenon with eyes that broke down both languages and numbers.
His vision moved between Differentiation and Undifferentiation with ease that his existence had not possessed before THE Numerical Sovereignty was integrated into his First Tongue.
He could see the mathematical relationships underlying the flow, the ratios and proportions that described what was occurring.
Emotive was giving something to THE Undivided One.
Not fighting it.
Not defending against it.
Giving something to it while appearing to fight.
"Whatever are you doing, O Emotive?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4926: A Bond of Emotions!
paragraphs: Because of the Inscription that he had laid out on that waste of life that was THE Living Elemental, Noah was able to perceive what was happening around this being and his immediate surroundings.

The curse burned across Elemental’s foundations with relentless precision, but it also served as an anchor for Noah’s perception. Through that anchor, he could observe the region of Alfheimr where the cursed Absolute currently cowered, could see the beings that surrounded him and the conflicts that unfolded in his vicinity.
So he saw both THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive as she fought against an Undivided One that actually did not even seem like it wanted to be there.
The observation struck him as peculiar the moment he processed it fully.

THE Undivided One was a massive thing whose body resembled a great winged lion with the face of something that had never been mortal. No features of any realm Noah had witnessed could describe that visage, that configuration of angles and expressions that spoke of existence before existence had learned to differentiate itself into recognizable forms.

Its mane was made of writhing serpents that hissed with individual malice, each one a separate consciousness bound to the greater whole, their eyes burning with hunger that their host seemed reluctant to act upon. Its wings stretched wide enough to cast shadows across entire territories, vast expanses of feathered darkness that should have been beating with aggressive intent.
But there was something hesitant in its assault. Something reluctant in the way it pressed against Emotive’s defenses!

Where its paws touched, existence forgot what solidity meant. The ground beneath it became uncertain, wavering between states of matter as the undifferentiated nature of the beast leaked into its surroundings. And yet those paws moved with reluctance, striking toward Emotive with force that should have been devastating but pulling back at the last moment as if the winged lion feared the consequences of actually connecting.
Noah narrowed his eyes.

He wasn’t able to fully perceive everything that had occurred, but there should have been another Undivided One or two that came out with this one from THE Prima Indifferentia. He had felt their brief auras when the crack first opened above the mountain, terrible pressures that had made even his distant perception waver for a moment.
But those auras had disappeared rapidly, snuffed out with casual efficiency that spoke of overwhelming power.
He only attributed this to THE Creature.

So THE Undivided One that was attacking Emotive had to know that it could be taken care of by THE Creature at any time. The being at the peak of the mountain had already demonstrated his capacity to eliminate such threats.
This remaining winged lion understood that its existence continued only because THE Creature permitted it.

But since THE Creature wanted adversity for Emotive and Elemental, he did not interfere. That was the reason why the assault continued. Not because THE Undivided One posed a genuine threat, but because THE Creature had decided that his allies needed to struggle.

Emotive was defending as if she did not want to be there. Her Embodiments flew toward THE Undivided One with power that should have been devastating, but her movements held reluctance that her manic energy could not fully disguise. She threw attacks because she had to, not because she wanted to.
And THE Undivided One was attacking as if it also did not want to be there!

The winged lion’s serpent mane hissed toward Emotive with malice that seemed performative rather than genuine. Its massive paws swept through the air with force that would have devastated anything of an average Absolute, but the movements were perfunctory, going through motions rather than genuinely seeking to kill. Its wings beat with power that should have generated storms, yet they created only gentle breezes that barely disturbed Emotive’s constantly changing hair.
It knew that true aggression would invite THE Creature’s attention. It knew that actually harming these beings might transform it from permitted pest to consumed meal!
It was a unique and laughable situation.
But as Noah continued to observe, he noticed something else entirely.

His newly elevated perception, enhanced by THE Numerical Sovereignty and THE Infinite Observable Harvest flowing into his foundations, could perceive things that he had not been able to see before. His eyes broke down both languages and numbers now, moving between Differentiation and Undifferentiation with ease that allowed him to observe the mathematical relationships underlying existence itself.
And he saw something flowing from THE Living Emotive.
An extremely clear and intense definition of emotion was streaming from her existence and going into THE Undivided One.

The flow was invisible to normal perception. Even most Absolutes would not have been able to observe it. But Noah could see it now, could trace its path from Emotive’s foundations into the weavings of the winged lion with clarity that made the phenomenon undeniable.
Uniquely, THE Undivided One had no idea what was happening to it.

Its weavings were filled with light of undifferentiation, as was proper for a being that had existed in THE Prima Indifferentia. The serpents of its mane continued hissing with individual malice, unaware that their collective existence was being subtly altered. Its face that had never been mortal remained fixed in expressions that predated emotion itself. And yet, at this moment, something silent and invisible was flowing alongside its undifferentiated nature.
Something that was giving it a very clear and intense definition and differentiation based on emotions.

Noah leaned forward on his throne in THE Interstices, the churning infinity symbol around him pulsing with increased intensity as his attention sharpened. He watched the flow of emotional definition pour into THE Undivided One, watched it weave itself through the winged lion’s foundations without triggering any of its natural defenses against differentiation.
It was like watching someone slowly poison a drink while their victim remained oblivious.
His eyes flashed coldly as realization settled into his consciousness.
He had truly been underestimating THE Living Emotive!

Because as she threw out Embodiments here and there to keep THE Undivided One at bay, her actual power was focused elsewhere entirely. The attacks were distractions, performances meant to make it seem like she was fighting when in truth she was doing something far more insidious. Most of her authority was concentrated on this emotional light of definition, on the flow that was slowly transforming the winged lion from the inside out.
After a few more seconds of observation...
BOOM!
An impact occurred between THE Living Emotive and THE Undivided One!

Emotive breathed heavily with an angry look that twisted her features into something between fury and exhaustion. The figure of that worthless heap of burning foundations known as THE Living Elemental was blasted backward by the shockwave, hitting the surrounding trees of the mountain like a sack of ugly potatoes.
His cursed form crumpled against the ancient bark with impact that would have been satisfying to witness if Noah had cared enough about the wretch to feel true satisfaction.
But his attention remained on Emotive.
A unique scene unfolded after that impact.

THE Living Emotive looked toward the peak of the mountain that Noah could not perceive too well, the region where THE Creature’s temple sat shrouded in multicolored flames. Her expression held accusation that exceeded her previous anger, and she no longer attacked THE Undivided One.
Instead, she actually began to float toward it.
Uniquely, THE Undivided One had gone still.

The winged lion’s serpent mane ceased its hissing. Each individual serpent blinked with confusion that should not have been possible for extensions of a being of undifferentiation. Its wings, which had been beating with performative aggression moments before, now folded against its leonine body with docility that contradicted everything its form suggested. Its face that had never been mortal shifted through expressions it had never worn before, cycling through confusion and recognition and something that looked almost like affection.
Its entire massive form shook as if it was remembering something, as if new information was integrating into its existence that changed everything it had believed about the situation.
And then the ridiculous scene occurred.

THE Living Emotive floated up toward THE Undivided One’s shoulder, her now crimson hair blazing with manic energy that seemed more petulant than threatening now. She settled onto the winged lion’s massive shoulder as if it were a chair, her small form perching upon primordial horror with casualness that defied comprehension.

The serpents of its mane that had been hissing with malice moments before now regarded her with something approaching protectiveness, their eyes softening in ways that their undifferentiated nature should not have permitted.
She looked up toward the mountain where THE Creature resided and spoke with an angry gaze.
"Because you did not want to help, you forced me to use my last Bond on some random Undivided One!"
Her voice carried across Alfheimr with weight that pressed against the glorious twilight.
"I was saving that for THE Youngest! Just because you can resist our Bond doesn’t mean you can bully me like this, Creature!"
Noah was astonished as he looked at the body of THE Living Emotive.

She was filled with manic energy that seemed to contradict the gravity of what she had just revealed. Her angry words came across more like pouting than genuine fury, complaints directed toward an unseen being who apparently cared nothing for her displeasure.

Below her, the winged lion shook its shoulder with motion that caused her to drift off her perch. The serpents of its mane hissed with what sounded almost like apology as their movement disrupted her seating. She pouted toward it with expression that would have been more appropriate on a child denied a treat than on an Absolute.

THE Undivided One was still adjusting with confusion that Noah could perceive even through the distant observation of his Inscription anchor. Whatever bond or definition had been placed on it had fundamentally altered its perception of THE Living Emotive.She was no longer prey. She was no longer enemy. She was...
A friend.
Someone it did not want to harm.

The transformation had occurred in seconds, invisible to many except Noah’s newly elevated perception, and now the winged lion treated Emotive with something approaching protectiveness despite having no logical reason to do so.
Where its paws touched, existence still forgot what solidity meant, but it was careful now to keep those paws away from the small woman.
But she had revealed something that painted a much clearer picture.

Noah had asked himself how this woman had moved from THE Creature to THE Living Paradox, how she had ingratiated herself with beings who should have had no reason to tolerate her presence. He had wondered how she managed to cling to THE Primordial Chaos in Alfheimr, how she inserted herself into dynamics that had nothing to do with her own agenda.
Now he understood.

She had a unique power of definition or differentiation based on her terrifying manic emotions. A power that allowed her to form some sort of Bond with beings, even someone as powerful as THE Creature. A bond that influenced the target to treat her differently, to feel closeness toward her that they had not chosen and could not explain.
Emotive. THE Broken Doll!

She seemed to be among the few unique beings in Observable Existence whose capabilities exceeded their apparent classification. There was more to her than what met the eye, depths of power that her manic surface behavior disguised behind seemingly unhinged emotion.
Her methodology interested Noah greatly.

The invisible nature of it seemed very similar to THE Entity, even though the two of them were clearly not related. Both operated through subtle influence rather than direct confrontation. Both altered the targets they affected without those targets realizing what was happening until the transformation was complete.
But the differences were equally significant.

THE Entity, THE Primordial Mycelia, took over and controlled the entirety of the will of another. It subsumed consciousness into its unified network, dissolving individuality into collective purpose. Its targets ceased to be themselves entirely.
THE Broken Doll formed bonds that made one feel like they were her family or lover.

Her targets remained themselves. They retained their will, their consciousness, their individual nature. But their perception of her shifted, their emotional responses to her presence transformed into something that served her purposes.
They believed they cared about her because she had made them believe it through definition so subtle that they could not perceive its presence.
Noah filed this information away for future consideration.
But even as he observed all of this, he had to divide his attention.

The churning infinity symbol around his body in THE Interstices continued processing THE Infinite Observable Harvest, unit after unit of amplified and elevated resources flowing into his foundations. His perception of Alfheimr through the Inscription anchor remained active, observing Emotive and her newly bonded winged lion with analytical interest.
But in THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, Bazuman had begun to move.
Noah had to see exactly how his newly elevated Immensity and methods would work against THE Undivided One that had chased him across THE Prima Indifferentia!

Because while the winged lion that THE Living Emotive had just bonded to was powerful, a being that would have devastated most average Absolutes in direct conflict, a creature whose very paws made existence forget what solidity meant...
It was nowhere near the level of Bazuman!
That ancient horror, that entity who had pursued Noah through corrupted proto-matter with hunger...
Bazuman was something else entirely.
And Noah was about to discover whether his growth had been sufficient to reach him!

chapters.title: Chapter 4927: Ganging Up On Bazuman! I
paragraphs: In THE Agora of Primordial Judgment, the air itself had grown heavy with anticipation.
Noah stood beside THE Primordial Paradox, his existence burning with blue-gold Infinities that pressed outward against the corrupted proto-matter flooding through the crack above.

The ancient stones beneath his feet thrummed with vibrations he could feel through his soles, the entire structure of THE Agora responding to the presence that had emerged from THE Prima Indifferentia.
Behind them, the four Strategoi had arranged themselves in positions of readiness for combat!

Glossikos stood with her linguistic authority coiling around her form. Khaotikos shifted between states of matter and energy with increasing instability. Ontikos emanated the calm weight of Existence itself. And Paradoxos displayed both fear and determination across his dual faces!
Before them all stood Bazuman.
THE Undivided One had emerged fully from the crack now, its round chthonian form settling upon the ancient stones with weight that made one’s teeth ache from the pressure.
Countless crimson eyes arranged in spiraling patterns across its spherical mass gazed outward in every direction, each one burning with hunger.

Innumerable tentacles extended from its form, each tipped with mouths that held teeth made of crystallized memories. Its entire surface churned constantly, revealing glimpses of faces and forms beneath, the remnants of beings who had ceased to exist everywhere except within Bazuman’s infinite memory.
The Immensity it carried pressed against Noah’s perception like a physical weight settling upon his shoulders, like heavy hands pushing down on his chest with every breath he took!

This wasn’t the same as the winged lion that Emotive had just bonded to in Alfheimr. That creature had been powerful, yes, capable of devastating most Absolutes in direct conflict. But Bazuman existed in an entirely different classification.
It was like comparing that pathetic floundering embarrassment known as THE Living Elemental to beings like THE Living Paradox or THE Primordial Chaos.
They were legitimately leagues apart.

And at this moment, this thing was keeping its gaze locked onto Noah. Every single one of those countless crimson eyes had oriented toward him specifically, tracking his movements with attention that felt uncomfortably personal.

The weight of that collective focus pressed against his skin like heat from a forge held too close. The tentacles that extended from its form seemed to reach in his direction even when they weren’t actively moving, drawn by magnetism that operated on levels beyond physical attraction.
Noah couldn’t help but look toward it and ask the question that had been forming since he first felt its attention.
"Am I wrong to think that you are obsessed with me, Bazuman?"
Bazuman’s many eyes smiled.
The expression shouldn’t have been possible. Monstrous eyes couldn’t smile, couldn’t convey emotion through shape alone!
And yet every single crimson orb across its churning surface curved upward at the edges, creating an impression of brutal amusement.
When it spoke, its voice emerged from a thousand mouths simultaneously, a deep resonance of undifferentiation that seemed to vibrate inside Noah’s chest rather than reach him through the air.
"I tasted you."
The words pressed against reality itself!
"You tasted of unique endless undifferentiation. And I let you slip past me."
Its tentacles writhed with increased intensity.
"And right now, with this corrupted paradoxical spread of proto-matter..."
Its eyes blazed brighter.
"I feel like I have tasted yet another portion of you inside me."
The mouths across its surface all curved into expressions of hunger.
"I want more."
Every eye focused on Noah with intensity.
"I... want you."
BOOM!
The words were horrid for Noah to hear, and he felt his existence recoiling with distaste. It felt like this Undivided One was confessing in the worst way possible!
But the words were heavy in other ways as well.

They caused THE Primordial Paradox to frown, his obsidian-gold flames flickering with attention that had shifted from casual observation to serious concern. He kept his calm gaze on THE Undivided One, but Noah could feel the weight of his perception turning partially toward him as he asked a question that demanded honest answer.
"Youngest, what is he talking about? Your authority is spreading alongside my disciple’s corruption?"

THE Primordial Paradox asked this with an inquisitive gaze, and Noah could see this being already looking at the surrounding influx of corrupted paradoxical proto-matter with eyes that were breaking down everything. Those ancient perceptions were analyzing the composition of the corruption, identifying the blue-gold threads of Infinity woven through its structure, tracing their origins back to the source that had inserted them.
So Noah replied honestly.
"Since your disciple was spreading corruption to affect all of Observable Existence, I added a little of myself onto that train."
His voice held no apology.
"I’m just going along for the ride and benefiting from it."
He met THE Primordial Paradox’s gaze directly.
"And yes, I know of the potential dangers that may come from this. It seems like I’m looking at one right now."
THE Primordial Paradox frowned momentarily, his obsidian-gold flames burning. He looked at Noah silently for a moment that stretched longer than it should have.
Then he spoke with a voice that held warning beneath its calmness.
"You know, but you also don’t know."
His gaze shifted to Bazuman.

"There’s a reason why after you disappeared in that crack of Observable Existence in THE Prima Indifferentia and I was staring straight at the one responsible for making this happen... I was still unable to collapse Bazuman at that time."
His flames flickered.
"Amongst Undivided Ones, the level of undifferentiation from Bazuman is immensely high. And part of the reason, which I now understand, was you."
His eyes returned to Noah.
"He had a bit of you eons ago. Even if briefly, Bazuman had ingested you. He had ingested Infinity."
"And now, you have given him a glimpse of more."
Noah listened to these words quietly and with calmness that he maintained through force of will. He knew the dangers of what he’d done with the process that THE Living Paradox had initiated.

He’d known from the moment THE Infiniverse scattered his Seals through the corrupted proto-matter. He’d declared that he would face whatever arose from his choice and take care of it himself, even proclaiming that he would take on the responsibility to stop THE Living Paradox if needed.
But it seemed that right now, he would get a glimpse of exactly what would be required of him.
Because not long after THE Primordial Paradox finished his words...
Bazuman laughed.
The sound emerged from a thousand mouths simultaneously, brutal amusement that made the ancient stones of THE Agora crack beneath its resonance.
Every crimson eye across its churning surface blazed with light that exceeded their previous intensity, and its horrid body pulsed!
BOOM!
Its many eyes released a terrifying sense of pressure that exceeded anything that many here had never felt from an individual entity before!

Glossikos stood with her linguistic authority coiling around her form.
Khaotikos shifted between states of matter and energy with increasing instability.

Countless crimson eyes arranged in spiraling patterns across its spherical mass gazed outward in every direction, each one burning with hunger.
Innumerable tentacles extended from its form, each tipped with mouths that held teeth made of crystallized memories.
Its entire surface churned constantly, revealing glimpses of faces and forms beneath, the remnants of beings who had ceased to exist everywhere except within Bazuman’s infinite memory.
The Immensity it carried pressed against Noah’s perception like a physical weight settling upon his shoulders, like heavy hands pushing down on his chest with every breath he took!
This wasn’t the same as the winged lion that Emotive had just bonded to in Alfheimr.
That creature had been powerful, yes, capable of devastating most Absolutes in direct conflict.
But Bazuman existed in an entirely different classification.
It was like comparing that pathetic floundering embarrassment known as THE Living Elemental to beings like THE Living Paradox or THE Primordial Chaos.
They were legitimately leagues apart.
And at this moment, this thing was keeping its gaze locked onto Noah.
Every single one of those countless crimson eyes had oriented toward him specifically, tracking his movements with attention that felt uncomfortably personal.
The weight of that collective focus pressed against his skin like heat from a forge held too close.
The tentacles that extended from its form seemed to reach in his direction even when they weren’t actively moving, drawn by magnetism that operated on levels beyond physical attraction.
Noah couldn’t help but look toward it and ask the question that had been forming since he first felt its attention.
"Am I wrong to think that you are obsessed with me, Bazuman?"
Bazuman’s many eyes smiled.
The expression shouldn’t have been possible.
Monstrous eyes couldn’t smile, couldn’t convey emotion through shape alone!
And yet every single crimson orb across its churning surface curved upward at the edges, creating an impression of brutal amusement.
When it spoke, its voice emerged from a thousand mouths simultaneously, a deep resonance of undifferentiation that seemed to vibrate inside Noah’s chest rather than reach him through the air.
"I tasted you."
The words pressed against reality itself!
"You tasted of unique endless undifferentiation.
And I let you slip past me."
Its tentacles writhed with increased intensity.
"And right now, with this corrupted paradoxical spread of proto-matter..."
Its eyes blazed brighter.
"I feel like I have tasted yet another portion of you inside me."
The mouths across its surface all curved into expressions of hunger.
"I want more."
Every eye focused on Noah with intensity.
"I... want you."
BOOM!
The words were horrid for Noah to hear, and he felt his existence recoiling with distaste.
It felt like this Undivided One was confessing in the worst way possible!
But the words were heavy in other ways as well.
They caused THE Primordial Paradox to frown, his obsidian-gold flames flickering with attention that had shifted from casual observation to serious concern.
He kept his calm gaze on THE Undivided One, but Noah could feel the weight of his perception turning partially toward him as he asked a question that demanded honest answer.
"Youngest, what is he talking about?
Your authority is spreading alongside my disciple’s corruption?"

THE Primordial Paradox asked this with an inquisitive gaze, and Noah could see this being already looking at the surrounding influx of corrupted paradoxical proto-matter with eyes that were breaking down everything.

Those ancient perceptions were analyzing the composition of the corruption, identifying the blue-gold threads of Infinity woven through its structure, tracing their origins back to the source that had inserted them.
So Noah replied honestly.
"Since your disciple was spreading corruption to affect all of Observable Existence, I added a little of myself onto that train."
His voice held no apology.
"I’m just going along for the ride and benefiting from it."
He met THE Primordial Paradox’s gaze directly.
"And yes, I know of the potential dangers that may come from this.
It seems like I’m looking at one right now."

chapters.title: Chapter 4928: Ganging Up On Bazuman! II
paragraphs: The pressure congealed into physical form, becoming a sea of crimson undifferentiation that instantly settled all around THE Agora like a tide of dissolution washing over everything it touched.
The red light pressed against Noah’s skin with weight that felt like being submerged in water that wanted to unmake him.
It permeated through the air, through the stones, through the very fabric of existence in this region, seeking to dissolve definition wherever it found purchase.
And this undifferentiation carried a glimmer of Infinity and profound Paradox!

It felt like the exertion of overwhelming will made manifest, like the authority of undifferentiation pressing against everything that dared to be differentiated. The moment it erupted, structures throughout THE Agora began to waver, their defined edges becoming uncertain, their solid forms questioning whether they were truly solid at all.
Noah withstood it with his existence alone!
His Infinities burned brilliantly across his form, blue-gold flames rising from every aspect of his being to press back against the crimson tide.
The sensation was like standing in a river that wanted to sweep him away, but his feet remained planted on bedrock that couldn’t be moved!
Absolute Immovable Object!
Where the undifferentiation touched his light, it didn’t find purchase. His nature regenerated faster than it could be unmade, his definition reasserting itself with every nanosecond that passed!
He felt the pressure, yes. But he wasn’t undifferentiated.
He remained exactly what he was.

Beside him, THE Primordial Paradox was surrounded by obsidian-gold light that formed a bubble of absolute protection around his form. The paradoxical authority that comprised his existence simply declared that undifferentiation couldn’t affect him, and reality accepted that declaration without question. Not a single mote of crimson light penetrated his barrier. He stood as an island of perfect calm within the sea of dissolution.
But the four Strategoi behind them...
Glossikos had solemn expression on her features as crimson undifferentiation lapped against her linguistic authority, her weavings struggling to maintain coherence against the pressure.

Khaotikos shifted between states with increasing desperation, trying to find a configuration that the undifferentiation couldn’t affect, finding none. Ontikos emanated the weight of Existence itself, but even Existence wavered beneath pressure that sought to make it forget what existence meant.
And Paradoxos, this two faced bum, despite his affinity for paradox, found that Bazuman’s undifferentiation was paradoxical in ways that his own authority couldn’t fully counter.
These four were actually struggling!

The mere exertion of pressure from this Undivided One was that grand, that overwhelming, that it could challenge four Strategoi of THE Agora simultaneously through nothing more than its released Immensity.

Bazuman looked toward Noah with all of its eyes, and every single one of them smiled with the same brutal amusement that had preceded its laugh. Its tentacles reached toward him through the crimson tide, mouths at their tips opening with hunger that made his stomach pulse.
"I. Want. You!"
BOOM!
It erupted thereafter!
Noah observed as around Bazuman, the manifestation of its power unfolded in configurations of Civilizational wonder.
Echoes...began emerging from its churning mass.

Not physical beings, but impressions of beings. Reconstructions formed from Bazuman’s perfect memory of everything it had ever consumed. They poured forth from its surface like spirits rising from a grave.
They took shapes that spoke of Absolutes from before THE Infinite Unfurling, of creatures that had ceased to exist everywhere except within Bazuman’s infinite recollection.
They were things...that Bazuman had swallowed and undifferentiated.

Echoes filled with whispers came first, faint impressions that attacked with fractions of their original power but in overwhelming numbers. Hundreds of them... translucent forms that launched toward Noah and THE Primordial Paradox and the struggling Strategoi with attacks that shouldn’t have been possible from beings who no longer existed.

More followed, stronger manifestations. Noah saw the forms of Absolutes he didn’t recognize, wielding authority that felt ancient even by the standards of Observable Existence. They spoke Embodiments and released attacks based on methodologies that had been lost to history for eons uncounted.
But even this wasn’t the extent of Bazuman’s horror.
Its form split open.
The spherical mass that comprised its body cracked down the center like an egg being hatched, and from within that crack emerged light that held no color.
It was a pocket dimension of pure undifferentiation that existed within Bazuman’s interior, a space where the rules of Existence ceased to apply and all things trended toward eternal dissolution.
This was where Noah had been swallowed into before!

Gravitational pull erupted from the opening, affecting everything nearby. Noah felt it tugging at his existence, felt his body lean forward slightly before he braced himself against the pull. The echoes that Bazuman had manifested became more numerous as it drew upon deeper reserves within itself. The very air became hazardous, proximity to Bazuman causing passive dissolution that began working on anything that drew too close.
Tentacles became more aggressive, seeking to drag opponents into that horrifying interior. And across Bazuman’s wounded surface where the split had formed, additional mouths began manifesting.
Such terrifying power unfolded!
All of the horrors that Bazuman manifested created a suction force that dragged everything toward the yawning maw at its core!
Noah could see structures of THE Agora being pulled toward the endless light of undifferentiation, ancient stones that had witnessed eons of judgment now sliding across the ground toward consumption.

Even the figures of the four Strategoi weren’t still. They were being pulled while they resisted, their feet scraping against ground and skies that offered no purchase, their Civilizations beginning to burn brightly around them as they enacted their own Embodiments to maintain position one after another while repelling horrid Manifestations!
On Noah’s chest, something bloomed.

The sensation was warmth spreading outward from his chest, comfortable heat like a hearth coming to life. A defensive Transcendent Paradoxical Inscriptio Dormiens activated without his conscious command, its golden page manifesting against his chest and burning with dual lights of differentiation and undifferentiation.
The Inscription declared that he couldn’t be consumed, that his existence wasn’t susceptible to the suction that affected everything else, and reality accepted that declaration.
Echoes of Absolute from Bazuman surrounded him, and...
Noah remained unfettered.
He took no damage.

He stood perfectly still while structures crumbled around him and Strategoi struggled to maintain position, his Infinities burning with brilliance that exceeded their previous intensity as he faced Bazuman’s full echoes and manifestation with calm that he maintained through absolute confidence in what he’d become.
At this time, THE Primordial Paradox spoke with a voice that cut through the chaos without effort.
"An enemy like this is one that needs to be defeated in a short span of time."
His obsidian-gold flames burned brighter.
"Especially since he is an Undivided One. I couldn’t erase it before because it had your glimmer of Infinity."
His eyes turned to Noah.
"But if you are confident, Youngest, I can hold it down to give you the opportunity to confirm that you truly know what you are doing."
"I can hold it down... if you can use your Infinity to overcome its now endless undifferentiation."
